table.name: Injector Scaling
table.description:
Injector size constant, shown as the injector flow (g/s) the ECU assumes at the 0.3 MPa reference of Injector Flow Compensation. Cranking pulses, latency, minimum pulse and the throttle-rate transient fuel are in microseconds and do not follow it.
Details: Injector size constant, read as the injector flow the ECU assumes at the reference pressure of Injector Flow Compensation. 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x this x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125, and 0x0D15EC (read) the base pulse FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x fuel-trim factors (1.0 at nominal trims) in microseconds; 0x0D1528 then applies the fuel factor and 0x0D2BB8 the flow compensation and latency. Result: base pulse [us at 0.3 MPa] = 131.40 x this x stoichiometric fuel mass per cylinder per cycle [g], i.e. flow = 7610.3 / this g/s (shown). For new injectors set the reference flow to new flow at 10 MPa x 44/256 (if Injector Flow Compensation is kept). Not scaled by this value (must be rescaled by hand when it changes): Injector Latency, Minimum Pulse Width, the cranking pulses (Cranking Fuel tables, Cranking Fuel Secondary), Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain and Term Minimum, and the HPFP fuel-quantity axes, which are all in microseconds of pulse; the open-loop/enrichment tables and Transient Fuel Film Target are mass-based and follow automatically (read: cal 0x1C6EE is read by 0x0B8030, the film step 0x0F6B18 and the Tip-In Extra Pulse step 0x0F54B8, which also scales with it). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector Latency
table.description:
Fixed time added to every injection pulse, by rail pressure; probably the injector opening delay.
Details: Added to every injection pulse: 0x0D3848 writes FFF8B08C = this(rail pressure) [+ Injector Latency Adder], and 0x0D2BB8 adds FFF8B08C x 0.8 us to the fuel time (read). Interpreted as injector opening delay (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Latency Adder
table.description:
Extra latency added only while an injector-driver fault (P062D / P2146) is active. No effect on a healthy car.
Details: Added to Injector Latency (saturating) only while FFF88F4A bit 1 is set (0x0C7808 / 0x0D3848, read). That bit is the injector-driver fault flag set by 0x080B96 (P062D / P2146; the same bit selects Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target A, read), so this is a fault-mode latency: no effect on a healthy car. Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3)
table.description:
Multiplier on the fuel quantity of injectors 1 and 3 by rail pressure: more pressure means more flow, so less pulse. Keep equal to Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4).
Details: When used: Used by the pulse functions of injectors 1 and 3 (read); injectors 2 and 4 use Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4). Multiplier on the fuel quantity of every injection: pulse = latency + quantity x this / 256 (0x0D2BB8), looked up from rail pressure FFF88886 by 0x0CB0C8 into FFF8AFEA (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4)
table.description:
Same as Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 1/3) but for injectors 2 and 4 (rail pressure plus Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset).
Details: When used: by the pulse functions of injectors 2 and 4 (0x0D2EDC / 0x0D300C / 0x0D3524 / 0x0D3654, read). Looked up by 0x0CB0C8 from FFF89222 = rail pressure FFF88886 + Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset into FFF8AFEC (read). keep them equal unless deliberately trimming one bank (bank reading inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector Minimum Pulse Width
table.description:
Shortest pulse the ECU will command; any shorter computed pulse is raised to this. Adjust for injectors with a different minimum controllable pulse.
Details: Floor for every injection pulse: 0x0D2BB8 takes the larger of the computed pulse and this value (FFF8B088, from 0x0D2B9C) before the 1 s cap at cal 0x11CFC (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 1
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 1 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.
Details: Multiplier on injector 1's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D168C writes FFF8C060 = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1E4 (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 2
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 2 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.
Details: Multiplier on injector 2's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D1848 writes FFF8C064 = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1E6 (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 3
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 3 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.
Details: Multiplier on injector 3's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D1A04 writes FFF8C068 = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1E8 (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Trim 4
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for cylinder 4 only, by fuel quantity and rpm (128 = no change), applied before the pulse is split into injections. Use it to balance individual cylinders.
Details: Multiplier on injector 4's fuel quantity before the split into injections: 0x0D1BC0 writes FFF8C06C = quantity x this(quantity, rpm) / 128 + the per-cylinder transient (wall-film + throttle-rate) fuel term FFF8C1EA (0x0F6260; not learned: 0x8000 = none, reset to 0x8000 outside running; adds 4 x (term - 32768) counts) (read). Order 1-4 is the order the code processes FFF8C060-C06C; the transient fuel module's cylinder masks (05C8A0-05C8C4, read in 0x0F5AD0) only fit firing order 1-3-2-4 if slot n is cylinder n+1, so 1-4 is the cylinder number (inferred, strong). Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Single Injection)
table.description: Details: When used: Strategy byte = injections per cycle (FFF8A69E, 0x0CF3EC, read): this one applies with one injection. Written to FFF8A6A3 by 0x0CF630 (read). Injector 1's quantity (0x0D168C) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A69F equals 1 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 2 (Single Injection)
table.description: Details: When used: Applies with one injection per cycle. Written to FFF8A6A6 by 0x0CF684 (read). Injector 2's quantity (0x0D1848) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A0 equals 1 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 3 (Single Injection)
table.description: Details: When used: Applies with one injection per cycle. Written to FFF8A6A9 by 0x0CF6D8 (read). Injector 3's quantity (0x0D1A04) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A1 equals 1 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 4 (Single Injection)
table.description: Details: When used: Applies with one injection per cycle. Written to FFF8A6AC by 0x0CF72C (read). Injector 4's quantity (0x0D1BC0) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A2 equals 1 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset
table.description:
Pressure offset added to measured rail pressure before looking up Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4), by rpm and load; probably the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor.
Details: 0x06D43A (read): FFF89222 = sat(rail pressure FFF88886 + this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616)), interpolated by 0x00671C (descriptor 0x0608E4: data, u16 axis, u8 axis, 16, 16; row = rpm, read). FFF89222 indexes the injector flow compensation 05A844 used only for injectors 2 and 4 (0x0CB0C8, read); injectors 1 and 3 use 05A838 with FFF88886. Likely the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor (inferred from the boxer layout). Signed, in the rail-pressure unit. Descriptor boot 057A64. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure
table.description:
Main fuel rail pressure target in normal warm running, by load and rpm. Higher pressure = better atomisation and more injector flow at the cost of pump load. Replaced by Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released) with the pedal released.
Details: Rail-pressure target 0x165180 (called from the HPFP module 0x164804, read) writes FFF8B9A0, the target used by the pump feedback and the P0087/P0088 monitor. Normal running (combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 and engine state FFF99844 = 3; cal 0x3F28C = 0 makes the wait timer zero): target = base byte table x 150 counts. The byte target is held at its previous value while it changes by less than cal 0x3F28A (4 = 0.37 MPa), and capped at cal 0x3F39A x 153/28. This is the main base table: load FFF8A616 x rpm FFF8CD56. If FFF8A774 bit 0 is set it is replaced by Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released); with no sensor faults (FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5 clear) Target Rail Pressure Additive x Additive Multiplier / 255 is added. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Pedal Released)
table.description:
Rail pressure target used instead of Target Rail Pressure while the accelerator is fully released (cranking or running), by coolant.
Details: When used: Replaces Target Rail Pressure while FFF8A774 bit 0 is set: accelerator fully released while cranking or running (0x0E127C / 0x09FF9A, read). 0x165180 (read): replaces Target Rail Pressure while FFF8A774 bit 0 is set (the same flag selects Base Timing (Pedal Released, TGV Closed/Open)); coolant FFF88A44. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure Additive
table.description:
Extra rail pressure added to Target Rail Pressure, scaled by Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier, only with no rail-pressure sensor faults.
Details: 0x165180 (read): added to Target Rail Pressure (in its byte units) after scaling by Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier / 255, only while FFF88E28 bit 2 and FFF88E2B bit 5 are clear; result clipped to 0...255. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure Additive Multiplier
table.description:
Scaling (255 = x1.0) for Target Rail Pressure Additive, by an unidentified input and what is probably intake air temperature.
Details: 0x165180 (read): multiplier (/255) on Target Rail Pressure Additive, looked up from FFF88A9D (unidentified) and FFF88662 (intake air temperature + 50, inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 0)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in the first phase after start (combustion mode 0), by coolant and rpm.
Details: 0x165180 (read): target x 150 while combustion mode FFF8A85C is 0 (first phase after start), coolant FFF88A44 x rpm FFF8CD56 (400...1,600 rpm). Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 4, Start Delay)
table.description:
Rail pressure target used in normal running mode only during a start delay before the engine counts as running.
Details: 0x165180 (read): used in combustion mode 4 instead of Target Rail Pressure until the engine is running (FFF99844 = 3) and the counter FFF86A54 >= cal 0x3F28C. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Released)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 3 (the phase before normal running) with the accelerator fully released, by coolant.
Details: When used: FFF88C64 bit 5 = accelerator fully released (0 % for 2 passes, cleared at 0.25 %; 0x09FF9A, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode FFF8A85C = 3 while FFF88C64 bit 5 is set (else Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Applied)); coolant FFF88A44. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 3, Pedal Applied)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 3 (the phase before normal running) with the accelerator pressed, by coolant.
Details: When used: Combustion mode 3 with the accelerator applied (FFF88C64 bit 5 clear, read). 0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode 3 while FFF88C64 bit 5 is clear. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Combustion Mode 1)
table.description:
Rail pressure target in combustion mode 1 (an early warm-up phase).
0x165180 (read): target in combustion mode 1 while FFF899D7 bit 0 is clear. Confidence: read.

table.name: Target Rail Pressure (Catalyst Heating)
table.description:
Fixed rail pressure target during stratified catalyst heating (combustion mode 2).
Details: 0x165180 (read): fixed target in combustion mode FFF8A85C = 2 (stratified catalyst heating). Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target A
table.description:
Rail pressure target while an injector-driver fault (P062D / P2146) is active. No effect on a healthy car.
Details: 0x165180 (read): target while FFF88F4A bit 1 is set (injector-driver faults P062D / P2146, set by 0x080B96, read); if bit 2 is also set the lower of A and B is used. Confidence: read.

table.name: Rail Pressure Fail-Safe Target B
table.description:
Second fail-safe rail pressure target; the lower of A and B is used when both apply. Nothing that activates it was found, so it probably never applies.
Details: 0x165180 (read): target while FFF88F4A bit 2 is set. No setter of that bit was found in either image. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Feedforward Command

scaling.units: us (injector pulse, 0.3 MPa ref, incl. latency)

table.description:
Open-loop high-pressure pump command (a crank angle) by fuel quantity and rpm; the pressure controller adds its correction on top. Lower angles appear to mean more pump delivery. The fuel-quantity axis is in microseconds of injector pulse, so it must be rescaled when Injector Scaling changes.
Details: 0x16474C (read): open-loop pump command FFF8B984 from fuel quantity FFF8AFEE (injector pulse words / 8, 0x0CB0F4) x rpm FFF8CD56. Command FFF8B99A = this + proportional + integral/16 (0x164778, 0x165094), clamped to cal 0x3ED0E...0x3ED10+0x3ED16 (2,250...3,450). Lower values at higher fuel quantity, i.e. lower command = more delivery (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Proportional Gain
table.description:
Proportional gain of the rail-pressure controller, by rpm: how hard the pump command reacts to pressure error. Higher = faster but risks oscillation.
Details: 0x164DB0 (read): proportional term FFF8B996 = (actual rail pressure FFF88884 - target FFF8B9A0) x this / 41967, saturated to s16. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Fuel Quantity Limit

scaling.category: mg fuel per cylinder (at Injector Scaling 2918)
scaling.units: mg (stoich fuel per cylinder per cycle)

scaling.category: base pulse (0.3 MPa reference, any Injector Scaling)

table.description:
Ceiling on the base fuel quantity, the stoichiometric fuel the ECU calculates from measured air before any enrichment. Its meaning in air depends on Injector Scaling. Raise it in proportion when you raise Injector Scaling, or the engine will run lean at high airflow.
Details: When used: always while running (every pass of 0x0B7E00, which computes load and the base fuel quantity, read). Upper limit of the base (stoichiometric) fuel quantity FFF8ADEA. 0x0B8030 (read) computes FFF8ADEA = air quantity FFF8C250 x Injector Scaling x 0.10266 / 14.7 / 4 / rpm x 0.125 (= 0.5587 x Injector Scaling x air per cylinder per cycle in g) and stores min(that, this) (0x0B80FC-0x0B8112: MOVU.W @0x23696, CMP/GE, read). The limited value is what the rest of the fuel path uses: the base pulse 0x0D15EC (FFF8C05C = 16 x FFF8ADEA x trims), before the enrichment/fuel factor 0x0D1528 and the flow compensation and latency 0x0D2BB8; the transient-fuel film model 0x0F5F84; the fuel load FFF8ADEE (0x0B895C); and the fuel-used accumulators 0x06B70E (read). Above the limit the base pulse stops rising with airflow, so the mixture goes lean as air keeps rising; enrichment is applied on top of the limited value and does not lift it (inferred from the order of the calls). The raw unit includes Injector Scaling, so the limit in air terms moves with it: air per revolution at the limit = this x 3.580 / Injector Scaling (raw) g/rev = this x reference injector flow [g/s] x 0.0004704. With Injector Scaling at 1.74 g/s (fuel added for E85 by lowering the flow figure) the limit drops to 3.32 g/rev; below about 1.73 g/s it falls under the 3.31 g/rev (256 %) ceiling of engine load FFF8ADE4 (0x0B7EFC, read) and becomes the first limit reached. When you raise Injector Scaling raw (lower reference flow), raise this in proportion: new = 4060 x new raw / 2918 keeps 4.98 g/rev (u16, up to 65535). On AT/CVT codings, while FFF886AB bit 5 is set (meaning not decoded), the value is first smoothed by boot filter 0x6CEC with cal 0x23694; the limit applies on either path (read). 4060 in all eight images; the same code in LF78001H 0x0C1770, LF79002P 0x0C83DC, LF79100P 0x0C788C, LF9C100P 0x0C0ED8, LV9N 0x0A6840 (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Integral Step
table.description:
How much the rail-pressure controller's integral term moves each 10 ms pass, toward removing a steady pressure error. Higher = faster correction, more risk of hunting.
Details: 0x164B3C (read): only in HPFP state FFF8AB35 = 3 the integrator FFF86A44 (added to the command as /16) steps down by this when target - actual >= HPFP Integral Threshold, up by this when actual - target >= the threshold, and holds while |target - actual| < the threshold; it is frozen while the command sits at its clamp, and limited to cal 0x3F346...0x3F344 (-19200...19200). p16 (read): 0x164B3C (<- 0x164804 <- 0x07C408) runs every 10 ms. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Integral Threshold

scaling.units: us (injector pulse, 0.3 MPa ref, incl. latency)

table.description:
Deadband of the rail-pressure integrator, by fuel quantity (microseconds of injector pulse): while the pressure error is smaller than this, the integral term holds; beyond it, it steps toward removing the error. Larger = more steady error tolerated, less hunting.
Details: 0x164B3C (read): pressure error (target - actual) at which the integrator changes direction, by fuel quantity FFF8AFEE. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Command Minimum
table.description:
Lower limit of the high-pressure pump command, a crank angle in the pump frame. The upper limit is HPFP Command Maximum Base plus HPFP Command Range, so raising this does not raise the upper limit; keep it below that.
Details: 0x165094 (read): lower clamp of the pump command FFF8B99A; also an integrator freeze point (0x164B3C). Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Command Maximum Base
table.description:
Base of the high-pressure pump command upper limit: the limit is this + HPFP Command Range. Raise this (or the Range) to raise the upper limit; HPFP Command Minimum does not move it.
Details: 0x165094 (read): the upper clamp of the pump command FFF8B99A is this + HPFP Command Range. 0x164B3C also treats a command equal to this + Range as saturated (integrator freeze). While the fixed-command flag (third argument of 0x165094) is set the command is cal 0x3ED14 instead. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Command Range
table.description:
Range of the high-pressure pump command: the upper limit is HPFP Command Maximum Base + this, so it does not move with HPFP Command Minimum. Also used by the pump solenoid circuit monitor.
Details: 0x165094 (read): the upper clamp is HPFP Command Maximum Base (cal 0x3ED10) + this; 0x0776BA compares the solenoid window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C with 2 x this for the circuit monitor's enable flags. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Solenoid Window Start
table.description:
Start of the pump solenoid's energised window, by battery voltage and rpm, as a crank angle in the pump frame. Used whenever the engine is running.
Details: When used: whenever the engine is not in state 1 (FFF99844, 0x165120, read): FFF8B99C = this(battery FFF9DD61, rpm FFF8CD54) - FFF8B98C (+0x8000 offset); 0 in state 1. B99C is the lower bound of the end angle FFF8B994 and the start of the energised window (inferred). HPFP module 0x164804 (read). Values are in the HPFP command unit (the same unit as FFF8B99A and the angle reference FFF8B98C = cal 0x3F302 - FFF8C21E); the window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C is what 0x0776BA converts to time with rpm for the solenoid circuit monitor. Unit: 0.1 degree crank angle (the driver 0x1E9824 schedules cmd x 2 in units of 0.05 degree of a 10-degree tooth, read), shown in degrees. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Solenoid Window End Limit
table.description:
Upper limit on the end of the pump solenoid's energised window, by battery voltage and rpm, as a crank angle.
Details: When used: whenever the engine is not in state 1 (0x164D04, read): FFF8B994 = max(FFF8B99C, min(this(battery, rpm) - B98C, command FFF8B99A - HPFP Solenoid End Offset - B98C)) (+0x8000 offsets); in pump state FFF8AB35 = 4 only this limit is used. HPFP module 0x164804 (read). Values are in the HPFP command unit (the same unit as FFF8B99A and the angle reference FFF8B98C = cal 0x3F302 - FFF8C21E); the window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C is what 0x0776BA converts to time with rpm for the solenoid circuit monitor. Unit: 0.1 degree crank angle (the driver 0x1E9824 schedules cmd x 2 in units of 0.05 degree of a 10-degree tooth, read), shown in degrees. Confidence: read.

table.name: HPFP Solenoid End Offset
table.description:
Crank angle subtracted from the pump command to give the end of the solenoid's energised window, by rpm.
Details: When used: whenever the engine is not in state 1 (0x164D04, read): subtracted from the pump command FFF8B99A to give the solenoid end angle FFF8B994 (before the HPFP Solenoid Window End Limit). Written to FFF8B998. HPFP module 0x164804 (read). Values are in the HPFP command unit (the same unit as FFF8B99A and the angle reference FFF8B98C = cal 0x3F302 - FFF8C21E); the window FFF8B994 - FFF8B99C is what 0x0776BA converts to time with rpm for the solenoid circuit monitor. Unit: 0.1 degree crank angle (the driver 0x1E9824 schedules cmd x 2 in units of 0.05 degree of a 10-degree tooth, read), shown in degrees. Confidence: read.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Double Injection)
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 1 when it fires twice per cycle (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: Applies with two injections per cycle. Written to FFF8A6A4 by 0x0CF64C (read). Injector 1's quantity (0x0D168C) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A69F equals 2 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 1 (Triple Injection)
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 1 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: Applies with three injections per cycle. Written to FFF8A6A5 by 0x0CF668 (read). Injector 1's quantity (0x0D168C) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A69F equals 3 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 2 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: Applies with three injections per cycle. Written to FFF8A6A8 by 0x0CF6BC (read). Injector 2's quantity (0x0D1848) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A0 equals 3 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 3 when it fires twice per cycle (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: Applies with two injections per cycle. Written to FFF8A6AA by 0x0CF6F4 (read). Injector 3's quantity (0x0D1A04) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A1 equals 2 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 3 (Triple Injection)
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 3 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: Applies with three injections per cycle. Written to FFF8A6AB by 0x0CF710 (read). Injector 3's quantity (0x0D1A04) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A1 equals 3 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 4 (Double Injection)
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 4 when it fires twice per cycle (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: Applies with two injections per cycle. Written to FFF8A6AD by 0x0CF748 (read). Injector 4's quantity (0x0D1BC0) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A2 equals 2 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Per-Injector Fuel Multiplier 4 (Triple Injection)
table.description:
Fuel multiplier for injector 4 when it fires three times per cycle (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: Applies with three injections per cycle. Written to FFF8A6AE by 0x0CF764 (read). Injector 4's quantity (0x0D1BC0) is multiplied by this / 128 when that injector's strategy byte FFF8A6A2 equals 3 (read). The strategy byte is probably the number of injections per cycle (inferred from the split-injection code). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop)
table.description:
Minimum enrichment whenever the engine is out of closed loop for any reason: the mixture is at least this rich. Check it as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling when leaning the open-loop target.
Details: When used: whenever the closed-loop state FFF8A820 is not 1 (closed loop) and the combustion mode FFF8A85C >= 3 (normal running or its phase before). 0x0C9DCC (read): FFF8A662 = this(rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616) + FFF8B06C/128, FFF8B06C = 05B1DC(rpm, load) x 05B1F0(DAM)/128 (0x0D13B4); 0 in closed loop. The fuel factor 0x0C558C uses max(open-loop enrichment FFF8A684 + Additional Enrichment FFF8AFE8, FFF8A662), capped at 2 x cal 0x13E5C (128), as an enrichment candidate (read). So while open loop for any reason, the mixture is at least this rich. Unit 1/256 of fuel, shown as AFR like Primary Open Loop Fueling. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Open Loop Delay Load Threshold
table.description:
Load, by rpm, above which the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group takes effect after a delay; below it that group is off.
Details: When used: always while running; gates the FFF8A681 open-loop group (Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...)). 0x0C9CCC (read): a flag is set while load FFF8A616 <= this(rpm FFF8CE9C); while set the timer FFF8AFD6 is held at 0, above the threshold it counts up by cal 0x138AE (1) per pass; with FFF8AFE6 = 0 it is 0xFFFF. 0x0CEA80 accepts FFF8A681 only while FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the delay from 0x0CAA44 (coolant, drive mode and other conditions; not decoded). So above this load the TGV/AVCS open-loop group takes effect after the delay. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive by the Dynamic Advance Multiplier (DAM), so the extra fuel is added as knock history lowers DAM. Edit with the (TGV/AVCS Group) copy.
Details: Multiplier for Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive, indexed by FFF811AE (DAM x 16). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive by DAM (128 = x1.0).
Details: When used: cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear. Multiplier (128 = x1.0) for Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive, indexed by DAM x 16 (FFF811AE, the same input as Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive DAM Multiplier, read 0x0CE96A). 0x0CE854 (read; called from 0x0C589C with cal 0x2F79A bit 4, exhaust temperature estimate FFF8AFD0, its integral FFF8C03C, rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, DAM FFF811AE): while the exhaust-temperature condition holds (FFF8AFD0 >= cal 0x18DD4, hysteresis 0x18DD6, or FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8) and cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is clear, FFF8A683 = clamp((Primary Open Loop Fueling x 128 + Additive x Additive DAM Multiplier(DAM)) / 128 - Subtractive x Subtractive DAM Multiplier(DAM) / 128, 0, 255) (0x0CE934..0x0CE9A0, read: signed 16-bit table, same rpm x load inputs as the Additive, product shifted arithmetically, so negative cells add fuel). The result is rate-limited (FFF84424) into FFF8A682; 0x0CEA80 takes max(FFF8A682, the TGV/AVCS group FFF8A681) into the commanded-lambda enrichment FFF8A684 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Low-DAM Enrichment
table.description:
Extra fuel, by rpm and load, that richens the closed-loop target, the closed-loop override and the open-loop floor, scaled up as DAM falls (Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier). Probably a knock-history safety enrichment.
Details: When used: always while running; scaled to zero at DAM >= 15/16. 0x0D13B4 (read): FFF8B06C = this(rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616) x Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier(FFF811AE)/128 (equivalence ratio x 32768). B06C makes the closed-loop lambda target richer by 43194 x B06C/(B06C + 32768) (0x0FF468), is added to the Closed Loop Target Override (0x0FFBD8), and B06C >> 7 is added to 05A6DC(rpm, load) into FFF8A662 in combustion mode >= 3 when not in closed loop (0x0C9DCC) (read). Full at DAM 1/16, none at DAM 15/16, so it is a knock-history (low DAM) enrichment (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Low-DAM Enrichment DAM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Low-DAM Enrichment by DAM.
Details: When used: multiplies Low-DAM Enrichment (0x0D13B4, read), indexed by FFF811AE (DAM x 16). Confidence: read.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open)
table.description:
Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs open, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed) by TGV position and scaled by Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier. Raising it adds fuel while cold. Warm-up role inferred from the coolant axis.
Details: Enrichment FFF8B030 (0x0CF19C): a blend of this table and Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed) weighted by FFF8B3E8 (this table at TGVs fully open), times the RPM multiplier (read). FFF8B030 is one of the terms of the commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88, read) and enters the pulse through the fuel factor FFF8AFBC (0x0C558C, read). Role as warm-up enrichment inferred from the coolant axis. Blend weight FFF8B3E8 is the TGV position weight from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Coolant-based warm-up enrichment with the TGVs closed, blended with Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open) by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel while cold.
Details: Warm-up enrichment with the TGVs closed: FFF8B030 (0x0CF19C, read) = this x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open) x FFF8B3E8, times Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier; see Warm-Up Enrichment (TGV Open). FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, and 0x10C948 drives FFF8B3E8 toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the warm-up enrichment by rpm (128 = x1.0).
Details: Scales the FFF8B030 warm-up enrichment blend (0x0CF19C). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Warm-Up Enrichment (Coolant Window Override)
table.description:
Replaces the warm-up enrichment for a while after start, but only when the start coolant falls inside a calibrated window.
Details: When used: only when coolant at start FFF88A46 lies within cal 0x237B4...0x237B2. 0x0CF19C (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B030 = this(coolant FFF88A44) instead of the Warm-Up Enrichment TGV blend until the accelerator has been pressed for cal 0x2377F (40) passes within the first cal 0x237B6 (800) counts of FFF8B06A; the output may move by at most cal 0x23780 (65535 = unlimited) per pass. FFF8B030 is the warm-up term of commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Fuel Factor Correction (RPM x Load)
table.description:
General fuel correction by rpm and load in open and closed loop (128 = no change, each count about 0.4 %). Probably a light-load base-fuel correction.
Details: 0x0FD5F8 (called every pass from the closed-loop scheduler 0x0FD76C, read) looks this up by rpm FFF8CD56 (x50) and load FFF8A616 into FFF8A828; the fuel factor 0x0C558C sums A828 + cal 0x38460 (128) - 128 + trims + enrichment into FFF8AFBC (256 = x1.0), and the start path uses (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 (0x0D1400); with 128 as the neutral value each count above 128 adds 1/256 (0.39 %) of fuel in open and closed loop alike (read). Role (light-load base-fuel correction) inferred. p16 (read): the closed-loop scheduler 0x0FD76C runs in the 20 ms OS task (0x1E0AE8). Confidence: read.

table.name: Additional Enrichment Throttle Threshold
table.description:
Throttle opening above idle, by rpm, needed to enable Additional Enrichment A/B.
0x0D3BFC (from 0x0C782C, args read) sets the Additional Enrichment enable FFF8A654 bit 1 only when, among others, FFF88A3C (throttle opening above the idle opening: FFF88A3A - FFF8AFB8, 0x08015C) >= this(rpm FFF8CD54) or FFF88EDA bit 0, and rpm >= cal 0x13E08 = 65535 and coolant >= cal 0x13E14 = 65535 (or FFF88E28 bit 1), so the enable never sets (read; my research notes section 3). Once met, the threshold becomes cal 0x13E12 itself (1049 = 2.4 %), not the table value minus 1049: the code computes threshold - (threshold - 0x13E12) (0x0D3C90-0x0D3CAE, read); the rpm and coolant hysteresis cals 0x13E0A/0x13E16 work the same way. Belongs to Additional Enrichment A/B. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Open, EGR Off)
table.description:
Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs open and little or no EGR. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).
Details: When used: EGR flow estimate below 1000. Used when TGVs are open and FFF8B2A6 < 1000. 0x0FF468 (from the closed-loop module 0x0FD76C, read) picks one of four target tables by TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (set = TGVs closed) and by FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C (1000); FFF8B2A6 is the estimated EGR flow from EGR Valve Flow Model (05CB70) at the actual valve position (0x0FA830, read); 1000 = 0.67 g/s (EGR flow unit g/s x 1500, p16). The table value plus Closed Loop Target Cold-Start Trim, minus the Low-DAM Enrichment term 43194 x B06C/(B06C + 32768), is combined with 43194 + Closed Loop Target Lean Limit - 32768 by taking the lower (richer) value into FFF8B30A; then FFF8B312 = FFF8B30A + FFF8B336 (0x0FF634), converted to the final target FFF8B31E (0x0FF904, 0x0FF8C8). Closed loop drops out (state 9) when the target is richer than cal 0x2E726 (lambda 0.80) (0x0FB6F4, read). Axes rpm (FFF8CD56) x load % (FFF8A616). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Closed, EGR Active)
table.description:
Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs closed and EGR flowing. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).
Details: When used: TGVs closed and estimated EGR flow FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C (1000 = 0.67 g/s) (0x0FA830, read; EGR identification via OBD PID 0x2C, inferred). Used when TGVs are closed and FFF8B2A6 >= 1000. 0x0FF468 (from the closed-loop module 0x0FD76C, read) picks one of four target tables by TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (set = TGVs closed) and by FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C (1000); FFF8B2A6 is the estimated EGR flow from EGR Valve Flow Model (05CB70) at the actual valve position (0x0FA830, read); 1000 = 0.67 g/s (EGR flow unit g/s x 1500, p16). The table value plus Closed Loop Target Cold-Start Trim, minus the Low-DAM Enrichment term 43194 x B06C/(B06C + 32768), is combined with 43194 + Closed Loop Target Lean Limit - 32768 by taking the lower (richer) value into FFF8B30A; then FFF8B312 = FFF8B30A + FFF8B336 (0x0FF634), converted to the final target FFF8B31E (0x0FF904, 0x0FF8C8). Closed loop drops out (state 9) when the target is richer than cal 0x2E726 (lambda 0.80) (0x0FB6F4, read). Axes rpm (FFF8CD56) x load % (FFF8A616). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Closed, EGR Off)
table.description:
Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs closed and EGR closed or nearly closed. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).
Details: When used: EGR flow estimate FFF8B2A6 below 1000: EGR closed or nearly closed. Used when TGVs are closed and FFF8B2A6 < 1000. 0x0FF468 (from the closed-loop module 0x0FD76C, read) picks one of four target tables by TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (set = TGVs closed) and by FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C (1000); FFF8B2A6 is the estimated EGR flow from EGR Valve Flow Model (05CB70) at the actual valve position (0x0FA830, read); 1000 = 0.67 g/s (EGR flow unit g/s x 1500, p16). The table value plus Closed Loop Target Cold-Start Trim, minus the Low-DAM Enrichment term 43194 x B06C/(B06C + 32768), is combined with 43194 + Closed Loop Target Lean Limit - 32768 by taking the lower (richer) value into FFF8B30A; then FFF8B312 = FFF8B30A + FFF8B336 (0x0FF634), converted to the final target FFF8B31E (0x0FF904, 0x0FF8C8). Closed loop drops out (state 9) when the target is richer than cal 0x2E726 (lambda 0.80) (0x0FB6F4, read). Axes rpm (FFF8CD56) x load % (FFF8A616). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target (TGVs Open, EGR Active)
table.description:
Closed-loop lambda target with the TGVs open and EGR flowing. Picked by TGV state and estimated EGR flow, then limited by the Closed Loop Target Lean Limit tables. Targets richer than lambda 0.80 drop the ECU into open loop (Closed Loop Minimum Target).
Details: When used: EGR flow estimate FFF8B2A6 >= 1000 (see TGVs Closed, EGR Active). Used when TGVs are open and FFF8B2A6 >= 1000. 0x0FF468 (from the closed-loop module 0x0FD76C, read) picks one of four target tables by TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (set = TGVs closed) and by FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C (1000); FFF8B2A6 is the estimated EGR flow from EGR Valve Flow Model (05CB70) at the actual valve position (0x0FA830, read); 1000 = 0.67 g/s (EGR flow unit g/s x 1500, p16). The table value plus Closed Loop Target Cold-Start Trim, minus the Low-DAM Enrichment term 43194 x B06C/(B06C + 32768), is combined with 43194 + Closed Loop Target Lean Limit - 32768 by taking the lower (richer) value into FFF8B30A; then FFF8B312 = FFF8B30A + FFF8B336 (0x0FF634), converted to the final target FFF8B31E (0x0FF904, 0x0FF8C8). Closed loop drops out (state 9) when the target is richer than cal 0x2E726 (lambda 0.80) (0x0FB6F4, read). Axes rpm (FFF8CD56) x load % (FFF8A616). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Closed, Other Modes)
table.description:
Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs closed outside normal combustion mode.
Details: 0x0FF9A0 (read) writes FFF8B324 from coolant (FFF88A44) x load % (FFF8A616): TGVs closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 set) use 05CD8C when combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 (normal) and 05CD78 otherwise; TGVs open use 05CDB4 / 05CDA0 the same way. 0x0FF468 forms 43194 + FFF8B324 - 32768 and the richer of that and the selected Closed Loop Target becomes FFF8B30A (read), so values below 32768 cap the target richer when cold. 32768 = no change. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Closed, Normal Mode)
table.description:
Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs closed in normal combustion mode.
Details: 0x0FF9A0 (read) writes FFF8B324 from coolant (FFF88A44) x load % (FFF8A616): TGVs closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 set) use 05CD8C when combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 (normal) and 05CD78 otherwise; TGVs open use 05CDB4 / 05CDA0 the same way. 0x0FF468 forms 43194 + FFF8B324 - 32768 and the richer of that and the selected Closed Loop Target becomes FFF8B30A (read), so values below 32768 cap the target richer when cold. 32768 = no change. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Open, Other Modes)
table.description:
Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs open outside normal combustion mode.
Details: 0x0FF9A0 (read) writes FFF8B324 from coolant (FFF88A44) x load % (FFF8A616): TGVs closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 set) use 05CD8C when combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 (normal) and 05CD78 otherwise; TGVs open use 05CDB4 / 05CDA0 the same way. 0x0FF468 forms 43194 + FFF8B324 - 32768 and the richer of that and the selected Closed Loop Target becomes FFF8B30A (read), so values below 32768 cap the target richer when cold. 32768 = no change. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Lean Limit (TGVs Open, Normal Mode)
table.description:
Caps the closed-loop target at no leaner than this, by coolant and load; values below neutral force a richer target when cold. Used with TGVs open in normal combustion mode.
Details: 0x0FF9A0 (read) writes FFF8B324 from coolant (FFF88A44) x load % (FFF8A616): TGVs closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 set) use 05CD8C when combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4 (normal) and 05CD78 otherwise; TGVs open use 05CDB4 / 05CDA0 the same way. 0x0FF468 forms 43194 + FFF8B324 - 32768 and the richer of that and the selected Closed Loop Target becomes FFF8B30A (read), so values below 32768 cap the target richer when cold. 32768 = no change. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Cold-Start Trim (TGVs Open)
table.description:
Small trim to the closed-loop target after a cold start, by start coolant and air used since start, with the TGVs not closed.
Details: When used: TGVs not forced closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 clear). 0x0FFA0C (read): FFF8B326 = 32768 + (this - 32768) x (05CDF0/05CE04(rpm, load) / 2979) x (05CE18/05CE24(FFF8AF12) / 255); B326 - 32768 is added to the closed-loop target (0x0FF468, see Closed Loop Target). Axes: coolant at start FFF89224 x accumulated air since start FFF81818 (0x10A270). Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed Loop Target Override
table.description:
Alternate closed-loop target (plus Low-DAM Enrichment) that replaces the final target under a fuel-routine condition that has not been identified.
Details: 0x0FFBD8 (read): FFF8B32A = this(rpm FFF8CD56, load % FFF8A616) + FFF8B06C. 0x0FF8C8 (read) writes FFF8B32A into the final closed-loop target FFF8B31E when FFF8A65C bit 0 is set (FFF8A65C is written by fuel routines 0x0C73D0 / 0x0CC6A4; the condition is not decoded). Stored as equivalence ratio x 32768. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Closed Loop Minimum Target
table.description:
Richest target allowed in closed loop: if the target is richer than this, the ECU switches to open loop.
Details: 0x0FB6F4 (read): when the target FFF8B310 (= 43194 x 32768 / FFF8B31E) is below this, closed-loop state FFF8A820 becomes 9 (open loop) and the closed-loop flag FFF8A82E bit 7 clears. Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Gain (Negative Error)
table.description:
How fast closed-loop fuel trim corrects when the error is negative, by rpm and load. Larger = faster correction, too large can make the trims oscillate.
Details: When used: closed loop active, error FFF8B2C8 < 0. Axes rpm FFF8CD5C (rpm/25) x load % FFF8A616 (0x0FEC3C, read). Larger = faster integral action. Closed-loop fuel controller 0x0FEC3C (from 0x0FD76C, read): while closed loop is active (FFF8A82E bit 7) the integrator FFF85190 (-> FFF8B2F8 and the correction FFF8B2F4) is stepped each pass by (shaped error x gain) >> 8, where the shaped error is one of six curves of the error FFF8B2C8 = target - measured (equivalence ratio x 32768, Phase 7) and the gain is Closed Loop Integral Gain (rpm, load) x 05CCBC(coolant) x cals (read). Curve selection (read, disassembly checked at 0x0FEE44-0x0FEEEA): pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) -> 05CC4C (negative error, by |error|, result negated) / 05CC58 (positive); pedal applied -> coolant FFF8CD65 below cal 0x4B294 (100 = 50 degC) 05CC70 (negative) / 05CC88 (positive), warmer 05CC64 (negative) / 05CC7C (positive). Positive error = target richer than measured (sign inferred). The axis is |error|; output in the same unit. Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Gain (Positive Error)
table.description:
How fast closed-loop fuel trim corrects when the error is positive, by rpm and load. Larger = faster correction, too large can make the trims oscillate.
Details: When used: closed loop active, error FFF8B2C8 >= 0. Axes rpm FFF8CD5C (rpm/25) x load % FFF8A616 (0x0FEC3C, read). Larger = faster integral action. Closed-loop fuel controller 0x0FEC3C (from 0x0FD76C, read): while closed loop is active (FFF8A82E bit 7) the integrator FFF85190 (-> FFF8B2F8 and the correction FFF8B2F4) is stepped each pass by (shaped error x gain) >> 8, where the shaped error is one of six curves of the error FFF8B2C8 = target - measured (equivalence ratio x 32768, Phase 7) and the gain is Closed Loop Integral Gain (rpm, load) x 05CCBC(coolant) x cals (read). Curve selection (read, disassembly checked at 0x0FEE44-0x0FEEEA): pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) -> 05CC4C (negative error, by |error|, result negated) / 05CC58 (positive); pedal applied -> coolant FFF8CD65 below cal 0x4B294 (100 = 50 degC) 05CC70 (negative) / 05CC88 (positive), warmer 05CC64 (negative) / 05CC7C (positive). Positive error = target richer than measured (sign inferred). The axis is |error|; output in the same unit. Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Error Shaping (Idle, Negative Error)
table.description:
Shapes how the closed-loop error size turns into a trim step (multiplied by Closed Loop Integral Gain). Used with the pedal released and negative error.
Details: When used: Pedal released, error < 0. Closed-loop fuel controller 0x0FEC3C (from 0x0FD76C, read): while closed loop is active (FFF8A82E bit 7) the integrator FFF85190 (-> FFF8B2F8 and the correction FFF8B2F4) is stepped each pass by (shaped error x gain) >> 8, where the shaped error is one of six curves of the error FFF8B2C8 = target - measured (equivalence ratio x 32768, Phase 7) and the gain is Closed Loop Integral Gain (rpm, load) x 05CCBC(coolant) x cals (read). Curve selection (read, disassembly checked at 0x0FEE44-0x0FEEEA): pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) -> 05CC4C (negative error, by |error|, result negated) / 05CC58 (positive); pedal applied -> coolant FFF8CD65 below cal 0x4B294 (100 = 50 degC) 05CC70 (negative) / 05CC88 (positive), warmer 05CC64 (negative) / 05CC7C (positive). Positive error = target richer than measured (sign inferred). The axis is |error|; output in the same unit. Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed Loop Integral Error Shaping (Idle, Positive Error)
table.description:
Shapes how the closed-loop error size turns into a trim step (multiplied by Closed Loop Integral Gain). Used with the pedal released and positive error.
Details: When used: Pedal released, error >= 0. Closed-loop fuel controller 0x0FEC3C (from 0x0FD76C, read): while closed loop is active (FFF8A82E bit 7) the integrator FFF85190 (-> FFF8B2F8 and the correction FFF8B2F4) is stepped each pass by (shaped error x gain) >> 8, where the shaped error is one of six curves of the error FFF8B2C8 = target - measured (equivalence ratio x 32768, Phase 7) and the gain is Closed Loop Integral Gain (rpm, load) x 05CCBC(coolant) x cals (read). table.name: Closed Loop Learning Averaging Passes
table.description:
Number of passes the closed-loop correction is averaged over before each long-term trim learning update, by rpm and load; probably the learning window.

table.name: Closed Loop Learning Step

table.name: LTFT Coolant Scaling (Positive)
table.description:
Scales a learned long-term trim that adds fuel, by coolant (128 = x1.0).
Details: Long-term fuel trim (0x0C589C -> 0x0CECA8 and 0x0FD76C -> 0x0FD3E4, read). table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain
table.description:
Acceleration/deceleration fuel on throttle movement, by coolant: larger = more fuel when the throttle opens and less when it closes. The table the manual car uses, every pass while running. Keep the three Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain tables consistent.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running (always the selected table on the manual car). 0x0F6D98 (read): the coolant factor of B26E = 32768 + (FFF8ADF2/256 - 128) x this x Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate RPM Multiplier/256 x 0.8188. Larger = more fuel on throttle opening and less on closing. Input FFF88A44 (coolant). Selection: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain is used while FFF8A618 bit 0 is set, which is always on the manual coding (cal 0x2F794 bit 1 clear, 0x0B8544, read); the (AT/CVT) table is used on AT/CVT codings while FFF8A618 bit 0 is clear (FFF886B0 bit 6 set after the first cal 0x34978 passes, not identified); the table when the manual flag FFF886AB bit 7 is set and either bit 0 is clear or cal 0x2F794 bit 2 is clear (rule: (A618 b0 = 0 or (0x2F794 b2 = 0 and 886AB b7)) ?: this one, read). Keep the three coolant tables consistent. The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). Fuel-trim learning (0x0FFE40) is enabled only while all four C1F4 words are within cals 0x4B850..0x4B852 (32674..32862) (Phase 7, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (AT/CVT)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain; only used with an automatic/CVT coding, no effect on a manual car.
Details: When used: AT/CVT codings only, while FFF8A618 bit 0 is clear. Same role as Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (0x0F6D98, read). Selection: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain is used while FFF8A618 bit 0 is set, which is always on the manual coding (cal 0x2F794 bit 1 clear, 0x0B8544, read); the (AT/CVT) table is used on AT/CVT codings while FFF8A618 bit 0 is clear (FFF886B0 bit 6 set after the first cal 0x34978 passes, not identified); the table when the manual flag FFF886AB bit 7 is set and either bit 0 is clear or cal 0x2F794 bit 2 is clear (rule: (A618 b0 = 0 or (0x2F794 b2 = 0 and 886AB b7)) ?: this one, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the throttle-movement transient fuel by rpm (256 = x1.0). Raise it for more tip-in fuel at that rpm. Not active for the first second with the pedal released or at steady idle at standstill.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running, unless the inhibit conditions hold (first 1 s of running with the accelerator released; steady idle at standstill, read). 0x0F6D98 (read): B26E = 32768 + (FFF8ADF2/256 - 128) x coolant gain x this/256 x 0.8188, in the 3.2 us transient-term unit; FFF8ADF2 is the 10 ms change of the throttle-area air estimate FFF8ADF0 (0x0B8BB0 / 0x0B8A6C, read; air-estimate meaning inferred), centred on 32768. B26E is accumulated into each cylinder term FFF8C1F4 (0x0F6750), so opening the throttle adds fuel and closing it removes fuel, down to Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Term Minimum (acceleration/deceleration fuel, inferred). Input FFF8CE9C (rpm). The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). Fuel-trim learning (0x0FFE40) is enabled only while all four C1F4 words are within cals 0x4B850..0x4B852 (32674..32862) (Phase 7, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Term Minimum
table.description:
Largest fuel reduction the throttle-closing side of the transient fuel may command, by coolant.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running. 0x0F6750 (read): the throttle-rate term of each cylinder FFF8C1F4 = max(this(coolant FFF8CD65), previous + increment), where the increment is (FFF8A802 + 64)/64 x (B26E - 32768) (B26E from Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain, 0x0F6D98). Cylinders injected since the previous pass are then decayed toward 32768: they keep FFF8A7F8/256 of their deviation. So this is the largest fuel reduction the throttle-closing side of the term may command. The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). Fuel-trim learning (0x0FFE40) is enabled only while all four C1F4 words are within cals 0x4B850..0x4B852 (32674..32862) (Phase 7, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transient Fuel Film Target
table.description:
Fuel film mass target (mg) by load and rpm; when it rises, the difference is added to the following injections and then decays, compensating fuel film build-up (inferred). The values are fuel mass, but the load axis is fuel-based and scales with Injector Scaling: after changing Injector Scaling, multiply the load axis by new raw / 2918 to keep the same real loads.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running. 0x0F6B18 (read; call in 0x0F6260): the table value at fuel-based load (FFF8ADEE >> 8) x rpm/25 (FFF8CD5C) is compared with its value of the previous pass; the change d becomes the step B26C = d x Injector Scaling/1279 x 1024/6554 x Transient Fuel Film Gain (Coolant, 64 = x1.0)/64, which 0x0F5B60 adds to all four per-cylinder film terms FFF8C1DC. C1DC then decays only for cylinders that injected, by FFF8B25C/65536 per pass, and becomes C1EC = 32768 + (C1DC - 32768) x Transient Fuel Film Gain RPM Multiplier/128 (0x0F6048), clamped by 05C8DC and 05C8E8 (read). So raising load adds fuel to the following injections (build-up of a fuel film, inferred) and a fall in load would remove it. No step (B26C = none) while the throttle-air rate FFF8ADF2 is within 32717..32819, or in the first cal 0x344AC (100) passes (1 s) of running with the accelerator released, or at steady idle (FFF8A61F within 108..147, standstill, rpm within about +-50 rpm of the idle target B236) (read). A rise from 0.39 to 1.03 g/rev (30 to 80 % load) adds about 870 us (0.3 MPa reference) to each following injection, decaying about 1.5 % per injection (computed). The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). Fuel-trim learning (0x0FFE40) is enabled only while all four C1F4 words are within cals 0x4B850..0x4B852 (32674..32862) (Phase 7, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Transient Fuel Film Gain RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the load-rise (film) transient fuel by rpm while it adds fuel (128 = x1.0). Companion of Transient Fuel Film Target.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running, while the film term FFF8C1DC is positive (extra fuel). 0x0F6048 (read): C1EC = 32768 + (C1DC - 32768) x FFF8866A (128) x this/16384, i.e. the film term x this/128. With a negative film term 05C8F4(coolant) x 05C8D0(rpm/25) are used instead. Input FFF8CE9C (rpm). Companion of Transient Fuel Film Target. The transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 runs in the 10 ms task (0x07C408 chain, read) and only in fuel state 3 (running, FFF8906B); outside it every term is reset to 0x8000 = none (read). It keeps two per-cylinder terms that are summed into FFF8C1E4 = C1F4 + C1EC - 32768 (0x0F5EA0, read), which 0x0D168C adds to each injector quantity as 4 x (C1E4 - 32768) counts (Phase 7, read). Each term decays by a factor only for the cylinders injected since the previous pass (masks below, read), so this is a per-cylinder wall-film / transient fuel compensation (inferred). Fuel-trim learning (0x0FFE40) is enabled only while all four C1F4 words are within cals 0x4B850..0x4B852 (32674..32862) (Phase 7, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Transient Fuel Injected-Cylinder Mask (Event Index 0)
table.description:
Tells the transient fuel logic which cylinders were injected since the last pass, following the firing order 1-3-2-4. Do not edit unless the injection order changes.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running, when the event index FFF8CD93 is 0. 0x0F5AD0 (read): the mask FFF8A804 of cylinders injected since the previous 10 ms pass = table[current event index FFF8CD93 + 1](number of events since the last pass, FFF8A7FD). 0x0F5B60 and 0x0F6750 decay the transient-fuel terms only for the cylinders in the mask (read). Do not edit unless the injection order changes. Confidence: read.

table.name: Standstill Tip-In Enrichment
table.description:
Extra fuel when pulling away from standstill, by coolant; the largest active enrichment wins. Probably a cold drive-away aid. Triggered below 5 km/h as the pedal is first pressed.
Details: When used: pulling away from standstill (see below). Enrichment amount. 0x0CE3E0 (read): armed while running (FFF8906B = 3), vehicle speed FFF99835 <= cal 0x384A2 (5 km/h) and at least cal 0x384A4 (200) passes since the last event; it fires when the accelerator leaves the fully released state (falling edge of FFF886AB bit 5 = FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released, my research notes) and ends when the pedal is released again. Coolant FFF8CD65 (degC + 50) is latched at the event. FFF8B022 = Amount x 32 for the first Hold Time passes, then falls by 2 x Decay per pass to 0. The fuel factor 0x0C558C uses FFF8B022 >> 8 as one of the enrichment candidates (the largest wins, read); FFF8B022 also blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Standstill Tip-In Enrichment Hold Time
table.description:
How long Standstill Tip-In Enrichment is held at full amount before it decays, by coolant.
Details: When used: pulling away from standstill. Passes for which the full amount is held (counter FFF84421 < this). 0x0CE3E0 (read): armed while running (FFF8906B = 3), vehicle speed FFF99835 <= cal 0x384A2 (5 km/h) and at least cal 0x384A4 (200) passes since the last event; it fires when the accelerator leaves the fully released state (falling edge of FFF886AB bit 5 = FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released, my research notes) and ends when the pedal is released again. table.name: Standstill Tip-In Enrichment Decay
table.description:

Details: When used: pulling away from standstill, after the hold time. Step by which FFF8B022 falls per pass (x 2). 0x0CE3E0 (read): armed while running (FFF8906B = 3), vehicle speed FFF99835 <= cal 0x384A2 (5 km/h) and at least cal 0x384A4 (200) passes since the last event; it fires when the accelerator leaves the fully released state (falling edge of FFF886AB bit 5 = FFF88C64 bit 5, accelerator fully released, my research notes) and ends when the pedal is released again. table.name: Fuel Cut Recovery Enrichment (Pedal Pressed)
table.description:
Extra fuel after a fuel cut, by cut duration and coolant, while the oxygen sensor still reads lean and the pedal is pressed; probably to restore the catalyst. Longer cuts give more.
Details: When used: after a fuel cut, accelerator not fully released (FFF886AB bit 5 clear). 0x0CAE40 (read): FFF8B08A counts the passes of the current or last cylinder fuel cut (FFF8A64C bit 0, reset at its start). While the closed-loop state FFF8A820 = 3 (the state entered with FFF9DD60 bit 5 and its hold timer), the A/F signal FFF88AF6 >= cal 0x14F5A (43492, slightly lean of the 43194 = lambda 1.0 unit), FFF8881E < cal 0x14F5C, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 >= cal 0x14F5E (0), open-loop enrichment FFF8A684 and FFF8AFE8 both 0, and FFF88A2D bit 0 / FFF89053 bit 1 clear, FFF8A66C = this(cut duration FFF8B08A, coolant FFF88A44); else 0. FFF8A66C is one of the enrichment candidates of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (the largest wins, read). Role inferred: extra fuel after a fuel cut while the oxygen sensor still reads lean, larger after longer cuts. Unit 1/256 of fuel. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Fuel Cut Recovery Enrichment (Pedal Released)
table.description:
Extra fuel after a fuel cut while the sensor still reads lean and the pedal is released; probably to restore the catalyst.
Details: When used: after a fuel cut with the accelerator fully released (FFF886AB bit 5 set). 0x0CAE40 (read): FFF8B08A counts the passes of the current or last cylinder fuel cut (FFF8A64C bit 0, reset at its start). Role inferred: extra fuel after a fuel cut while the oxygen sensor still reads lean, larger after longer cuts. Unit 1/256 of fuel. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: TGV Transition Enrichment (Closing)
table.description:
Short fuel adder after the TGVs start to move, below 3600 rpm and only when cold (TGV Transition Enrichment Coolant Multiplier). Initial amount after a closing event, by rpm and load.
Details: When used: briefly after the TGVs start to move (event-triggered transient fuel). Initial fuel adder after a closing event, rpm FFF8CE9C x load FFF8A616 (signed). 0x0CA144 (read; called with air quantity FFF8B4D6, coolant FFF88A44, rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616, FFF8A64C bit 0, FFF8A881 bit 5, FFF8AB28 bit 3, the TGV position sensors FFF88AA8/FFF88AA6 and their learned end positions FFF80698/80694 (low) and FFF80696/80692 (high)): a closing event fires when a sensor leaves its high end position by more than cal 0x13EAA (82 counts), an opening event when it leaves its low end position by more than cal 0x13EA6 (82). High sensor value = TGV open (FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction, rises with the sensor average through 05D29C/05D290; inferred polarity). After an event and a short delay the compensation is set to the Enrichment table value, held for Hold Time passes, then moved toward 0 by Decay Step per pass; the alternate tables apply while FFF8AB28 bit 3 is set (flag not identified). FFF8AFE0 = closing + opening terms, only while rpm FFF8CE9C < cal 0x13EAE (3600 rpm), FFF8A64C bit 0 clear (no cylinder fuel cut) and FFF8A881 bit 5 set (TGV-module flag, not identified); FFF8AFDE = FFF8AFE0 x Coolant Multiplier / 32768. FFF8AFDE >> 8 is added to the fuel factor FFF8AFBC (256 = x1.0, 0x0C558C) and FFF8AFDE x 2^-16 to the fuel-mode-2 factor (0x0D1470) (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Event Fuel Adder Initial Hold (A7E2 bit0 Clear)
table.description:
Part of a fuel adder triggered when the idle becomes steady with the pedal released, in one fuel mode only. How long the adder is held; AT/CVT-coding table, the manual car uses the Set table.
Details: When used: after the FFF8A856 bit 5 event, in fuel mode 2 only. FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is always set on the manual coding (Phase 14), so this car uses the bit0 Set tables. Initial hold (passes). 0x0CF80C (read): on the event edge (FFF8A856 bit 5 held for FFF8B046 passes, B046 = 05AED8(rpm) x 3000 / rpm; FFF8A856 bit 5 is the catalyst-heating readiness flag of 0x10AAB0: pedal released in combustion mode 4, idle steady for Catalyst Heating Readiness Idle Stability Time, coolant window (read); the same trigger as the Spark Compensation Event of 0x0C27C4; what the event is for is not identified) the start value, the hold and the decay step are sampled on rpm FFF8CD54 x coolant FFF88A44. FFF8B048 = start value, held for Initial Hold passes, then lowered by Decay Step per pass to 0; the event ends on a combustion-mode change 4 -> other / 1 -> other or after 05AEE4(rpm) x 3000 / rpm passes. FFF8B048 x 2^-16 is added to the fuel factor of fuel mode 2 (0x0D1470 -> FFF8B076, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Event Fuel Adder Decay Step (A7E2 bit0 Clear)
table.description:
Part of a fuel adder triggered when the idle becomes steady with the pedal released, in one fuel mode only. How fast the adder fades after the hold; AT/CVT-coding table, the manual car uses the Set table.
Details: When used: after the FFF8A856 bit 5 event, in fuel mode 2 only. FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is always set on the manual coding (Phase 14), so this car uses the bit0 Set tables. Step per pass after the hold. 0x0CF80C (read): on the event edge (FFF8A856 bit 5 held for FFF8B046 passes, B046 = 05AED8(rpm) x 3000 / rpm; FFF8A856 bit 5 is the catalyst-heating readiness flag of 0x10AAB0: pedal released in combustion mode 4, idle steady for Catalyst Heating Readiness Idle Stability Time, coolant window (read); the same trigger as the Spark Compensation Event of 0x0C27C4; what the event is for is not identified) the start value, the hold and the decay step are sampled on rpm FFF8CD54 x coolant FFF88A44. FFF8B048 = start value, held for Initial Hold passes, then lowered by Decay Step per pass to 0; the event ends on a combustion-mode change 4 -> other / 1 -> other or after 05AEE4(rpm) x 3000 / rpm passes. FFF8B048 x 2^-16 is added to the fuel factor of fuel mode 2 (0x0D1470 -> FFF8B076, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (MT Coding)
table.description:
Alternate version of Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain used only when a transmission-coding switch is changed.
Same role as Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (0x0F6D98, read). Selection: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain is used while FFF8A618 bit 0 is set, which is always on the manual coding (cal 0x2F794 bit 1 clear, 0x0B8544, read); the (AT/CVT) table is used on AT/CVT codings while FFF8A618 bit 0 is clear (FFF886B0 bit 6 set after the first cal 0x34978 passes, not identified); the table when the manual flag FFF886AB bit 7 is set and either bit 0 is clear or cal 0x2F794 bit 2 is clear (rule: (A618 b0 = 0 or (0x2F794 b2 = 0 and 886AB b7)) ?: this one, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse Angle
table.description:
Part of an extra fuel pulse on fast tip-in. Probably the injection angle of that extra pulse, by rpm.
0x0CB604 (second-pulse channel of injector 1; 0x0CBAC8/0x0CBF8C/0x0CC450 for the others, args per my research notes, verified there with callers.py) uses this table, by rpm/25 FFF8CD5C, as the second-pulse angle in segment 3 when fuel mode = 1 (normal), one injection per cycle, the injector's segment counter FFF8888E (..8891) = 3 and the tip-in trigger FFF8A656 bit 7 is set (read). Units: degrees BTDC = 180 - x/2 (segment 3 offset x; same frame as the other injection angles). FFF8A656 bit 7 is written in the transient-fuel module 0x0F6260 from 0x0F6FA8, the tip-in trigger of Tip-In Extra Pulse RPM/Coolant Multiplier (needs running, combustion mode 4, rpm FFF8CE9C < cal 0x3824A, FFF8CD82 > cal 0x34436, FFF8ADF4 > cal 0x34438 and FFF888CF > cal 0x346A6); the same bit latches the throttle-air rate B260 (0x0F5424) that sizes the extra pulse B262 (0x0F54B8), and it blocks multiple injection (read). Cal 0x346A6 = 255 and the compare at 0x0F7028 is an unsigned CMP/HI against the sign-extended byte (0xFFFFFFFF), so the bit can never set (read). Reading: the angle of the tip-in extra pulse whose quantity is B262 (inferred from the shared trigger and the segment-3 condition; it is not part of any learning). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Part of an extra fuel pulse on fast tip-in. Scales the extra pulse by rpm (128 = x1.0).
Input FFF8CD5C (rpm/25), product term x/128 (>> 7, read). 0x0F54B8 (read; called from 0x0F6260): extra-pulse quantity FFF8B262 = (latched throttle-air rate FFF8B260 - 32768) x Injector Scaling x cals 0x343E2/0x343E4/0x343E0 x period FFF8CD46 (float) x Tip-In Extra Pulse Coolant Multiplier/64 x Tip-In Extra Pulse RPM Multiplier/128 x 05C830(FFF8CD82)/128 x FFF8A7FE/128, only in fuel state 3 with combustion mode FFF8A85C = 4; it is held at its maximum while the injector-1 state FFF8888E does not change. 0x0D2CE8 / 0x0D300C / 0x0D3330 / 0x0D3654 (read) use B262 x Injector Flow Compensation x 0.0125 as the second-pulse time of each injector when mode 4 and the per-injector flag FFF8A6F1..A6F4 (set while FFF8888E..8891 = 3) rises. B260 latches FFF8ADF4 (filtered throttle-air rate) only on the rising edge of FFF8A656 bit 7 (0x0F5424), which 0x0F6FA8 sets on a fast tip-in (rpm, FFF8ADF4 > cal 0x34438, MAP-based threshold 05C98C on FFF8B4CA) only if a byte exceeds cal 0x346A6 = 0xFF (sign-extended compare, read in the disassembly at 0x0F7020): never. "Tip-in" is inferred from the trigger inputs. Confidence: read.

table.name: Tip-In Extra Pulse Coolant Multiplier

Details: When used: selected while the neutral switch FFF88ADA bit 6 is clear. B260 latches FFF8ADF4 (filtered throttle-air rate) only on the rising edge of FFF8A656 bit 7 (0x0F5424), which 0x0F6FA8 sets on a fast tip-in (rpm, FFF8ADF4 > cal 0x34438, MAP-based threshold 05C98C on FFF8B4CA) only if a byte exceeds cal 0x346A6 = 0xFF (sign-extended compare, read in the disassembly at 0x0F7020): never. "Tip-in" is inferred from the trigger inputs. Confidence: read.
