table.name: Cranking Fuel (First Attempt)
table.description:
Main cranking fuel pulse by coolant, for a normal first cranking attempt. Raise for more fuel while cranking. Raw units: change it proportionally.
Details: When used: THE normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (combustion mode 0 maps to fuel mode 0, 0x108B08, read) on a first attempt (no repeat-crank history). Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 clear (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel mode 0 or 3. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt)
table.description:
Cranking fuel pulse by coolant used on a repeat attempt, after a previous attempt already injected fuel and reached 800 rpm or cranked a while. Raw units: change it proportionally.
Details: When used: Normal cranking pulse on a repeat attempt: since the last history reset (ignition off long enough, coolant table 05B270) fuel was injected and the engine passed 800 rpm or cranked for 400 counts (FFF811A7 bit 7, backup RAM, 0x0D3EA8, read). Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 not 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel mode 0 or 3. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Restart after Key-Off)
table.description:
Multiplier on the cranking fuel by coolant when restarting after the engine was switched off with the key (start type meaning inferred). Edit with Cranking Fuel Secondary Coolant Multiplier (Restart after Key-Off).
Details: When used: Start type FFF8A6E7 = 1: restart after the engine was switched off with the key (0x0D1268, read; meaning inferred). A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 1 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Restart after Stall)
table.description:
Multiplier on the cranking fuel by coolant when restarting after a stall with the ignition still on (start type meaning inferred). Edit with the Secondary copy.
Details: When used: Start type FFF8A6E7 = 2: restart after a stall (the engine ran and stopped, ignition stayed on) (0x0D1268, read; meaning inferred). A first start (type 0) uses x1.0. Multiplier in the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 when FFF8A6E7 = 2 (0x0C9038, coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50, read from the call at 0x0C6896); 255 (x1.0) for other values. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel RPM Multiplier (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Reduces cranking fuel as cranking rpm rises, by rpm and coolant, TGVs closed side of a TGV blend (255 = x1.0, inferred). Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together.
Details: When used: every pass of 0x0C9038 while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm) (read). 0x0C9038 blends this table (weight 1 - FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction) with 05A388, both on rpm FFF8CD54 x coolant FFF88A44, and filters the blend toward the target with weight cal 0x11D71 / 0x11D72 (13/256 at coolant FFF8CD65 >= cal 0x11D70 = 13 degC, else 179/256) through boot helper 0x6C70 into FFF8C535 / FFF842CC (read). The filtered byte multiplies the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (fuel modes 0/3) (255 = x1.0, inferred like the coolant multipliers). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x ramp x A67E x A687 x filtered RPM multiplier x coolant multiplier (x 05A1FC-or-64 in 0x0C8A28) x const, 0, 524280) x 0.125; the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C). Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together unless a TGV-dependent value is wanted. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel RPM Multiplier (TGV Open)
table.description:
Reduces cranking fuel as cranking rpm rises, by rpm and coolant, TGVs open side of a TGV blend (255 = x1.0, inferred). Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together.
Details: When used: every pass of 0x0C9038 while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm) (read). 0x0C9038 blends this table (weight FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction) with 05A374, both on rpm FFF8CD54 x coolant FFF88A44, and filters the blend toward the target with weight cal 0x11D71 / 0x11D72 (13/256 at coolant FFF8CD65 >= cal 0x11D70 = 13 degC, else 179/256) through boot helper 0x6C70 into FFF8C535 / FFF842CC (read). The filtered byte multiplies the normal cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (fuel modes 0/3) (255 = x1.0, inferred like the coolant multipliers). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x ramp x A67E x A687 x filtered RPM multiplier x coolant multiplier (x 05A1FC-or-64 in 0x0C8A28) x const, 0, 524280) x 0.125; the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C). Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together unless a TGV-dependent value is wanted. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Barometric Multiplier
table.description:
Cranking fuel multiplier by what is probably barometric pressure, for starting at altitude.
Details: FFF8A687 = this(FFF88668), or 255 when a flag is set (0x0CEBF4, read); FFF8A687 is a factor of the cranking pulse (0x0C8A28, read). FFF88668 runs 48-104 kPa on this axis, so it is taken as barometric pressure (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Pedal Multiplier
table.description:
Cranking fuel multiplier by accelerator position.
Details: When used: start types other than 3 (FFF8A6E7 != 3). 0x0CD7E4 (read): FFF8A67E = this(accelerator FFF88A5E), updated only while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm). FFF8A67E is the first factor of both cranking pulses (0x0C8A28 -> FFF8AFC4, 0x0C9038 -> FFF8AFC6, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (First Attempt)
table.description:
How fast the cranking fuel floor fades away after the engine starts, by start coolant, on a first attempt. 65536 = no decay, smaller = faster fade.
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear and FFF8A881 bit 2 set, FFF811A7 bit 7 clear (no repeat-crank history). Indexed by FFF8CD67, coolant (degC + 50) held from start. 0x0C9038 (read): outside cranking (fuel state FFF8906B != 2) the normal cranking pulse is no longer recomputed; each pass FFF842D0 = previous value x this / 65536, so FFF8AFC6 decays geometrically from its last cranking value. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel modes 0/3, where 10 x it is a floor on the quantity (0x0D168C). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. Argument mapping from the call at 0x0C6896 (my research notes, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.description:

Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear and s4 set, FFF811A7 bit 7 set (repeat crank). Indexed by FFF8CD67, coolant (degC + 50) held from start. 0x0C9038 (read): outside cranking (fuel state FFF8906B != 2) the normal cranking pulse is no longer recomputed; each pass FFF842D0 = previous value x this / 65536, so FFF8AFC6 decays geometrically from its last cranking value. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel modes 0/3, where 10 x it is a floor on the quantity (0x0D168C). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. Argument mapping from the call at 0x0C6896 (my research notes, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (First Attempt)
table.description:
Secondary cranking fuel pulse by coolant (first attempt). It is the cranking pulse whenever the engine cranks in normal combustion mode instead of the start mode: after about 10 s of continuous cranking, when the low-rail-pressure start latch is set (then scaled by Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier), or on a re-crank before the start sequence reset; it also sets a floor on fuel in normal running until it decays. Raw units: change it proportionally.
Details: When used: Secondary cranking pulse FFF8AFC4, used only in fuel modes 1/2 (a re-crank that starts before the combustion mode returned to 0, and as the running floor). First attempt (no repeat-crank history, FFF811A7 bit 7 clear). Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 (0x0C8A28, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 clear (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x 842C4 x coolant multiplier x 05A1FC-or-64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125, and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC4 feeds injectors in fuel mode 1 or 2. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Secondary cranking fuel pulse by coolant (repeat attempt). It is the cranking pulse whenever the engine cranks in normal combustion mode instead of the start mode: after about 10 s of continuous cranking, when the low-rail-pressure start latch is set (then scaled by Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier), or on a re-crank before the start sequence reset; it also sets a floor on fuel in normal running until it decays. Details: When used: Secondary pulse, repeat attempt: since the last history reset fuel was injected and the engine passed 800 rpm or cranked for 400 counts (FFF811A7 bit 7, 0x0D3EA8, read). Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 (0x0C8A28, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 not 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x 842C4 x coolant multiplier x 05A1FC-or-64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125, and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (First Attempt)
table.description:
How fast the secondary cranking fuel floor fades after the engine starts, by start coolant, on a first attempt (per 10 ms pass). 65536 = no decay, smaller = faster fade. Keep equal to Cranking Fuel Decay (First Attempt).
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear and FFF8A881 bit 2 set, FFF811A7 bit 7 clear (no repeat-crank history). Indexed by FFF8CD67, coolant (degC + 50) held from start (copied from FFF8CD65 only while the engine state is 1 or a counter is below cal 0x56936, 0x06BA46, read; reading inferred). Argument mapping read from the call at 0x0C6918. 0x0C8A28 (read): outside cranking (fuel state FFF8906B != 2) the secondary cranking pulse is no longer recomputed; each pass FFF842BC = previous value x this / 65536, so FFF8AFC4 decays geometrically from its last cranking value. FFF8AFC4 feeds injectors in fuel modes 1/2, where 10 x it is a floor on the running quantity (0x0D168C, see Cranking Fuel Secondary). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. p16 (read): one pass = 10 ms (0x0C8A28 <- 0x0C589C <- 0x07C408 <- 10 ms OS task 0x1DFE3C), so the per-pass factor f gives f^100 per second. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Secondary-path copy of Cranking Fuel RPM Multiplier (TGV Open): reduces secondary cranking fuel as rpm rises. Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together.
Details: When used: every pass of 0x0C8A28 while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm) (read). 0x0C8A28 blends this table (weight FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction) with 05A220, both on rpm FFF8CD54 x coolant FFF88A44, and filters the blend toward the target with weight cal 0x23728 / 0x23729 (13/256 at coolant FFF8CD65 >= cal 0x2376E = 13 degC, else 179/256) through boot helper 0x6C70 into FFF8C534 / FFF842C4 (read). The filtered byte multiplies the secondary cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 (fuel modes 1/2) (255 = x1.0, inferred like the coolant multipliers). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x ramp x A67E x A687 x filtered RPM multiplier x coolant multiplier (x 05A1FC-or-64 in 0x0C8A28) x const, 0, 524280) x 0.125; the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C). Edit the TGV Closed / Open pair together unless a TGV-dependent value is wanted. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplies the secondary cranking fuel by coolant when rail pressure is still low some time into a start (64 = x1.0).
Details: When used: while the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 is set (0x0C8A28 argument from the call in 0x0C589C, read; the latch is set by 0x10B54C when rail pressure is still low after a calibrated time, my research notes). 0x0C8A28 multiplies the secondary cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 by this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) instead of the fixed 64 (read), so 64 = x1.0. Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x ramp x A67E x A687 x filtered RPM multiplier x coolant multiplier (x 05A1FC-or-64 in 0x0C8A28) x const, 0, 524280) x 0.125; the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment
table.description:
Extra fuel by coolant when rail pressure is still low some time into a start, until pressure has stayed close to target for a while.
Details: When used: while the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 is set (0x10B54C, my research notes). 0x0CDD8C (read): FFF8B014 = this(coolant FFF8CD65 = degC + 50) until rail pressure FFF88884 has stayed at or above the rail target FFF8B9A0 minus cal 0x15194 (3279 counts, about 2 MPa) for cal 0x15196 (500) passes; then FFF8B014 ramps down by cal 0x15192 / 2 = 1 count (1/256 of fuel) per 20 ms pass (0x0CDD8C runs in the 20 ms task 0x0C73D0); the 500-pass hold is 10 s. It returns to the full table value whenever rail pressure drops below the threshold again (counter reset). FFF8B014 is added to FFF8B010 (see Running After-Start Enrichment 1). Unit 1/256 of fuel (inferred, same as FFF8B010). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open)
table.description:
Start-path enrichment by load and coolant with the TGVs open, blended with the TGV Closed table by TGV position. Raising it adds fuel during start-up.
Details: FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04, read): Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open) weighted by FFF8B3E8, Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) by 1 - FFF8B3E8 and Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier; B02C adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 used by fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Unit 1/256 of base fuel (inferred). Blend weight FFF8B3E8 is the TGV position weight from 0x10C948: average of the two TGV position sensors FFF88AA6/88AA8 through 05D29C/05D290, ramped (cal 0x379EC/0x379EE) and gated by FFF8A881 bit 4 and FFF88E2A bit 5 (read). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed)

Start-path enrichment by load and coolant with the TGVs closed, blended with the TGV Open table by TGV position and scaled by Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier.
Details: FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04, read): Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open) weighted by FFF8B3E8, Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) by 1 - FFF8B3E8 and Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier; B02C adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 used by fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Load) RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) by rpm (128 = x1.0); the TGV Open table is not scaled.
Details: Scales only Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Closed) (the part weighted by 1 - FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction) by this(rpm)/128 (0x0CEF04, read); Start Enrichment (Load, TGV Open) is not scaled. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment Additive (Load, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Extra start enrichment by load and coolant, added on top of Start Enrichment (Load) only while a start condition flag is set (depends on start coolant, pedal and speed; not fully decoded). TGVs closed side of a TGV blend.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A857 bit 7 is set (set by 0x10BF88 only when FFF8A852 = 2, the second-pulse share FFF8A85F = 0 and a computed quantity is below FFF8B088 + cal 0x2A3CC; cal 0x2996C bit 3, coolant, the pedal-released flag and vehicle speed only pick the share table used in that computation; meaning inferred). 0x0CF0F4 (read): FFF8B02E = 05AD58(load FFF8A616, coolant FFF88A44) x FFF8B3E8 + 05AD44 x (1 - FFF8B3E8) x 05AD6C(rpm)/128 (this table weighted by 1 - FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction); 0x0CEF04 adds FFF8B02E to Start Enrichment (Load) FFF8B02C under the same bit (read). FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04) adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 of fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Unit 1/256 of base fuel (inferred, as Start Enrichment (Load)). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Enrichment (Coolant Window Override)
table.description:
Replaces Start Enrichment (Load) for a while after start, but only when the start coolant falls inside a calibrated window.
Details: When used: only when coolant at start FFF88A46 lies within cal 0x11D24...0x11D26. 0x0CEF04 (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B02C = this(coolant FFF88A44) instead of the Start Enrichment (Load) blend until the accelerator has been pressed for cal 0x11D02 (40) passes within the first cal 0x11D00 (800) counts of FFF8B06A (passes since running); the output may move by at most cal 0x11D38 (65535 = unlimited) per pass. FFF8B02C (0x0CEF04) adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 of fuel modes 0 and 3 (0x0D1400, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: After-Start Enrichment RPM Multiplier
table.description:
Scales the largest of the three after-start enrichments by rpm (128 = x1.0) while cranking and running.
Details: Scales the largest of the three faded after-start enrichments (0x0CD834, read) when FFF8906B is 2 or 3. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: After-Start Enrichment Coolant Multiplier (Repeat Start)
table.description:
Computed after a repeat crank but never used by the fuel calculation, so editing it does nothing.
Details: 0x0CD834 (read): FFF843F3 = this(coolant FFF8CD65, deg C + 50) while FFF811A7 bit 7 (repeat-crank history, backup RAM) is set, else 128 (x1.0); copied out to FFF8A697, which no code reads (my disassembler finds only the two writers 0x0CD834 and the init 0x0CC6A4), so editing it has no effect. Confidence: read.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (First Start)
table.description:
Running-path after-start enrichment 1 by coolant for a first start (start type meaning inferred). The ECU uses the largest of the three terms, each faded by its decay table; cut at very high load. Also blocks long-term trim learning while active.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 0, in fuel states 2 (cranking) and 3 (running). Amount E1 (1/256 of fuel) for this start type, on coolant FFF88A44. 0x0CDD8C (read) builds FFF8B010: three amounts E1/E2/E3, each from a coolant table chosen by start type FFF8A6E7 (0 first start, 1 restart after key-off, 2 restart after stall, else special start; type and coolant FFF88A44 latched when fuel state 2/3 is entered (start of cranking, or a return from 3 to 2) for the amounts E1-E3, and latched again when fuel state 3 is entered (end of cranking) for the decay tables D1-D3), each faded linearly to zero over 8 x D passes of FFF8B06A (passes since fuel state 3, 0x0D1354) by its own decay table D1/D2/D3 (factor = clamp((8D - FFF8B06A) x 32 / D, 0, 255) / 256; no fade while cranking); FFF8B010 = max(E1, E2, E3) x 05AA60(rpm)/128 x FFF8A696/128 + Low Rail Pressure Start Enrichment, forced to 0 at load FFF8A616 >= cal 0x237C8 (255, hysteresis cal 0x237C9) and outside fuel states 2/3. FFF8B010 is summed with Warm-Up Enrichment FFF8B030 in the enrichment term of the fuel factor 0x0C558C (read), blocks long-term trim learning (0x0FFE40) and is read by the closed-loop controller 0x0FD76C. This is the running-path counterpart of After-Start Enrichment 1-3 (0x0CD834 -> FFF8B012, start path). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start History Reset Delay (Coolant)
table.description:
Time after ignition-off, by coolant, after which the ECU forgets the previous start, so the next start counts as a first start rather than a restart. Shorter with a weak battery.
Details: When used: 0x0D39DC with 0x0D3A74 (read; my research notes): after the ignition is switched off (FFF8A65A bit 5) a counter runs; when it reaches this(coolant FFF88A44) (or cal 0x13E5E = 50 while battery FFF88A7E < cal 0x13E60, 11.0 V) FFF8A65A bit 6 is set, which clears the start history FFF811A7 bits 2-5/7 and FFF81408 used for the restart start type FFF8A6E7. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel (Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description:
Cranking fuel pulse by coolant for a repeat attempt in the special start type.
Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC6 (0x0C9038, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 = 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C9038): FFF842C8 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x C535 x coolant multiplier x 64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125 (the 64 is fixed, folded into the constant 5.843592e-11; Cranking Fuel Secondary Low Rail Pressure Multiplier 05A1FC acts only on the secondary pulse in 0x0C8A28), and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel mode 0 or 3. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Coolant Multiplier (Unused Routine, Restart after Key-Off)
table.description:
Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its coolant axis is shared with the live coolant multipliers; edit that axis only there.
Details: Role in the routine: multiplier by coolant FFF8CD65 for start type FFF8A6E7 = 1 (0x0CD124, read). Unused in this ROM: third cranking-pulse routine 0x0CD124 (called once from 0x0C589C, read). Its outputs FFF8B000 / FFF8A67B / FFF8B002 / FFF8A67C have no reader (ram_xref: writers 0x0CC6A4 and 0x0CD124 only, no readers), and its statics FFF843B0..FFF843BC are read only by itself. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Stall Window, First Attempt)
table.description:
Post-start fade of cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, first attempt.
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear and s4 clear, FFF811A7 bit 7 clear. Indexed by FFF8CD67, coolant (degC + 50) held from start. 0x0C9038 (read): outside cranking (fuel state FFF8906B != 2) the normal cranking pulse is no longer recomputed; each pass FFF842D0 = previous value x this / 65536, so FFF8AFC6 decays geometrically from its last cranking value. FFF8AFC6 feeds injectors in fuel modes 0/3, where 10 x it is a floor on the quantity (0x0D168C). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. Argument mapping from the call at 0x0C6896 (my research notes, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Decay (Unused Routine)
table.description:
Belongs to a third cranking-fuel routine whose results nothing reads, so editing it has no effect. Its axis is shared with the start-type decay tables.
Details: Role in the routine: per-pass decay of the pulse after cranking by coolant at start FFF88A46 (0x0CD124, read). Unused in this ROM: third cranking-pulse routine 0x0CD124 (called once from 0x0C589C, read). Its outputs FFF8B000 / FFF8A67B / FFF8B002 / FFF8A67C have no reader (ram_xref: writers 0x0CC6A4 and 0x0CD124 only, no readers), and its statics FFF843B0..FFF843BC are read only by itself. Editing it has no effect. Axis 0x03836C is shared with the start-type decay tables. Confidence: read.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary (Repeat Attempt, Special Start)
table.description:
Secondary cranking fuel pulse for a repeat attempt in the special start type.
Coolant-indexed base of the cranking pulse FFF8AFC4 (0x0C8A28, read); used when flag s4 (= TGV-module flag FFF8A881 bit 2, read) set, s8 set, FFF8A6E7 = 3 (s8 = FFF811A7 bit 7, the repeat-crank history; argument mapping read from the calls at 0x0C589C). Cranking pulse (read, 0x0C8A28 / 0x0C9038): FFF842B4 = clamp(base x 256 x A67E x A687 x 842C4 x coolant multiplier x 05A1FC-or-64 / (2^32 x 255), 0, 524280) x 0.125, and the per-injector quantity is never below 10 x that (0x0D168C), in 0.8 us counts. Raw units: the factors' normalisation is not fully resolved, so change it proportionally. FFF8AFC4 feeds injectors in fuel mode 1 or 2. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Fuel Secondary Decay (Stall Window, First Attempt)
table.description:
Post-start fade of the secondary cranking fuel for a stall-window restart, first attempt.
Details: When used: cal 0x38448 bit 0 clear and s4 clear, FFF811A7 bit 7 clear. Indexed by FFF8CD67, coolant (degC + 50) held from start (copied from FFF8CD65 only while the engine state is 1 or a counter is below cal 0x56936, 0x06BA46, read; reading inferred). Argument mapping read from the call at 0x0C6918. 0x0C8A28 (read): outside cranking (fuel state FFF8906B != 2) the secondary cranking pulse is no longer recomputed; each pass FFF842BC = previous value x this / 65536, so FFF8AFC4 decays geometrically from its last cranking value. FFF8AFC4 feeds injectors in fuel modes 1/2, where 10 x it is a floor on the running quantity (0x0D168C, see Cranking Fuel Secondary). 65536 = no decay; smaller = faster fade. p16 (read): one pass = 10 ms (0x0C8A28 <- 0x0C589C <- 0x07C408 <- 10 ms OS task 0x1DFE3C), so the per-pass factor f gives f^100 per second. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Running After-Start Enrichment 1 (Special Start)

table.name: Injection Timing (Single Injection)
table.description:
Main injection angle in normal running (degrees BTDC of compression TDC, larger = earlier), by rpm and load, with one injection per cycle. Replaced by Injection Timing (High Pedal) at high pedal.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. Main injection angle FFF8B052 in running mode (FFF8906B = 3) after a start delay (counter FFF84480 >= cal 0x12008) (0x0CFE8C, read): this table, plus Injection Timing Additive x multiplier / 255 when the high-pedal latch FFF8A8A4 bit 6 is clear (with FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5 set: this table alone), clamped to 360..1079 code units (half degrees) (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (High Pedal)
table.description:
Injection angle used instead of Injection Timing (Single Injection) and its additive while the pedal is at 90 % or more (released below 85 %).
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. When used: replaces Injection Timing (Single Injection) + additive while FFF8A8A4 bit 6 is set, a high-pedal latch built like bit 7 (set at >= 90 % pedal, cleared below 85 %; 0x11C0C4 / 0x10F608, read), and only while FFF88E28 bit 2 and FFF88E2B bit 5 are clear (0x0CFE8C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing Additive
table.description:
Retard (degrees later) applied to Injection Timing (Single Injection), scaled by Injection Timing Additive Multiplier.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees LATER, i.e. subtracted from the degrees-BTDC of Injection Timing (Single Injection) after the multiplier/255 (0x0CFE8C, read). Added to the primary injection angle, scaled by Injection Timing Additive Multiplier / 255 (0x0CFE8C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing Additive Multiplier
table.description:
Scales Injection Timing Additive (255 = x1.0), by an unidentified input and intake air temperature.
Details: Scales Injection Timing Additive (0x0CFE8C, read). Inputs: FFF88A9D (rows, not identified) and FFF88662 (columns), intake air temperature + 50 degC (the OBD IAT source, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Injection Timing
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking and for the first 0.3 s of running, by rpm and coolant, but only when the engine is in normal combustion mode (fuel mode 1): after about 10 s of cranking, when the low-rail-pressure start latch is set, or on a re-crank before the start sequence reset. A normal start uses Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) instead.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC (display 720 - x/2; 0x0CFE8C clamps the code to 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC, read); larger = earlier. When used: 0x0CFE8C (read) writes this table into FFF8B052 while cranking (FFF8906B = 2) and for the first cal 0x12008 (30 passes, 0.3 s) after the engine is running. FFF8B052 is the injection angle only for injectors in fuel mode 1 (0x0CB394, read). A normal start cranks in combustion mode 0 = fuel mode 0 (init 0, 0x109B4C; 0x108B08, read), where the angle is FFF8B050 = Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) (05AF80, 0x0CFB28 / 0x0CB394, read), so this table does not set the normal cranking angle. It applies when the crank runs in combustion mode 4 / fuel mode 1: after about 10 s of continuous cranking (cal 0x29A32 = 1000 passes, 0x109B4C), when the low-rail-pressure start latch FFF8A856 bit 6 forces mode 4, or on a re-crank before the mode returned to 0 (read). Columns are coolant temperature FFF88A44 (passed by 0x0C589C, read; breakpoints -30..80 C). Replaced by Cranking Injection Timing (Stop-Start Restart) when FFF89066 bit 0 is set; a fixed cal 0x11FE6 overrides it when cal 0x38448 bit 6 is set. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0)
table.description:
Injection angle in the first phase after start, by rpm and coolant: a compression-stroke injection, probably for the stratified start. Kept within 0.5-180 BTDC.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. Clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0CFB28, read). Injections cannot start in the last 10 degrees before TDC: 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 BTDC (0x1DCA04, read). When used: fuel mode 0 (combustion mode 0, the first phase after start, 0x108B08). 0x0CFB28 (read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B050 = this(rpm/50 FFF8CD56, coolant FFF88A44) clamped to 1080...1439; else 0x636. In cranking with FFF89066 bit 0 set it is replaced by 05AF74/05AF68 (coolant) by rail pressure FFF88884 vs cal 0x2A65E; with cal 0x38448 bit 7 set the fixed cal 0x11EBC is used. 0x0CB394 and its three siblings (one per injector) use FFF8B050 - 1080 as the injection angle when that injector's fuel mode FFF8A858.. is 0 (read). p16 (read): FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN ID 0x15A byte 2 bit 0 (mailbox 15, decoder 0x085D20). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Double Injection Quantity Window Low
table.description:
Lower fuel-quantity limit for using two injections per cycle; with Double Injection Quantity Window High it defines when split injection is used.
Details: 0x0CF3EC (read): two injections (FFF8A69E = 2) are allowed while the quantity FFF8B07A x FFF8AFEA / 256 lies between this and Double Injection Quantity Window High (with hysteresis cal 0x17D54), and half of it plus latency still exceeds the minimum pulse plus cal 0x183B8. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Double Injection Quantity Window High
table.description:
Upper fuel-quantity limit for two injections per cycle.
Details: Upper edge of the two-injection quantity window (0x0CF3EC, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Quantity Window Low
table.description:
Lower fuel-quantity limit for using three injections per cycle.
Details: 0x0CF3EC (read): three injections (FFF8A69E = 3) are chosen first while the quantity lies between this and Triple Injection Quantity Window High, a third of it plus latency exceeds the minimum pulse plus cal 0x183BA, and an enable argument is set. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Quantity Window High
table.description:
Upper fuel-quantity limit for three injections per cycle.
Details: Upper edge of the three-injection quantity window (0x0CF3EC, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure below 2 MPa. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused. Not clamped by the ECU: keep it within 0.5-180 BTDC. Edit with the High Rail Pressure table.
Details: When used: while cranking (fuel state FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set and rail pressure FFF88884 below cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, called from 0x0C589C with (906B, coolant FFF88A44, rpm/50, cal 0x38448 bit 7, FFF89066 bit 0, FFF88884, &FFF8B050, &FFF8B008), args read in the caller's disassembly). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). It replaces Start Injection Angle (Fuel Mode 0) in FFF8B050, which 0x0CB394 uses as the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 0 (segment 3, offset B050 - 1080) (read). Unlike that table it is only floored at code 0, not clamped to 1080-1439, so keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439) (read). Setting cal 0x38448 bit 7 would force cal 0x11EBC (clamped to 1080-1439) instead. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). Edit with the High Rail Pressure table. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, High Rail Pressure)
table.description:
Injection angle while cranking for a stop-start restart with rail pressure at or above 2 MPa. Probably unused (stop-start cannot activate). Not clamped: keep within 0.5-180 BTDC.
Details: When used: as Start Injection Angle (Stop-Start Restart, Low Rail Pressure), but with rail pressure FFF88884 at or above cal 0x2A65E (3279 = 2.0 MPa / 290 psi) (0x0CFB28, read). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Only floored at code 0, not clamped (read): keep it within 180-0.5 BTDC (code 1080-1439). FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cranking Injection Timing (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description:
Replaces Cranking Injection Timing while cranking for a stop-start restart. Stop-start cannot activate in this calibration, so probably unused.
Details: When used: while cranking (FFF8906B = 2) with the stop-start restart request FFF89066 bit 0 set; then it replaces Cranking Injection Timing as the main injection angle FFF8B052 (0x0CFE8C, read; args read in 0x0C589C: param_5 = coolant FFF88A44, param_11 = FFF89066 bit 0). Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (720 - code/2; larger = earlier), same scale as every injection-angle table (my research notes). Clamped to code 360-1079 = 180.5-540 BTDC (read). Cal 0x38448 bit 6 would force cal 0x11FE6. FFF89066 bit 0 = CAN 0x15A byte 2 bit 0, the restart request of the engine stop-start feature (signals_rates_can.md, my research notes, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Triple Injection, 1st)
table.description:
Angle of the first pulse with three injections per cycle.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: First pulse with three injections per cycle (0x0CB394, read). Injection angle for FFF8B058 (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Triple Injection, 2nd)
table.description:
Angle of the second pulse with three injections per cycle.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Second pulse with three injections per cycle (0x0CB604, read). Injection angle for FFF8B05A (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Triple Injection, 3rd)
table.description:
Angle of the third pulse with three injections per cycle.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Third pulse with three injections per cycle, on the first-pulse channel in a later segment (0x0CB1E4, read). Injection angle for FFF8B05C (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 1
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (the third gets what the first two leave).
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6C9 -> FFF8A6D3, read); the third gets 128 minus the first two (0x0D0DC0). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Triple Injection Split 2
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the second of three injections.
Details: Share of the fuel in the second of three injections (0x0D06EC -> FFF8A6CA -> FFF8A6D4, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Spark Retard
table.description:
How far spark is retarded from base timing during cold-start catalyst heating, which heats the catalyst faster. The spark moves toward this target in steps.
Details: Spark target during catalyst heating: in running state (FFF8866C >= 3) FFF8A76C = min(selected base timing FFF8A645 - this(max(FFF8A64B, cal 0x1B8CC = 1) x 128), cal 0x1B83C = 60 degrees) (0x0DD4EC, read); before running it is cal 0x1B8CA (0). Units are base-timing units (0.5 degree). The ignition module then moves toward the target in steps (cal 0x1B894/0x1B895) within cal 0x1B896/0x1B897 limits (0x0DA51C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Spark Retard (Phase 2)
table.description:
Same as Catalyst Heating Spark Retard for the second catalyst-heating phase; its result also selects the phase 2 injection angles.
Details: FFF8A76B, the spark-linked value used in fuel mode 2 (FFF8A85C 1 and 3): in running state (FFF8866C >= 3) = min(base timing FFF8A645 - this(max(FFF8A64B, cal 0x1B8C8 = 1) x 128), cal 0x1B83C = 60 degrees); before running it is Spark Angle Before Running (Coolant) (05BA84) (0x0DD464, read). FFF8A76B is also the spark input of the Catalyst Heating Phase 2 injection-angle tables. Units 0.5 degree (base-timing units). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Injection Angle
table.description:
Injection angle during stratified catalyst heating, by rpm and spark target: a compression-stroke pulse that follows the retarded spark (inferred).
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. First pulse in catalyst-heating fuel mode 3; clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0D03C8, read), and 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 (0x1DCA04, read). the pulse sits at the late limit (10.5 BTDC) for spark at 2 BTDC or later (all ATDC catalyst-heating spark; spark axis in ign_raw half degrees, its unit inferred), is 70 BTDC at 4 BTDC spark, 130 at 6, and the 180 BTDC limit from 8 BTDC spark on. A compression-stroke pulse that follows the retarded spark (inferred). Catalyst-heating mode = FFF8A85C 2 (0x109B4C, read): it maps to fuel mode 3 (0x108B08), in which the ignition target is FFF8A76C (0x0DA51C, read) and the injection angle is FFF8B062 (0x0CB394, read). FFF8B062 = this(rpm, spark target FFF8A76C), clamped to 1080-1439 (0x0D03C8, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2
table.description:
Angle of the second (late, after top dead centre) pulse during stratified catalyst heating, by spark target; negative = after TDC.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC; negative = AFTER that TDC (expansion stroke). This angle is an offset in segment 0, the 180 degrees after firing TDC (0x0CB604 mode 3 uses it with segment 0; the pulse-fit check 0x075D84 places it B064 + 1440 after the first pulse B062, read), so it is shown as -offset/2: clamped to 0 to -179.5 (0x0D0468, read), and -170 to -179.5 act as -169.5 (0x1DCA04, read). Catalyst-heating mode = FFF8A85C 2 (0x109B4C, read): it maps to fuel mode 3 (0x108B08), in which the ignition target is FFF8A76C (0x0DA51C, read) and the injection angle is FFF8B062 (0x0CB394, read). FFF8B064 = this(FFF8A76C), clamped to 0-359 (0x0D0468, read); used for the second injection's angle by 0x0CB604 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Second Injection Share
table.description:
Share of fuel moved into the late second pulse during stratified catalyst heating (combustion mode 2). 0 = single injection.
Details: Share of the injection quantity given to the second pulse during stratified catalyst heating (combustion mode FFF8A85C 2 = fuel mode 3, 0x108B08, read). 0x10A6D8 copies this byte to FFF8A860 (read); 0x0D0A7C-0x0D0C14 copy A860 into the per-injector split FFF8A6D6...A6D9 when that injector's fuel mode FFF8A858...A85B is 3 and rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm) (read); 0x0D1FB8 gives the second pulse A6D6/256 of the quantity, and 0x0CB604 places it at Catalyst Heating Injection Angle 2 (read). The double/triple injection windows (0x0CF3EC) are a separate mechanism and play no part. Confidence: read.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Second-pulse injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and spark target; compression stroke, limited to 10.5-180 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. Second pulse of the phase 2 split; clamped to 0.5-180 BTDC (code 1080-1439, 0x0D023C, read), i.e. the compression stroke; 0.5-10 BTDC act as 10.5 (0x1DCA04, read). When used: Selected by FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) in 0x0D023C: this one while it is clear (read). Injection angle FFF8B060 from rpm and FFF8A76B (0x0D023C, read), the second-injection angle in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB604, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal)
table.description:
First-pulse (intake stroke) injection angle in catalyst-heating phase 2 and the start sequence, by rpm and coolant, limited to 180.5-360 BTDC. Used when the TGVs are not closed.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the injected cylinder's compression TDC (0 = firing TDC, 180 = intake BDC (start of compression), 360 = gas-exchange TDC, 540 = expansion BDC); larger = earlier. Same scale as every Injection Timing table. First pulse of the phase 2 split; clamped to 180.5-360 BTDC (code 720-1079, 0x0D00A8, read), i.e. the intake stroke. When used: while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear. 0x0D00A8 (called from 0x0C589C, args read): in fuel state FFF8906B 2/3, FFF8B05E = this(rpm FFF8CD54, coolant FFF88A44) + 05B068(rpm, load) x 05B090(FFF88A9D, IAT)/255 + 05B0E0(spark FFF8A76B, coolant), clamped 720..1079; under FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5 only this table; cal 0x38448 bit 5 (clear) would force cal 0x1208A. 0x0CB394 uses FFF8B05E - 720 as the injection angle of cylinders in injector mode 2 (fuel mode 2 = combustion modes 1 and 3, the catalyst-heating phase 2 / start sequence) (read). Axes 850-1600 rpm x coolant. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Rpm x load correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal); positive = later. TGVs not closed.
Details: When used: catalyst-heating phase 2 first pulse, while the TGVs are not forced closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 clear). 0x0D00A8 (called from 0x0C589C with (906B, cal 0x38448 bit 5, rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5, FFF88A9D, IAT FFF88662, coolant FFF88A44, spark target FFF8A76B, TGV closed FFF8A881 bit 4, &FFF8B05E), read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B05E = Base(rpm, coolant) + Base Adder(rpm, load) x multiplier(FFF88A9D, IAT)/255 + Base Spark Adder(spark, coolant), clamped to code 720-1079 (180.5-360 BTDC); with FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5 set only the Base is used (read). This table is the rpm x load adder, scaled by 05B090 (FFF88A9D x IAT)/255. Units (FU_UNITS): added to the code angle, so a positive value moves the pulse LATER (fewer degrees BTDC), x/2 degrees (fu_units_inj_delta_later). FFF8B05E is the first-pulse angle of injectors in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB394, segment 2, offset B05E - 720, read). Edit with Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base (TGV Normal). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Base Spark Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Correction by spark target and coolant to the phase 2 first-pulse angle, TGVs not closed; positive = later.
Details: When used: catalyst-heating phase 2 first pulse, TGVs not forced closed (0x0D00A8, read). 0x0D00A8 (called from 0x0C589C with (906B, cal 0x38448 bit 5, rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5, FFF88A9D, IAT FFF88662, coolant FFF88A44, spark target FFF8A76B, TGV closed FFF8A881 bit 4, &FFF8B05E), read): in fuel states 2/3 FFF8B05E = Base(rpm, coolant) + Base Adder(rpm, load) x multiplier(FFF88A9D, IAT)/255 + Base Spark Adder(spark, coolant), clamped to code 720-1079 (180.5-360 BTDC); with FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5 set only the Base is used (read). This table is the adder by spark target FFF8A76B (rows, ign_raw) and coolant FFF88A44 (columns); it is not scaled. Units (FU_UNITS): added to the code angle, so a positive value moves the pulse LATER (fewer degrees BTDC), x/2 degrees (fu_units_inj_delta_later). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle Adder (TGV Normal)
table.description:
Correction to Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal), the second pulse; positive = later. Edit with that table.
Details: When used: catalyst-heating phase 2 second pulse, TGVs not forced closed; scaled by 05B158/255. 0x0D023C (called from 0x0C589C with (906B, spark target FFF8A76B, rpm/50 FFF8CD56, cal 0x38448 bit 4, FFF88E28 bit 2, FFF88E2B bit 5, FFF88A9D, IAT FFF88662, rpm FFF8CD54, TGV closed FFF8A881 bit 4, &FFF8B060, &FFF8B00A), read): unless rpm > cal 0x1CBD8 (20480 = 4000 rpm), FFF8B060 = Phase 2 Injection Angle(rpm/50, spark) + this adder(rpm/50, spark) x multiplier(FFF88A9D, IAT)/255 (adder skipped while FFF88E28 bit 2 or FFF88E2B bit 5), clamped to code 1080-1439 (180-0.5 BTDC) in fuel states 2/3 (read). FFF8B060 is the second-pulse angle in fuel mode 2 (0x0CB604, segment 3, read). Units (FU_UNITS): added to the code angle, so a positive value moves the pulse LATER (fewer degrees BTDC), x/2 degrees (fu_units_inj_delta_later). Edit with Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Injection Angle (TGV Normal). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Split Injection Second Share (Idle)
table.description:
Share of fuel moved into the second (compression-stroke) pulse during the start / catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and coolant (0 = single injection). Used with the pedal released and the car stopped.
Details: When used: fuel mode 2, pedal released and stopped, FFF899D7 bit 0 clear. 0x10A604 (read) writes FFF8A85F = this at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8); 0 when FFF8A657 bit 7 or FFF8A857 bit 7, cal 0x2A340 (51) if cal 0x2996C bit 4 (clear). 0x0D0A7C-0x0D0C14 copy A85F into the per-injector split FFF8A6D6...A6D9 when that injector's fuel mode FFF8A858...A85B is 2 (combustion modes 1 and 3, 0x108B08) (read); the second pulse gets A6D6/256 of the quantity (0x0D1FB8) at the Catalyst Heating Phase 2 injection angle B060, and A6D6 = 0 means no second pulse (my research notes) (read). Selection: pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A389 (2 km/h) -> 05D1A0 (05D1C8 if FFF899D7 bit 0), otherwise 05D1B4 (read). The same data blocks are also read by 0x10BF88 through descriptors 05D224 / 05D238 / 05D24C, so one entry covers both. Confidence: read.

table.name: Start Split Injection Second Share
table.description:
Share of fuel moved into the second (compression-stroke) pulse during the start / catalyst-heating phase 2, by rpm and coolant (0 = single injection). Used with the pedal pressed or the car moving.
Details: When used: fuel mode 2, pedal applied or vehicle moving. 0x10A604 (read) writes FFF8A85F = this at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8); 0 when FFF8A657 bit 7 or FFF8A857 bit 7, cal 0x2A340 (51) if cal 0x2996C bit 4 (clear). 0x0D0A7C-0x0D0C14 copy A85F into the per-injector split FFF8A6D6...A6D9 when that injector's fuel mode FFF8A858...A85B is 2 (combustion modes 1 and 3, 0x108B08) (read); the second pulse gets A6D6/256 of the quantity (0x0D1FB8) at the Catalyst Heating Phase 2 injection angle B060, and A6D6 = 0 means no second pulse (my research notes) (read). Selection: pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A389 (2 km/h) -> 05D1A0 (05D1C8 if FFF899D7 bit 0), otherwise 05D1B4 (read). The same data blocks are also read by 0x10BF88 through descriptors 05D224 / 05D238 / 05D24C, so one entry covers both. Confidence: read.

table.name: Spark Angle Before Running (Coolant)
table.description:
Spark value assumed before the engine reaches running mode, used only to choose the catalyst-heating phase 2 injection angles; it is not the actual cranking spark.
Details: When used: 0x0DD464 (read): while the engine state FFF8866C < 3 (before running mode), FFF8A76B = this(coolant FFF88A44); in running mode it is base timing FFF8A645 - Catalyst Heating Spark Retard (Phase 2). FFF8A76B is the spark-angle input of the Catalyst Heating Phase 2 injection-angle tables (05B130/05B144, 05B0E0/05B0F4) (read). It is not the cranking spark itself (0x0D9E40 uses FFF8A751 in state 2, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch On)
table.description:
Coolant-based threshold of an internal counter at which catalyst-heating phase 2 ends and normal running starts, used while the neutral switch is on.
Details: When used: while FFF88ADA bit 6 is set; with the manual-transmission coding that bit follows FFF8A29E bit 5 = pin PH5 (active low), the neutral switch: the P0851/P0852 (Park/Neutral Switch Input Circuit Low/High) monitor 0x06F436 tests this bit (read, p16). Phase FFF8A85C 3 ends (mode 4, normal) when FFF8A64B reaches this(coolant) (0x109B4C, read); the partner table is Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch Off). drops to 64 at 90 C and above, so phase 2 ends sooner in neutral. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch Off)
table.description:
Coolant-based threshold of an internal counter at which catalyst-heating phase 2 ends and normal running starts, used in gear (neutral switch off).
Details: When used: while FFF88ADA bit 6 is clear (neutral switch FFF8A29E bit 5 / pin PH5 off, i.e. in gear; identity confirmed by the P0851/P0852 monitor 0x06F436, read, p16). Phase FFF8A85C 3 ends (mode 4, normal) when FFF8A64B reaches this(coolant) (0x109B4C, read). Partner of Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Exit Threshold (Neutral Switch On). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Phase 2 Maximum Time
table.description:
Longest time catalyst-heating phase 2 may last, by coolant.
Details: Phase FFF8A85C 3 also ends when its timer FFF853BA reaches this(coolant) (0x109B4C, read). The timer counts 10 ms passes of 0x109B4C (p16, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Maximum Time
table.description:
Longest time the stratified catalyst-heating phase may last.
Details: Phase FFF8A85C 2 (stratified heating) continues only while its timer FFF853B6 is below this (0x109B4C, read). p16 (read): timers FFF853B6/BA count 10 ms passes of 0x109B4C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Coolant Minimum
table.description:
Lowest coolant temperature at which stratified catalyst heating is allowed.
Details: Phase FFF8A85C 2 requires coolant FFF8CD65 >= this (0x109B4C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Coolant Maximum
table.description:
Highest coolant temperature at which stratified catalyst heating is allowed.
Details: Phase FFF8A85C 2 requires coolant FFF8CD65 <= this (0x109B4C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Rail Pressure Minimum
table.description:
Minimum rail pressure needed for stratified catalyst heating.
Details: Phase FFF8A85C 2 requires rail pressure FFF88884 >= this (0x109B4C, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Catalyst Heating Readiness Idle Stability Time
table.description:
How long the idle must be steady (pedal released, normal running) before the catalyst-heating readiness flag sets, by rpm change and rpm versus idle target. Its exact role after that is inferred.
Details: When used: combustion mode 4 with the pedal released (FFF88C64 bit 5), only because cal 0x2996C bit 2 is set (0x10AAB0, read). The readiness flag FFF8A856 bit 5 (0x10AAB0 -> abStack, read) additionally needs a pass counter FFF853E6 (reset whenever the conditions drop) to reach this(rpm change FFF8CEA6, rpm - idle target FFF8B236), i.e. the idle has to be steady for this many passes (disassembly 0x10AB72-0x10AB98: R5 = CEA6, R6 = CE9C - B236, read). The other readiness conditions are the coolant window of Catalyst Heating Coolant Minimum/Maximum shrunk by cal 0x29A5C and further cals (my research notes). A856 bit 5 is used by the mode logic 0x109B4C (with a timer from 05D170, 0x109AA8) (read); its exact role there (re-entry of the heating modes) is inferred. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Delay
table.description:
Delay between the closed-pedal decel fuel cut condition being met and cylinders starting to be cut, by coolant and rpm.
Details: When used: on the rising edge of the decel fuel cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0, 0x0BD684 (limit state, 10 ms module 0x0BE694; stack args checked at 0x0BF9F6..0x0BFA52: s20 = coolant FFF8CD65, s24 = rpm/50 FFF8CD56) looks this table up once and latches it; limit state FFF8A638 becomes 8 when bit 0 has stayed set for this many 10 ms passes (0 = at once; FFF8A620 bit 0 forces 0). Until then the torque cap is the plain torque estimate (state 1), so no cylinder is cut; from state 8 the staging of the Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time tables applies (0x0B9EF0, 0x0B9DC8, 0x0C1AC8, read). When bit 0 drops after state 8 the state goes to 9, which sets FFF8A774 bit 3 if cylinders were cut and starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0E1628, round 3). Rows = coolant (x - 50 C), columns = rpm (x 50) (lookup 0x1B0918: first argument = first axis = row, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Coolant)
table.description:
Added to the idle target to set the rpm at which the decel fuel cut ends (and, 200 rpm higher, where it starts), by coolant. Raising it probably ends the cut at a higher rpm.
Details: When used: always while running; looked up by coolant FFF88A44 (R5 = R6 at 0x0BA0AA, read). Resume threshold FFF8A62E (0x0BA044, 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; stack args checked at 0x0BEE90..0x0BEF52, read) = max(FFF8A62A, idle target FFF8B236/128 + sum of adders), clamped to 255, in 25 rpm units. Adders: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Coolant), 059638(coolant) below cal 0x1DB52 (15 km/h), max(A/C adder FFF8A628, cal-0x1DB56 term), and cal terms 0x1DB68 / 0x1DB69 / 0x1DB72 / 0x1DB73 / 0x1DB74 under further conditions. FFF8A62E is the rpm (FFF8CE9C/128) below which the decel fuel cut ends with the pedal still released; the cut starts above FFF8A62E x 25 + 200 rpm (cal 0x1DE1C; +1300 rpm for 3 s and then +800 rpm once the rpm has already fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, cals 0x1DE20 / 0x1DE24 / 0x1DE1E, 0x0BD4E0) (0x0C06F0, 0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC, read). Raising it ends the cut at a higher rpm (inferred effect). It also starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0DAFD4) and selects Decel Fuel Cut Recovery Timing Ramp (0x0DB21C). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Low Speed)
table.description:
Extra resume-rpm adder for the decel fuel cut below 15 km/h, by coolant. Raising it probably ends the cut at a higher rpm.
Details: When used: vehicle speed FFF88BE8 below cal 0x1DB52 (267 = 15 km/h); looked up by coolant FFF88A44 (0x0BA0C6..0x0BA0D2, read); 0 otherwise. Resume threshold FFF8A62E (0x0BA044, 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; stack args checked at 0x0BEE90..0x0BEF52, read) = max(FFF8A62A, idle target FFF8B236/128 + sum of adders), clamped to 255, in 25 rpm units. Adders: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Coolant), 059638(coolant) below cal 0x1DB52 (15 km/h), max(A/C adder FFF8A628, cal-0x1DB56 term), and cal terms 0x1DB68 / 0x1DB69 / 0x1DB72 / 0x1DB73 / 0x1DB74 under further conditions. FFF8A62E is the rpm (FFF8CE9C/128) below which the decel fuel cut ends with the pedal still released; the cut starts above FFF8A62E x 25 + 200 rpm (cal 0x1DE1C; +1300 rpm for 3 s and then +800 rpm once the rpm has already fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, cals 0x1DE20 / 0x1DE24 / 0x1DE1E, 0x0BD4E0) (0x0C06F0, 0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC, read). Raising it ends the cut at a higher rpm (inferred effect). It also starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0DAFD4) and selects Decel Fuel Cut Recovery Timing Ramp (0x0DB21C). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Gear 1, A/C Off)
table.description:
Decel fuel cut staging for gear 1 (and 0) with the A/C off (inferred): for each rpm band, the times after the cut starts at which 1, 2, 3 and all 4 cylinders are cut. Lower = faster, harsher cut. Values should rise along each row. Manual coding.
Details: When used: gear FFF88FCE = 1 (also gear 0) (MT coding) and FFF8A9A2 bit 7 clear (A/C not engaged, inferred; see the A/C On tables). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. Details: When used: gear FFF88FCE = 4 (MT coding) and FFF8A9A2 bit 7 set: the A/C engaged flag FFF8A9A2 bit 6 confirmed for cal 0x396F0 (2) passes above cal 0x396EE rpm (0 rpm), 0x122AC4 (read; A/C identity of bit 6 inferred, as in the existing A/C entries). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (A/C, Alternate)
table.description:
Alternate A/C resume-rpm adder for the decel fuel cut, by an unidentified CAN-derived value.
0x0BA044 uses this(FFF8A8C6) as the A/C adder FFF8A628 only while FFF8A9A2 bit 6 (A/C engaged) and cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 are set (stack args s8/s12 and the branch at 0x0BA110..0x0BA136, read). Cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 is the same switch as the other alternate A/C entries; FFF8A8C6 = cal 0x3555C x FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5)/100 (0x115F80, round 3; meaning not identified). Resume threshold FFF8A62E (0x0BA044, 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; stack args checked at 0x0BEE90..0x0BEF52, read) = max(FFF8A62A, idle target FFF8B236/128 + sum of adders), clamped to 255, in 25 rpm units. Adders: Decel Fuel Cut Resume RPM Adder (Coolant), 059638(coolant) below cal 0x1DB52 (15 km/h), max(A/C adder FFF8A628, cal-0x1DB56 term), and cal terms 0x1DB68 / 0x1DB69 / 0x1DB72 / 0x1DB73 / 0x1DB74 under further conditions. FFF8A62E is the rpm (FFF8CE9C/128) below which the decel fuel cut ends with the pedal still released; the cut starts above FFF8A62E x 25 + 200 rpm (cal 0x1DE1C; +1300 rpm for 3 s and then +800 rpm once the rpm has already fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, cals 0x1DE20 / 0x1DE24 / 0x1DE1E, 0x0BD4E0) (0x0C06F0, 0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC, read). Raising it ends the cut at a higher rpm (inferred effect). It also starts Decel Fuel Cut Resume Timing Retard (0x0DAFD4) and selects Decel Fuel Cut Recovery Timing Ramp (0x0DB21C). Confidence: read.

The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. table.name: Purge Rate Limit (Off-Idle)
table.description:
Maximum canister purge rate by learned vapour concentration, scaled by Purge Rate Limit Coolant Multiplier; less purge when the vapour is rich. Used with the pedal pressed.
Details: When used: accelerator not released (FFF886AB bit 5 clear) and FFF886FA bit 4 clear (0x0D4B40, read). Limit A6FD = this(learned concentration FFF8B0BE) x Purge Rate Limit Coolant Multiplier / 255; the purge-rate ramp A709 is capped at A6FD (0x0D6060) and the purge rate A70C = min(A709 x (1 - cut), capacity A70F) (0x0D615C, read). FFF886FA bit 4 forces cal 0x24869 (38 = 14.8 %) instead. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

A713 = this(battery FFF9DD61, vacuum FFF8CDFA); the valve duty is A713 + (100 % - A713) x Purge Valve Duty (0x0D6118, read), so this is the duty at which the valve starts to flow. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Learning Weight (Purge Rate)
table.description:
Weight by purge rate on how much each sample moves the learned vapour concentration (255 = x1.0).
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D63D8, read): the concentration sample FFF8B0B0 = 32768 + 256 x (256 - B09C) x w / purge rate A70C, where B09C is the averaged closed-loop correction (256 = none) and w is the product of this(purge rate A70C), Purge Learning Weight (Purge Flow) and Purge Learning Weight (Trim Deviation), each x/256 and skipped when 255. 0x0D715C then moves the learned concentration FFF81412 by half the sample offset in state 4. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Learning Weight (Purge Flow)
table.description:
Weight by purge flow on how much each sample moves the learned vapour concentration (255 = x1.0).
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D63D8, read): weight by target purge flow FFF8B0C0 on the concentration sample (see Purge Learning Weight (Purge Rate)); 255 = x1.0 (skipped). Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Learning Weight (Trim Deviation)
table.description:
Weight by the size of the closed-loop correction on the vapour concentration learning (255 = x1.0); a dead band so small trim noise does not move it.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D63D8, read; input checked in the disassembly at 0x0D646C: |256 - FFF8B09C| clamped to 255): weight by the size of the averaged closed-loop correction on the concentration sample; 255 = x1.0. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: read.

table.name: Purge Injector Minimum Pulse Margin
table.description:
Margin above Injector Minimum Pulse Width, by rail pressure: when an injector pulse comes this close to the minimum (or the fuel trim nears its lower limit) with rich purge vapour, the ECU cuts purge so fuel can still be metered.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D7504, read; rail pressure FFF88886 as stack argument checked in the disassembly). Flag FFF8A701 bit 6 is set when (any cylinder pulse FFF8CF3C[n] <= Injector Minimum Pulse Width/4 + this x 2.5, or the closed-loop correction FFF8B2F2 <= its lower limit FFF8B2FE + 5 %) while coolant FFF8CD65 >= cal 0x249B6 (35 C), purge duty A70A > 0 and learned concentration B0BE >= cal 0x26E34 (35328, the learning maximum). That flag raises the purge cut B0A0 by cal 0x37C32 (11.7 %) per pass off-idle (0x0D5D4C, read). Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Open)
table.description:
Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map for pedal pressed, EGR off and TGVs open, which covers wide-open throttle and high rpm. The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning.
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is pressed, EGR is off (FFF8A813 bit 7 clear) and the TGVs are not forced closed: the map for wide-open throttle and high rpm (EGR is not enabled there). Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 22x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 or FFF8A774 bit 0 is clear, and F1 and F2 clear (F1 = FFF8A813 bit 7 = EGR active, F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4 = TGVs closed). The result is rate-limited (cals 0x1058C / 0x1058E) and the IAT and coolant compensations FFF8A782 + FFF8A787 are added (0x0C2C08) to give base timing FFF8A645, which is the upper limit of the fired base timing, not a value fired as is: 0x0DD568 sets FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(max(FFF8A64B, 102) x 128) - tip-in retard, and FFF8A64B carries the request efficiency FFF8AF22 (0x0C13B4 / 0x0C39DC), so in effect FFF8A76A = min(FFF8A645, Primary Ignition request + KCA + FLKC) less any torque-reduction retard (Torque Reduction Spark Retard is the inverse of Ignition Efficiency vs Retard; min() form computed). FFF8A76A then goes through the rate limiter 0x0DD760, the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC and the retard terms) to FFF8A744 (read). The knock correction advance and FLKC are not added on top of this map: where Primary + KCA + FLKC is lower, raising this map changes nothing at the coil; where this map is lower it is the fired base and KCA / FLKC have no effect. In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A replaces FFF8A645 (read). The F2 selector is FFF8A881 bit 4, set by the TGV module 0x10CAE0 (0x10DEFC) - set = TGVs closed (see below). TGV polarity (read): 0x0D952C blends its Closed and Open ignition sets as Closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + Open x FFF8B3E8, so FFF8B3E8 is the TGV open fraction; 0x10C948 drives it toward 0 while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set, so that bit set = TGVs closed. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Off, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is off (or only a few percent) and the TGVs are closed (typically cold or light-load running). Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 22x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 or FFF8A774 bit 0 is clear, and F2 set, F1 clear (F1 = FFF8A813 bit 7 = EGR active, F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4 = TGVs closed). FFF8A76A then goes through the rate limiter 0x0DD760, the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC and the retard terms) to FFF8A744 (read). The knock correction advance and FLKC are not added on top of this map: where Primary + KCA + FLKC is lower, raising this map changes nothing at the coil; where this map is lower it is the fired base and KCA / FLKC have no effect. In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A replaces FFF8A645 (read). The F2 selector is FFF8A881 bit 4, set by the TGV module 0x10CAE0 (0x10DEFC) - set = TGVs closed (see below). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Active, TGV Open)
table.description:
Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is active and the TGVs are open (part-throttle cruising). The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus EGR advance, knock correction advance and fine learning, so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one. One of four base maps selected by EGR and TGV state.
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is pressed, EGR is active (FFF8A813 bit 7, see Base Timing (EGR Active, TGV Closed)) and the TGVs are not forced closed. Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 22x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 or FFF8A774 bit 0 is clear, and F1 set, F2 clear (F1 = FFF8A813 bit 7 = EGR active, F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4 = TGVs closed). In limit states FFF8A639 = 0x0B/0x0C/0x19/0x1A/0x1B the spark target FFF8A72A replaces FFF8A645 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing (EGR Active, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (upper-limit) ignition timing map used while the pedal is pressed, EGR is active and the TGVs are closed. The ECU fires the lower of this map and Primary Ignition plus knock correction advance and fine learning (then feedback knock correction and retards apply), so raising cells adds timing only where this map is the lower one. One of four base maps selected by EGR and TGV state; that the switching module is EGR is inferred.
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is pressed, EGR is active (FFF8A813 bit 7: commanded EGR FFF8A81A >= 19, off below 16; 0x0FB028, read; that the module is EGR is inferred from OBD PID 0x2C) and the TGVs are closed (FFF8A881 bit 4). Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 22x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 or FFF8A774 bit 0 is clear, and F1 and F2 set (F1 = FFF8A813 bit 7 = EGR active, F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4 = TGVs closed). FFF8A76A then goes through the rate limiter 0x0DD760, the base sum FFF8A74B (0x0DA600) and the fired sum 0x0D9E40 (FBKC and the retard terms) to FFF8A744 (read). The knock correction advance and FLKC are not added on top of this map: where Primary + KCA + FLKC is lower, raising this map changes nothing at the coil; where this map is lower it is the fired base and KCA / FLKC have no effect.
