table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, Mode 5)
table.description:
Main idle speed target by coolant in normal running; this is the table to edit to change idle speed on a manual car. Automatic/CVT cars use Mode 6 instead.
Details: When used: warm idle in normal running (the idle mode manual cars use). 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 5 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. This is the table to edit to change warm idle speed on a manual car (data at 0x024B10). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Warm idle speed target by coolant for automatic/CVT cars only; a manual car never uses this table.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding. With the manual coding the idle mode never becomes 6 (0x0F2BCC passes the mode through unchanged while FFF88ADA bit 7 is set, and 0x0F354C produces only modes 1-5 and 7, read), so on a manual car edit Mode 5. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 6 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Post-Start, Modes 1/2)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant right after a start (below 75 degC coolant) until the car moves or the engine warms to 50 degC, and while the engine is stopped. Raise for a higher fast-idle after cold starts.
Details: When used: idle mode 1 (engine stopped, or dropped out of the running state) and mode 2 (after a start with coolant below 75 C / 167 F, until the car moves or, once the warm-up flag FFF88EA2 bit 1 has cleared, coolant reaches 50 C / 122 F; held at least 200 time-since-start counts) (read, 0x0F354C). 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 1/2 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Start, Mode 3)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant after a hot restart (coolant at or above 75 degC at start), until the car moves. Raise for a higher idle right after hot starts.
Details: When used: idle mode 3, after a start with coolant at or above 75 C / 167 F (hot restart). Left only when the car moves (about 2 km/h), after at least 200 time-since-start counts; the coolant exit is disabled for these starts (05C7D4 = 65535) (read, 0x0F354C). Used on manual cars. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 3 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant once the car has driven off after a cold start but the engine is still warming up (until coolant is above about 75 degC); then idle returns to Mode 5. Used on manual cars.
Details: When used: idle mode 7, entered from mode 2/3 when the car moves (about 2 km/h) while the warm-up flag FFF88EA2 bit 1 is still set; back to mode 5 when the flag clears (coolant above 75 C / 167 F) (read, 0x0F354C). Used on manual cars after a cold-start drive-off. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 7 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7): idle speed by coolant once the car has moved off before the engine is warm. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 8 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (In Drive, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive with the brake on (pedal released, slow). Never used on a manual car (inferred).
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding, while the in-Drive idle condition FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant): automatic coding, neutral input clear, pedal released, slow) and afterwards until the in-Drive idle air reduction FFF8B160 has ramped back to its target. Never on a manual car (inferred from that chain). 0x0F2248 (read): when FFF8A7E4 bit 4 is set, B242 = this(coolant) << 6 (12.5 rpm per count) replaces the idle-mode target chain. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Minimum (Baro, Oil Temp)
table.description:
Floor on the idle speed target by barometric pressure and oil temperature; the ECU idles at no less than this.
Details: 0x0F2274 (read): one of the minimum idle-speed requests maxed into B246 (value << 6 = 12.5 rpm per count); skipped (0) while FFF88E2B bit5 is set. Inputs: barometric pressure FFF88668 (axis 50-120 kPa) and FFF88E26 = engine oil temperature (the FFF88E24 value that also feeds OBD PID 0x5C; 0x1731F0, read), axis 60-130 degC. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Post-Start Mode Exit Coolant
table.description:
Coolant temperature, by coolant at start, at which idle leaves the post-start mode for normal warm idle (it also leaves once the car moves).
Details: When used: idle modes 2/3 (post-start) in the idle mode state machine 0x0F354C (read). Once time since start FFF88A76 >= cal 0x24E92 (200 = 2 s; neither exit happens earlier), the mode goes to 5 (normal idle) when coolant FFF88A44 >= this(coolant at start FFF88A46) or when the vehicle moves (about 2-4 km/h); while the warm-up flag FFF88EA2 bit 1 is set it stays in 2/3 regardless of coolant and goes to mode 7 only once the vehicle moves (0x0F354C, read; my research notes). The 248 F cells for warm starts are the raw 65535 "disabled" value (120 C on this scale): warm starts leave the post-start mode only by driving off. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (Mode 1 to 2)
table.description:
How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 2 (cold post-start). Larger = quicker change towards the new idle target; smaller = a gentler fade.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Coolant FFF88A44 axis. Mode 1 -> 1 uses step 0. This table: mode 1 -> 2. p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. Confidence: read.

table.name: CAN Idle Speed Request (Alternate)
table.description:
Minimum idle speed requested by another module over CAN, by request code.
0x10EA40 (read; 20 ms task 0x1E0AE8 via 0x113060): while the network variant / frame gate holds (FFF88E0C bit 3 with FFF88621 = 1, bit 4 with FFF88618 = 1, or bit 7 with FFF88618 = 1) and FFF8A9A3 bit 0 is set, FFF8B3FA = this(CAN code FFF8A88A) for cal 0x35534 = 250 passes (5 s), then it falls by cal 0x35532 = 5 counts (1 rpm) per pass; 0 when FFF8A9A3 bit 0 clears. 0x10EB1C takes FFF854E2 = max(B3FA, a second request from FFF8A8D9 = CAN FFF88B90 + 26 scaled by cal 0x3555C, limited to cal 0x35556 = 1500 rpm), optionally remaps it through 05D3C0 / 05D3CC, and stores FFF8B3FC. FFF8B3FC's only reader is 0x0EE338, which passes it to the idle target module 0x0F2274 as stack argument 7 (disassembly at 0x0EF2E4, read); there min(B3FC, 0x1E00) >> 6 (12.5 rpm units) is maxed into a minimum idle-speed request only when param_1 = cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 and FFF8A9A2 bit 6 are both set (0x0F2826 reads @(158,R15) = param_11, read). Cal 0x1D0AE = 0, the same switch that keeps the alternate A/C idle air path and radiator-fan duty tables off. Unit: rpm x 5.12 (read from the >> 6 into 12.5 rpm units and the 0x1E00 = 1500 rpm cap). Confidence: read.

table.name: CAN Idle Speed Request Remap (Alternate)
table.description:
Remaps the CAN idle speed request before it is applied.
0x10EB1C (read, disassembly 0x10EC56-0x10EC7A): the combined request FFF854E2 (input) is passed through this table into FFF8B3FC when FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is set and FFF8A8A1 bit 7 is clear; with both set 05D3CC is used instead; with FFF8A7E2 bit 0 clear the request is stored unchanged; with FFF88B8E bit 0 (CAN 0x280) the output is cal 0x3555E (0). FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is always set on the manual coding (brief), so this is the table that would apply. Confidence: read.

table.name: CAN Idle Speed Request Remap (Flag Set, Alternate)
table.description:
Alternative remap of the CAN idle speed request, used when an unidentified CAN flag is set.
0x10EB1C (read): used instead of 05D3C0 when FFF8A8A1 bit 7 is also set; FFF8A8A1 bit 7 comes from CAN bits FFF88B95 bits 0/1 via 0x11BBB4 (read, meaning not identified). Input = combined request FFF854E2. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Mode 5)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant for normal warm idle (the warm-idle mode on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded open. At a settled warm idle the TGVs are normally commanded closed, so Idle Base Air (Mode 5, TGV Closed) is probably the table in use: change both together, and together with Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, Mode 5) so idle feedback does not have to learn the difference.
Details: When used: idle mode 5, normal idle (the warm-idle mode of a manual car). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant; the TGV-closed set is used while FFF8A881 bit4. Change with the idle speed target so the feedback need not learn the difference. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC (lookup 0x7414, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Mode 5, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant for normal warm idle while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, Mode 5) and Idle Base Air (Mode 5).
Details: When used: idle mode 5, normal idle (the warm-idle mode of a manual car). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant; this TGV-closed table is used while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set. Change with the idle speed target so the feedback need not learn the difference. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC (lookup 0x7414, read). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Initial)

table.name: Idle Air Altitude Factor (Key-On/Cranking)
table.description:
Multiplier on idle air by barometric pressure, used at key-on and while cranking. The two Running copies hold the same data: edit all three together.
Details: When used: only at key-on and while cranking (engine state 1/2); in running the copies Idle Air Altitude Factor (Running,...) 05C61C / 05C628 are used, so edit all three together (read, slice C). 0x0F19E0 -> FFF811D5, multiplies the idle air B1FE (cal 0x1D0BD bit7 = 1). 1.72 at 58 kPa -> 1.0 at 100 kPa. Copies 05C61C/05C628 hold the same data. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Altitude Factor (Running, A/C Off)
table.description:
Multiplier on idle air by barometric pressure while running with the A/C off.
Details: When used: engine running (FFF8906B not 1/2) and FFF8A7DF bit 5 clear. 0x0F19E0 / 0x0F088C (read): FFF811D5 = Idle Air Altitude Factor 05C610(baro FFF88668) while the engine state FFF8906B is 1 or 2 (key-on / cranking), otherwise 05C61C when FFF8A7DF bit 5 is clear and 05C628 when it is set. FFF811D5 multiplies the idle air B1FE. FFF8A7DF bit 5 is FFF8CDD2 bit 7 debounced by 0x0F40D4 (cals 0x34ED4/0x34ED5), and CDD2 bit 7 is a copy of FFF8A9A2 bit 6, the A/C-compressor-engaged flag (0x0B7712, read; A/C meaning inferred as in the A/C idle air tables). So this copy is used with the A/C off. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, Coolant)
table.description:
Idle air taken away, by coolant, while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive (pedal released, slow) to offset the load of the transmission. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (0x0F38D0, read): automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear) and the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 clear, accelerator released, speed FFF99835 within cals 0x2583F..0x25841, rpm below cal 0x25842 and below @025886(coolant), no speed-sensor/CAN faults; so never on a manual car (read). 0x0EAA40 (read): FFF8B162 = this(coolant) + Idle Air Reduction In Drive (RPM Error)(rpm - target rpm FFF8B236, coolant) + a ramp term (cals 0x25838..0x2583C), >= 0, capped by @025846(coolant); FFF8B160 follows it at cal 0x25834/0x25836 (86) per pass and is subtracted at half weight from the idle air FFF8B200 (0x0F0AF8, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, RPM Error)
table.description:
Correction to Idle Air Reduction In Drive by rpm error (actual minus target) and coolant, for automatic/CVT cars idling in Drive. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant) (automatic coding only). 0x0EAA40 (read): added to the coolant term with the rpm error FFF8CE9C - FFF8B236 (s16, rpm x 5.12) and coolant FFF88A44 as axes. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Minimum Idle Air (Moving in Gear)
table.description:
Floor on idle air by rpm (and coolant) whenever the car is moving in gear, so the throttle cannot close below it; acts mainly as a dashpot when the pedal is released (inferred). Raise to soften throttle closing on decel; lower for faster rpm drop. Not used at standstill or in neutral.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass of 0x0EE338 while running. 0x0ED5F8 (read; call order checked against 0x0EE338): B1DA = this(rpm/50 FFF8CD56, coolant FFF8CD65) x 256 (plus FFF8B19E x cal 0x250CB = 0). The floor candidate is this value while the vehicle moves (speed FFF99835 >= cal 0x250CA = 4 km/h) out of neutral; at standstill or in neutral it is 0 (or cal 0x2524E = 1536 with FFF88E2A bit 1 / FFF88E28 bit 0). While the accelerator is pressed and for cal 0x2525A (30 passes, 0.3 s) after release the floor is at least cal 0x250C8 (7127 in B1D4 units = 3563 as shown here); at -40 degC (CD65 <= 10) it is capped at cal 0x250C4 (2851 = 1426 as shown). The result rises by at most cal 0x250BE (1536 = 768 as shown) and falls by cal 0x250CC (831 = 416 as shown) per pass, becomes B1D4 = max(it, B1E0), and the idle-air minimum B1F6 = max(B1D4/2, cal 0x24EDC = 1280) (0x0EE318). So whenever the car moves in gear the idle air (and the idle throttle area) cannot fall below this, by rpm; it matters most with the accelerator released (decel dashpot, inferred), but with the pedal pressed it still sets the floor where it exceeds 3563 as shown (from about 1300 rpm cold, about 1500 rpm from 80 degC). Shown x128 = B1D4/2, the candidate for the idle-air minimum B1F6. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air
table.description:
Manual cars only: extra air, by how far rpm has dipped below a held reference, while pulling away from a standstill in gear with the pedal pressed. Raise to make launches from rest harder to stall.
Details: When used: manual coding, standstill in gear with the accelerator pressed (pulling away, inferred). Input B148 = rpm minus the held reference. 0x0EBD00 (read; called once per combustion event from 0x0F08B8, crank task, disassembly checked for the table inputs): on the manual coding (FFF88ADA bit 7) while the engine turns, at vehicle speed <= cal 0x25CD1 (5 km/h, +6 hysteresis), not in neutral (FFF88ADA bit 6) and with FFF88C64 bit 7 clear (accelerator not released, debounced; inferred), after cal 0x25CD6 (8) such events: B148 = rpm FFF8CEB4 - B192 (FFF8CEB4 = 96e6/(two segment periods) = rpm x 5.12, read). The anti-stall air B18C = max(B18C - cal 0x25CD8 (0), Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air(B148)); it falls by cal 0x25CDC (713) per event with neutral or the accelerator released, and by cal 0x25CDA (238) per event above the speed limit (read). B18C enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8), which also floors the throttle area while driving off (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Decay
table.description:
Manual cars only: how fast (by rpm) the reference rpm used by Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air falls per combustion event, so dips are measured from the recent peak.
Details: When used: as Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air, every combustion event. Input FFF8CE9C (rpm). The held reference rpm B192 falls by this per event (read), so a dip is measured from the recent peak. 0x0EBD00 (read; called once per combustion event from 0x0F08B8, crank task, disassembly checked for the table inputs): on the manual coding (FFF88ADA bit 7) while the engine turns, at vehicle speed <= cal 0x25CD1 (5 km/h, +6 hysteresis), not in neutral (FFF88ADA bit 6) and with FFF88C64 bit 7 clear (accelerator not released, debounced; inferred), after cal 0x25CD6 (8) such events: B148 = rpm FFF8CEB4 - B192 (FFF8CEB4 = 96e6/(two segment periods) = rpm x 5.12, read). The anti-stall air B18C = max(B18C - cal 0x25CD8 (0), Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air(B148)); it falls by cal 0x25CDC (713) per event with neutral or the accelerator released, and by cal 0x25CDA (238) per event above the speed limit (read). B18C enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8), which also floors the throttle area while driving off (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Offset
table.description:
Manual cars only: offset (by rpm) subtracted from the predicted reference rpm for Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air; a positive value probably means a dip must be larger before the anti-stall air reacts.
Details: When used: as Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air, once per combustion event (0x0EBD00, called from 0x0F08B8; axis FFF8CE9C confirmed in LF75404S_table_inputs, read). The held reference rpm B192 = max(B192 - Pull-Away Anti-Stall Reference Decay(rpm), previous rpm FFF8CEB4 + k x its last change FFF8CEBA / 51 - this(rpm)) (k = cal 0x25CDE 102 falling / 0x25CE0 1663 rising), and the dip B148 = rpm FFF8CEB4 - B192 indexes Pull-Away Anti-Stall Air (read). A positive value lowers the predicted reference, so a dip has to exceed it before the anti-stall air reacts (inferred from the arithmetic). Manual coding only (FFF88ADA bit 7), at standstill (<= cal 0x25CD1 = 5 km/h), not in neutral, accelerator not released. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Slowing)
table.description:
Extra idle air, by rpm change rate, to catch an rpm dip at idle once the drop is easing (pedal released, rpm at least 40 below target).
Details: When used: idle, accelerator released, rpm below target and FFF8B13A rising. 0x0EB9C4 (read; call 0x0EFA2A, stack arguments checked in the disassembly): active while FFF8A7E2 bit 3 is set, rpm FFF8CE9C is at least 40 rpm below the rate-limited idle target B196 (cals 0x25CBE/0x25CBC = -205/+205 hysteresis), not in neutral, at least cal 0x25CC8 (500 passes, 5 s) after start (FFF88A76), the accelerator released for cal 0x25CC6 (200 passes, 2 s), and FFF8A298 bit 3 / FFF8A7E3 bit 3 clear. Then B16A = this table, and the rpm-drop air B18E = max(B16A, B16C) with B16C from 05C2BC/05C2C8 (rpm error) (read); B18E enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). When inactive B18E falls by cal 0x25CC2 (2376) or 0x25CC4 (950) per pass. Selection: this table while FFF8B13A is higher than in the previous pass (the drop is slowing), Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Continuing) otherwise (0x0EBA5C-0x0EBA74, read). FFF8B13A = (previous + change of the filtered rpm FFF8B19A)/2, updated once per combustion event (0x0E9D80 <- 0x0F08B8, crank task, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Continuing)
table.description:
Extra idle air, by how fast rpm is falling, to catch an rpm dip at idle (pedal released, rpm at least 40 below target, at least 5 s after start). Used while the drop is not easing; see the Drop Slowing table.
Details: When used: idle, accelerator released, rpm below target and FFF8B13A not rising. 0x0EB9C4 (read; call 0x0EFA2A, stack arguments checked in the disassembly): active while FFF8A7E2 bit 3 is set, rpm FFF8CE9C is at least 40 rpm below the rate-limited idle target B196 (cals 0x25CBE/0x25CBC = -205/+205 hysteresis), not in neutral, at least cal 0x25CC8 (500 passes, 5 s) after start (FFF88A76), the accelerator released for cal 0x25CC6 (200 passes, 2 s), and FFF8A298 bit 3 / FFF8A7E3 bit 3 clear. Then B16A = this table, and the rpm-drop air B18E = max(B16A, B16C) with B16C from 05C2BC/05C2C8 (rpm error) (read); B18E enters the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). When inactive B18E falls by cal 0x25CC2 (2376) or 0x25CC4 (950) per pass. Selection: this table while FFF8B13A is not higher than in the previous pass (the drop is continuing); Idle RPM-Drop Recovery Air (Drop Slowing) while it is higher (0x0EBA5C-0x0EBA74, read). FFF8B13A = (previous + change of the filtered rpm FFF8B19A)/2, updated once per combustion event (0x0E9D80 <- 0x0F08B8, crank task, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward (AT/CVT, State 0/5)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward, used in two transmission states only: extra or less idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step.
Details: 0x0ECA08 (read; call 0x0ECA88/0x0ECA94 R5 checked): while FFF88A26 bit0 (idle, inferred), engine running (FFF88A27 bit0 clear) and FFF99835 below cal 0x259C8 (255, i.e. always), B1AE = this(new target - ramped target = B236 - B23C/4, capped at cal 0x259CA = 1000 rpm); B1AE enters the idle air at half weight. A positive step (target raised) adds air ahead of the ramp. Used when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is clear (bit0 = FFF8A7DD in 1..4 or 6, 0x0F38B0). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward
table.description:
Extra (or less) idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step, so rpm follows the new target without waiting for feedback. Positive steps add air. Used at idle on manual cars (and most automatic states).
Details: 0x0ECA08 (read; call 0x0ECA88/0x0ECA94 R5 checked): while FFF88A26 bit0 (idle, inferred), engine running (FFF88A27 bit0 clear) and FFF99835 below cal 0x259C8 (255, i.e. always), B1AE = this(new target - ramped target = B236 - B23C/4, capped at cal 0x259CA = 1000 rpm); B1AE enters the idle air at half weight. A positive step (target raised) adds air ahead of the ramp. Used when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is set (bit0 = FFF8A7DD in 1..4 or 6, 0x0F38B0). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Trim (Charging Command)
table.description:
Idle air trim by the alternator charging command. Probably compensates for lower alternator load.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass of 0x0EE338. 0x0EC640 (read): B1A2 = this(FFF8B718), summed into the idle air adder B19E (0x0EC09C) at half weight in the idle air (TE.md, read). FFF8B718 is the charging command of the 0x13xxxx charging module: B71E = 05E120(target charging voltage FFF8B6F4, mV inferred) clamped 167..1500 (0x138BB0, read; B718 = B71E because cal 0x57584 bit 4 is clear, 0x1373C8). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Electrical Load Idle Air Hold Release (Alternator Command)
table.description:
Flag table by alternator command that decides when the CAN load-value idle air adder (Idle Air Adder, CAN Load Value table) may increase while battery voltage is low.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass of 0x0EE338 while cal 0x57584 bit 6 is set (0x0ECBAC, read). A release flag (FFF84DC9) is set when this(alternator command FFF8B718) >= 10 and the received load word FFF8B458 >= 10, and cleared when B458 < 10. While it is clear and the filtered battery-sensor value (FFF89074 x 16/125 - 243200, filtered by cal 0x25A44; FFF89074 is a 24-bit received sensor value, 0x097xxx) is below cal 0x25A46 (12800, hysteresis 640), Idle Air Adder (CAN 0x370 Load Value) may not increase. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Adder (CAN 0x370 Load Value)
table.description:
Extra idle air by a load value received over CAN, probably electrical load (not confirmed), added to the accessory idle air.
Details: 0x0ECBAC (read): B1B2 = this(FFF8B458); increases are held off under a condition built from cal 0x57584 bit6, 05C3A0(FFF8B718) and a filtered value from FFF89074 (not decoded); B1B2 is part of the accessory-load air B1B0 (0x0ECAE0) that enters the idle air at half weight. FFF8B458 is a received word (FFF88BA4, zeroed when FFF88BA3 bit0; 0x114AD0, read); its meaning (electrical load, inferred) is not determined. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Adder (CAN 0x280 Stage)
table.description:
Extra idle air by a 3-bit stage value received over CAN, used only with one body coding. Possibly the radiator fan stage, but that is a guess.
Details: 0x0ECDF0 (read): while FFF88E2E bit6 is set, B1B4 = this(FFF8A8BF) if coding byte FFF811DC = 0x5A, or cal 0x25BDA (205) if FFF811DC = 0xA5, else 0; part of B1B0 (0x0ECAE0, capped with the other accessory adders at cal 0x25A02 = 4228) and added at half weight. FFF8A8BF is a 3-bit received value (0x114760); FFF88E2E bit6 follows FFF8A8A0 bit0 or input FFF88BC6 bit4 by coding (0x080532). Radiator-fan stage is a guess (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air from Throttle Area (Torque Request)
table.description:
Converts a throttle area back into idle air units when another module requests torque over CAN. Area is in mm^2 of effective throttle opening (about 2,150 mm^2 wide open).
Details: When used: every pass of the idle air output 0x0F0B8C (read). B132 = Throttle Required Area-shaped table 05C47C(rpm CD54, ratio of the CAN torque request FFF8B470 to FFF8AF64); B204 = min(this(B132), cal 0x25BB0 = 65535); when FFF8A89F bit 2 (torque request active) and B204 > B1FE, the idle air request B202 becomes B204 (0x0F0B8C, read; my research notes 1.1). It converts a throttle area back into idle-air units, so if 0594F0 is edited this table must be edited to stay its inverse (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4)
table.description:
Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4 with the TGVs commanded closed.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart)
table.description:
Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart, by start type and coolant. the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.
Details: 0x0F1270 (read; args per call in module 0x0EE338): post-start idle air B20E = max(start air, staged air 05C49C family), added to the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). TGVs not forced closed. Selected instead of the cranking value only inside the engine stop-start restart window (FFF89053 bit3/bit4 with the FFF88ADA bit3 edge, before the decay delay), by start type FFF8A6E8 (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1270 runs every 10 ms; its pass counter FFF84E42 counts 10 ms passes and the decay/ramp steps apply every 4th pass (40 ms). Confidence: read.

table.name: Post-Start Idle Air (Stop-Start Restart, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Post-start idle air for an automatic stop-start restart with the TGVs closed. the stop-start feature appears unable to activate in this calibration.
Details: 0x0F1270 (read; args per call in module 0x0EE338): post-start idle air B20E = max(start air, staged air 05C49C family), added to the idle air at half weight (0x0F0AF8). TGVs closed (FFF8A881 bit4). Selected instead of the cranking value only inside the engine stop-start restart window (FFF89053 bit3/bit4 with the FFF88ADA bit3 edge, before the decay delay), by start type FFF8A6E8 (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1270 runs every 10 ms; its pass counter FFF84E42 counts 10 ms passes and the decay/ramp steps apply every 4th pass (40 ms). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air (Alternate, Target RPM)
table.description:
A/C idle air by an unidentified CAN load value and idle target rpm, for an alternate A/C idle-air path.
Details: When used: with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set and cal 0x23CE9 bit 0 clear: A/C idle air FFF8B1A0 = max(this(FFF8A8C6, idle target FFF8B236), kick, cal 0x3539A = 712) while FFF8A9A3 bit 0 (0x0EC10C, read). 2376 base-air units, rising with FFF8A8C6. Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). Row input FFF8A8C6 = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air (Alternate, Engine Speed)
table.description:
A/C idle air by an unidentified CAN load value and engine speed, for an alternate A/C idle-air path.
Details: When used: with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set and cal 0x23CE9 bit 0 set: A/C idle air FFF8B1A0 = max(this(FFF8A8C6, engine speed FFF8CE9C filtered by cal 0x353C2 while A/C is on), kick, cal 0x3539A) (0x0EC10C; column input checked in the disassembly at 0x0EC200..0x0EC21A, read). Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). Row input FFF8A8C6 = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air Initial Kick (Alternate)
table.description:
Initial A/C idle air kick by an unidentified CAN code, for an alternate A/C idle-air path.
Details: When used: with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set, while FFF8A9A3 bit 0 is set and the time since it was set is below A/C Idle Air Kick Duration: kick = this(FFF8A88A), afterwards the kick falls by cal 0x3539C (23) per 10 ms (0x0EC10C, read). FFF8A88A is a 0..6 code from received bits FFF88B8D 5-7 (CAN 0x280 byte 4 bits 5-7; 0x10E8C4 / 0x10E9C0, read; meaning not identified). Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). The sibling 2D tables' row input FFF8A8C6 (not used by this table) = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Idle Air Kick Duration (Alternate)
table.description:
How long the alternate A/C idle air kick is held, by an unidentified CAN code.
Details: When used: with cal 0x1D0AE bit 0 set: the A/C idle-air kick (A/C Idle Air Initial Kick (Alternate)) is held while the 10 ms pass count since FFF8A9A3 bit 0 was set is below this(FFF8A88A) (0x0EC10C, read); FFF8A88A is a 0..6 code from received bits FFF88B8D 5-7 (CAN 0x280 byte 4; meaning not identified). Alternate A/C idle-air path of 0x0EC10C (10 ms idle module 0x0EE338; call checked in the disassembly). The sibling 2D tables' row input FFF8A8C6 (not used by this table) = cal 0x3555C (121) x received byte FFF88B91 (CAN 0x280 byte 5) / 100, capped at cal 0x35A84 (128), or cal 0x35A85 when FFF88B8E bit 0 (0x115F80, read); filtered by cal 0x353C1 while A/C (A9A3 bit 0) is on. Its physical meaning is not identified (A/C load related, inferred). Confidence: read.

table.name: Low Voltage Idle Request Threshold (Alternator Command)
table.description:
Battery voltage threshold, by alternator command, for a low-voltage idle-up request. Unused in this ROM: its result is never read, so editing it has no effect.
Details: Unused in this ROM: 0x0F2274 (read; stack arguments checked against the push order at 0x0EF0FE..0x0EF110) compares module voltage FFF88A7E with this(alternator command FFF8B718) when cal 0x57584 bit 6 is set (else with cal 0x34EE0 = 12.0 V), while time since start FFF88A76 >= cal 0x34EE6 (10 s). Low for cal 0x34EE8 (15 s) gives cal 0x34EE2 (67), recovered after cal 0x34EE4 (300 s); the result goes only to FFF8A7F4, which nothing reads (ram_xref: one writer, no reader; its address appears only in the init 0x0ED850 and in this call). Editing it has no effect. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Feedback Map (Target MAP Offset)
table.description:
Probably the main idle speed feedback map: how much the target manifold pressure (air) is raised or cut, by rpm error from the idle target and how fast rpm is changing. Positive = more air. Larger values give a stronger correction but risk hunting. Only active while idle feedback is on.
Details: 0x0EB030 (call 0x0EB338, R5 = FFF8CEA6, R6 = rpm error; read): B144 = this(rpm change per pass FFF8CEA6, rpm error e = filtered rpm FFF8C57C - idle target FFF8B236); target MAP B24A = filtered MAP + B144/4 - 0x2000, clamped by cals 0x25346/0x25348. The velocity-form PI then drives intake flow (MAP x rpm) and MAP toward this target (0x0EB030/0x0EAE10/0x0EB710, read). Positive = more air. Acts as the idle feedback gain map (inferred). Only active while idle feedback is on (FFF8A7E0 bits 2/4). p16 (read): the rpm-rate axis FFF8CEA6 is updated once per combustion event (0x07EF16, crank-synchronous, 180 deg CA); the feedback 0x0EB030 runs every 10 ms. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Feedback RPM Error Factor (Above Target)
table.description:
Scales the rpm error used by the idle feedback when rpm is above the idle target. Lower values make the feedback react less to overshoot.
Details: 0x0EB030 (call 0x0EB14C, R5 = e; read): for e = filtered rpm - target >= 0, g = this(e); for e < 0, g = cal 0x25320 (2028) or cal 0x25322 (1843) below -200 rpm (cal 0x25324). The shaped speed B224 = target + g x e/2048 feeds the proportional (flow) term; above target + 1200 rpm (cal 0x2525D x 64) B224 = rpm - cal 0x2531E instead. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Feedback Gain Multiplier (Time in Feedback)
table.description:
Multiplier on both idle feedback gains by how long idle feedback has been running with rpm near target.
Details: 0x0EA8EC (read): idle feedback gain B15E (4096 = 1.0, multiplies both P and I in 0x0EB030) = this(FFF8B256) when FFF8A7DB is not 1/2/3 (A7DB = 1 -> @0252F0(coolant), 2/3 -> @025C1C(coolant)). B256 counts consecutive feedback passes with |rpm - target| within 05C7C8 (80 x 64 = 1000 rpm) (0x0F33CC, read). p16 (read): FFF8B256 counts 10 ms passes (0x0F33CC in module 0x0EE338). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Torque Feedback P
table.description:
Torque correction (ft-lb) for idle speed by idle target and rpm error (positive = engine too slow), used when idle is held by torque control (inferred), within about 500 rpm of the idle target.
Details: When used: idle limit state FFF8A638 = 2. Torque correction by idle target rpm FFF8B236 (rows) and rpm error = target - filtered rpm FFF88E3A (columns; positive = engine too slow). 0x0BA4F8 (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694 with (idle target FFF8B236, filtered rpm FFF88E3A, predicted air torque FFF8AF40, loss torque FFF8AF62, rpm FFF8CD54, vehicle speed FFF88BE8, cal 0x23704 bit 7, rpm FFF8CE9C, FFF8A64C bit 7, FFF8AF3E), read): P = Feedback P(B236, B236 - 88E3A) -> FFF8AE6E (negative part kept only while vehicle speed FFF88BE8 <= cal 0x1DCA6 (142, about 8 km/h; hysteresis 36), otherwise floored at 0 ft-lb); D = Feedback D(B236, CD54 change over 2 passes = 20 ms) -> FFF8AE70; FFF8AE62 = (P + D) x gain + (AF40 - AF62). AE62 is chosen as the torque cap FFF8AE54 by 0x0B9DC8 when the limit state FFF8A638 = 2 (read); 0x0BD684 sets state 2 while running with rpm FFF8CD62 at most about 500 rpm above the idle target B236 and its other flags clear (read), i.e. idle speed control by torque (inferred). Torque unit Nm = x/80 - 200 (16000 = 0 ft-lb). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Torque Feedback D
table.description:
Torque correction (ft-lb) for idle speed by idle target and how fast rpm changed over the last 20 ms; damps rpm swings when idle is held by torque control (inferred), within about 500 rpm of the idle target.
Details: When used: idle limit state FFF8A638 = 2. Torque correction by idle target rpm FFF8B236 (rows) and the rpm change over the last 20 ms (FFF8CD54 now - two passes ago, columns; R6 at the JSR 0x0BA696 read in the disassembly). 0x0BA4F8 (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694 with (idle target FFF8B236, filtered rpm FFF88E3A, predicted air torque FFF8AF40, loss torque FFF8AF62, rpm FFF8CD54, vehicle speed FFF88BE8, cal 0x23704 bit 7, rpm FFF8CE9C, FFF8A64C bit 7, FFF8AF3E), read): P = Feedback P(B236, B236 - 88E3A) -> FFF8AE6E (negative part kept only while vehicle speed FFF88BE8 <= cal 0x1DCA6 (142, about 8 km/h; hysteresis 36), otherwise floored at 0 ft-lb); D = Feedback D(B236, CD54 change over 2 passes = 20 ms) -> FFF8AE70; FFF8AE62 = (P + D) x gain + (AF40 - AF62). AE62 is chosen as the torque cap FFF8AE54 by 0x0B9DC8 when the limit state FFF8A638 = 2 (read); 0x0BD684 sets state 2 while running with rpm FFF8CD62 at most about 500 rpm above the idle target B236 and its other flags clear (read), i.e. idle speed control by torque (inferred). Torque unit Nm = x/80 - 200 (16000 = 0 ft-lb). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Torque Feedback Reference Torque
table.description:
Reference torque by rpm that scales the idle torque feedback (P and D): a larger value gives a smaller correction. Must not be set to 0 ft-lb, which zeroes the feedback.
Details: When used: idle limit state FFF8A638 = 2. Reference torque by rpm FFF8CE9C that normalises the feedback gain: gain = (predicted air torque AF40 - 16000)/(this - 16000) (read), so a larger value gives a smaller P+D correction. 16000 (0 ft-lb) would zero the gain. 0x0BA4F8 (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694 with (idle target FFF8B236, filtered rpm FFF88E3A, predicted air torque FFF8AF40, loss torque FFF8AF62, rpm FFF8CD54, vehicle speed FFF88BE8, cal 0x23704 bit 7, rpm FFF8CE9C, FFF8A64C bit 7, FFF8AF3E), read): P = Feedback P(B236, B236 - 88E3A) -> FFF8AE6E (negative part kept only while vehicle speed FFF88BE8 <= cal 0x1DCA6 (142, about 8 km/h; hysteresis 36), otherwise floored at 0 ft-lb); D = Feedback D(B236, CD54 change over 2 passes = 20 ms) -> FFF8AE70; FFF8AE62 = (P + D) x gain + (AF40 - AF62). AE62 is chosen as the torque cap FFF8AE54 by 0x0B9DC8 when the limit state FFF8A638 = 2 (read); 0x0BD684 sets state 2 while running with rpm FFF8CD62 at most about 500 rpm above the idle target B236 and its other flags clear (read), i.e. idle speed control by torque (inferred). Torque unit Nm = x/80 - 200 (16000 = 0 ft-lb). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Feedback Carry-Over Decay (Positive)
table.description:
How fast the idle feedback air kept when leaving idle is bled off, by rpm change rate; this acts like a dashpot (inferred). Larger = faster release.
Details: When used: every 10 ms pass while running and the carry-over FFF8B174 is positive. Input FFF8CEA6 (smoothed rpm change per combustion event). 0x0EAC1C (read; called from the 10 ms idle module 0x0EE338 with FFF8906B, B180, A7E0 bit 4, FFF8CEA6, FFF88A3C): in the pass where idle speed feedback switches off (FFF8A7E0 bit 4 falls), the feedback air B180 is added to the carry-over FFF8B174 (clamped -2375..4751 by cals 0x25730/0x25732) and copied to B178. B174 then enters the idle air at half weight next to B180 (B1FE = (2 x B200 + B180 + B174) x F/64, 0x0F0A90) and decays every pass: a positive carry-over falls by Idle Feedback Carry-Over Decay (Positive) and may not exceed B178 x Idle Feedback Carry-Over Limit (Positive)/255; a negative one rises by the (Negative) decay and may not go below B178 x the (Negative) limit/255 (read). So the air the feedback had added when the driver leaves idle is kept and released gradually (dashpot-like, inferred). Engine state 3 only. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: AT/CVT codings, standstill in gear. Input FFF88A44 (coolant, read in the disassembly by the same R5). 0x0EC7A4 (read; called from 0x0EE338 with FFF886AB bit 7, neutral FFF88ADA bit 6, CAN fault FFF88E2B bit 1, FFF8A7E2 bit 1, FFF8B140, coolant FFF88A44, time since start FFF88A76, speed FFF99835): on the manual coding FFF8A7DD is always 1, so these tables are AT/CVT only. FFF8B140 = engine rpm FFF8CD54 - FFF888AC x 128/25 (0x0E9EE8, read); FFF888AC comes from the TCM frame 0x148 (signals_rates_can.md, read), so B140 is the torque-converter slip in rpm (inferred). State 4 (stopped in gear) needs slip >= Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear) (hysteresis cal 0x25648), state 6 (neutral/park) needs slip > Idle Converter Slip Threshold (Neutral) (hysteresis cal 0x25646) and FFF88A76 > cal 0x25642 (read). FFF8A7DD selects the idle table sets named "(AT/CVT, State...)" through FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (0x0F38B0). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Learn Filter Gain (Before First Transfer)
table.description:
Long-term idle learning speed used after an idle-learn reset until the first learned value has been stored.
Details: 0x0ED288 (read; R5 = FFF8145E for all three lookups, checked in the disassembly): long-term idle learn filter FFF8145C += (B1C6 slot learning + B1D0 + offset - FFF8145C) x this/65536, while learning is on (FFF8A7E0 bit5). Axis FFF8145E = learn passes since the last transfer (0x0ED46C; reset when 0x0ED3E0 transfers at the end of a drive: FFF8145A steps -95/+166 when FFF8145C passes -238/+238). Used while FFF811D4 bit0 is clear (set by the first transfer, cleared by the idle-learn reset 0x0EA984). p16 (read): 0x0ED288 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338); the gain is per 10 ms pass and the axis is shown in seconds of learning since the last transfer (1 pass = 0.01 s). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Learn Filter Gain (A/C Off)
table.description:
How fast the long-term idle air learning follows the current correction with the A/C off, by time since the last learning transfer. Larger = learns faster but less stable.
Details: 0x0ED288 (read; R5 = FFF8145E for all three lookups, checked in the disassembly): long-term idle learn filter FFF8145C += (B1C6 slot learning + B1D0 + offset - FFF8145C) x this/65536, while learning is on (FFF8A7E0 bit5). Axis FFF8145E = learn passes since the last transfer (0x0ED46C; reset when 0x0ED3E0 transfers at the end of a drive: FFF8145A steps -95/+166 when FFF8145C passes -238/+238). Used when FFF811D4 bit0 is set and FFF8A9A2 bit6 (A/C, inferred) is clear. p16 (read): 0x0ED288 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338); the gain is per 10 ms pass and the axis is shown in seconds of learning since the last transfer (1 pass = 0.01 s). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Learn Filter Gain (A/C On)
table.description:
How fast the long-term idle air learning follows the current correction with the A/C on, by time since the last learning transfer. Larger = learns faster but less stable.
Details: 0x0ED288 (read; R5 = FFF8145E for all three lookups, checked in the disassembly): long-term idle learn filter FFF8145C += (B1C6 slot learning + B1D0 + offset - FFF8145C) x this/65536, while learning is on (FFF8A7E0 bit5). Axis FFF8145E = learn passes since the last transfer (0x0ED46C; reset when 0x0ED3E0 transfers at the end of a drive: FFF8145A steps -95/+166 when FFF8145C passes -238/+238). Used when FFF811D4 bit0 is set and FFF8A9A2 bit6 (A/C, inferred) is set. p16 (read): 0x0ED288 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338); the gain is per 10 ms pass and the axis is shown in seconds of learning since the last transfer (1 pass = 0.01 s). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Learn Bias Index Step
table.description:
How the drive-history index for Idle Learn Bias moves every 2 s, by vehicle speed (only with coolant at or above 80 degC).
Details: When used: every 2 s while running with coolant at or above 80 degC. 0x0ED4BC (read; called from 0x0EE338 with coolant FFF88A44 and vehicle speed FFF99835): every cal 0x25ADC (200) passes (2 s) the drive-history index FFF8B1D2 is updated: below 50 km/h (cal 0x25AEA) it moves by Idle Learn Bias Index Step(speed); from 50 km/h it becomes max(index, cal 0x25AE6 = 1000) + step; it is held at 1000 while coolant is below cal 0x25ADA (80 degC, unsigned compare read in the disassembly) and limited to 0..cal 0x25AE8 (1700). B1D0 = Idle Learn Bias(B1D2) (input register checked at 0x0ED586) is added to the target of the long-term idle learning filter 8145C = filter(B1C6 + B1D0 + offset) in 0x0ED288, which steps the learned idle air FFF8145A (half weight in the idle air, TE.md) (read). So long idling lowers, and sustained driving raises, the learned idle air (purpose, e.g. heat soak, inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Learn Bias
table.description:
Offset added to the long-term idle air learning by a drive-history index: long idling pushes the learned idle air down, sustained driving pushes it up (purpose, e.g. heat soak, inferred). Index movement is set by Idle Learn Bias Index Step.
Details: When used: every 2 s update; enters the long-term idle learning target continuously. 0x0ED4BC (read; called from 0x0EE338 with coolant FFF88A44 and vehicle speed FFF99835): every cal 0x25ADC (200) passes (2 s) the drive-history index FFF8B1D2 is updated: below 50 km/h (cal 0x25AEA) it moves by Idle Learn Bias Index Step(speed); from 50 km/h it becomes max(index, cal 0x25AE6 = 1000) + step; it is held at 1000 while coolant is below cal 0x25ADA (80 degC, unsigned compare read in the disassembly) and limited to 0..cal 0x25AE8 (1700). B1D0 = Idle Learn Bias(B1D2) (input register checked at 0x0ED586) is added to the target of the long-term idle learning filter 8145C = filter(B1C6 + B1D0 + offset) in 0x0ED288, which steps the learned idle air FFF8145A (half weight in the idle air, TE.md) (read). So long idling lowers, and sustained driving raises, the learned idle air (purpose, e.g. heat soak, inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Open)
table.description:
Main EGR rate target (% of intake charge, probably external EGR) by rpm and load while the TGVs are open. 0 = no EGR. Capped by EGR Target Rate Maximum.
Details: When used: TGVs not closed and single injection; cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear. Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Main EGR rate target (% of intake charge, probably external EGR) by rpm and load while the TGVs are closed. 0 = no EGR. Raising it adds more exhaust gas at light load. Capped by EGR Target Rate Maximum.
Details: When used: TGVs closed and single injection; cal 0x2F797 bit 5 clear. Base target EGR rate A818, looked up by 0x0FA10C with rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616 (read, disassembly). Target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read): FFF8A81A = base A817 x Coolant Multiplier 05CB04/255 x 255/255 (A816) x Reduction Multiplier A81C/255 x DAM Multiplier 05CB10/128, x 640 (1/640 units), capped at cal 0x2C4E6 (192 = 30 %) and forced to 0 unless the enable conditions FFF8A811 bit 0 hold (0x0FAAFC). A817 follows the base table A818 (0x0FA068). TGVs closed = FFF8A881 bit 4 set (read: 0x10C948 drives the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 to 0 while the bit is set). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). 0 = no EGR. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Maximum
table.description:
Hard cap on the target EGR rate.
Details: Cap on the target EGR rate FFF8A81A (0x0FA260 and 0x0F9CB8, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Coolant Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (255 = 1.0) by coolant on the target EGR rate.
Details: Multiplier on the target EGR rate (0x0FA260, coolant FFF88A44, read), 255 = x1.0. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate DAM Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (128 = 1.0) on the target EGR rate by the knock learning value (probably DAM).
Details: Multiplier on the target EGR rate (0x0FA260, read), indexed by FFF811AE (DAM x 16, inferred), 128 = x1.0. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Target Rate Reduction Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (255 = 1.0) by rpm and load that reduces the target EGR rate while an unidentified module requests it and EGR flow is present. When the request is active is not known.
Details: 0x0FA584 (read): A81C = 255 (x1.0) while the EGR flow FFF8B2A6 is below cal 0x2CD08 (500 = 0.33 g/s); with flow at or above it A81C holds its previous value, and while FFF8AA85 bits 6 and 5 are both set (from module 0x13BD40, not identified) it falls by cal 0x2CE66 (64) per pass down to this table's value (rpm FFF8CE9C x load FFF8A616, read disassembly). A81C multiplies the target EGR rate (0x0FA260). 255 = x1.0. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Enable Minimum Air after Start
table.description:
Amount of air (probably the air drawn since start), by coolant at start, that must pass before EGR is enabled.
Details: 0x0FAAFC (read): EGR is enabled only while this(coolant at start FFF89224, latched from FFF88E20 by 0x082DE0) <= FFF81818, a 32-bit sum of FFF8B4D6 x 256 / FFF8A64B accumulated since start by 0x10A270 (read; meaning of the sum inferred: air since start). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Enable Coolant Minimum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when coolant is at or above this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs coolant FFF8CD65 (degC + 50) >= this (minus cal 0x2C4D6 = 5 once met) (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable Coolant Maximum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when coolant is at or below this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs coolant FFF8CD65 <= this (plus cal 0x2C4D8 = 5 once met) (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable RPM Minimum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when rpm is at or above this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs rpm FFF8CE9C >= this (minus cal 0x2C4DC once met) (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable RPM Maximum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when rpm is at or below this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs rpm FFF8CE9C <= this (plus cal 0x2C4E0 once met) (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable Load Minimum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when load is at or above this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs load FFF8A616 >= this (minus cal 0x2C4E3 once met) (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable Load Maximum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when load is at or below this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: with cal 0x2F797 bit 6 set EGR enable also needs load FFF8A616 <= this (plus cal 0x2C4E4 once met) (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable Intake Air Temp Minimum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when intake air temperature is at or above this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs FFF88662 (intake air temperature + 50 degC) >= this (minus cal 0x2D8A0 = 5 once met) (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Enable Battery Voltage Minimum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when battery voltage is at or above this.
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs FFF9DD61 (battery voltage x 12.8, inferred unit) >= this (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Enable Vehicle Speed Minimum
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when the car is moving at least this fast (vehicle speed signal inferred).
Details: 0x0FAAFC: EGR enable needs FFF99835 (vehicle speed, inferred) >= this (minus cal 0x2CE3B once met) (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Enable Exhaust Pressure Margin
table.description:
EGR is only enabled when the estimated pressure upstream of the EGR valve exceeds manifold pressure by at least this much, so exhaust gas can actually flow.
Details: 0x0FAAFC (read): EGR enable needs MAP (kPa) + this <= EGR Upstream Pressure Estimate FFF8A81D x 2/3 (kPa), i.e. the estimated upstream pressure must exceed MAP by this margin (cal 0x2CCD2 hysteresis). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Active Threshold
table.description:
Target EGR rate above which EGR counts as active, which switches ignition to the Base Timing (EGR Active) tables. See EGR Active Threshold Hysteresis for the switch-off point.
Details: 0x0FB028 (read): FFF8A813 bit 7 ('EGR active') = EGR enabled (FFF8A811 bit 0) and target rate FFF8A81A >= this >> 1; it selects the Base Timing (EGR Active...) tables. The 'Closed Loop Target (... EGR Active)' choice uses the flow FFF8B2A6 >= cal 0x2DE6C instead. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Active Threshold Hysteresis
table.description:
How far below EGR Active Threshold the target EGR rate must fall before EGR counts as inactive again.
Details: 0x0FB028 (read): once active, EGR stays active until FFF8A81A < (EGR Active Threshold - this) >> 1. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Extra timing advance requested while EGR is active with the TGVs closed, by rpm and load, scaled by how much EGR is flowing. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, so it reaches the spark only where that request (plus knock advance) is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map, never above it.
Details: When used: single injection, TGV-closed side. 0x0DC97C / 0x0DD0DC (read): v = TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8, each table read as x/2 - 64 degrees;; stored as 2 x deg + 128 in FFF8A763 (single injection) / FFF8A767. FFF8A769 = FFF8A767 when FFF8A775 bit 2 is set (all four injectors in a 2- or 3-injection strategy, 0x0FAABC), else FFF8A763 (0x0DD454, read). FFF8A769 enters the timing request FFF8A78A (0x0E0A30) and the alternate final-timing value FFF8A733 of 0x0D9E40 (read). Through the request it reaches the fired timing wherever Primary Ignition + this + KCA + FLKC is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map: 0x0C13B4 -> FFF8AF22 -> 0x0C39DC / 0x0DD568 give fired base = min(Base Timing + comps, request + KCA + FLKC) (read; min() form computed). It can never lift the fired timing above the Base Timing (EGR Active) maps. Axes rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8ADE4 (400-6400 rpm, 10-240 %; rows above 32768 are padding). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Timing Advance (TGV Open)
table.description:
Extra timing advance requested while EGR is active with the TGVs open, by rpm and load, scaled by how much EGR is flowing. It is added to the Primary Ignition request, so it reaches the spark only where that request (plus knock advance) is below the Base Timing (EGR Active) map, never above it.
Details: When used: single injection (FFF8A775 bit 2 clear), TGV-open side. 0x0DC97C / 0x0DD0DC (read): v = TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8, each table read as x/2 - 64 degrees;; stored as 2 x deg + 128 in FFF8A763 (single injection) / FFF8A767. FFF8A769 = FFF8A767 when FFF8A775 bit 2 is set (all four injectors in a 2- or 3-injection strategy, 0x0FAABC), else FFF8A763 (0x0DD454, read). table.name: EGR Coolant Timing Adjustment (TGV Closed)

Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Coolant Timing Adjustment Coolant Multiplier

table.name: EGR Target Flow Coolant Multiplier
table.description:
Multiplier (128 = 1.0) by coolant and load on the target EGR flow that drives the valve.
Details: 0x0F9F14 (read): target EGR flow FFF8B296 = filtered (target-rate flow FFF8B298) x this / 128, by coolant FFF88A44 x load FFF8A616; FFF8B298 = fresh air x 5 x r/(1-r) from the target rate (0x0F9FE4). B296 drives the valve (feed-forward 05CB1C and the flow feedback). 128 = x1.0. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Position from Target Flow
table.description:
Feed-forward EGR valve position (steps) for a target EGR flow; feedback is added on top.
Details: Feed-forward valve position FFF8B29E = this(target EGR flow FFF8B296) (0x0FA4B8, read); the command FFF8B2A0 = this + the flow-feedback integral FFF8B294, clamped 0..114 steps (0x0FA4E0, read). EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Flow Model
table.description:
Estimated EGR flow by pressure difference across the valve and valve position. Used both for the actual EGR flow estimate and for the flow feedback, so edits change both.
Details: Estimated EGR flow through the valve by pressure difference FFF8A810 (estimated upstream pressure - MAP) and valve position (read): 0x0FA830 looks it up at the actual position (FFF88A1C << 7) into FFF8B2A6 (used for the actual EGR rate, the Closed Loop Target 'EGR Active' choice at >= 1000 = 0.67 g/s and other modules), and 0x0FA034 looks up the same data (descriptor 05C9F4, identical bytes) at the commanded position into FFF8B29A, which the flow feedback compares with the target. Edits here change both. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Flow Feedback Integral Step
table.description:
How fast the EGR valve feedback corrects position, by the error between target and modelled flow. Positive opens the valve. Larger = faster correction, more risk of hunting.
Details: 0x0F9E10 (read): each pass the valve integral FFF8B294 += this(previous target flow - flow at commanded position) >> 7, frozen against the end stops (0 and 114 steps) and limited to cal 0x2CC6E..0x2CC70 (-50..+90 steps). Signed: positive opens the valve. EGR controller task 0x0F94A8 (read). That this is external EGR is inferred: its commanded output FFF8A81B is the OBD PID 0x2C (Commanded EGR) source and FFF88A1C (actual position) feeds PID 0x2D (EGR error) (0x1717C8, 0x1715F0, read). p16 (read): EGR module 0x0F94A8 runs every 10 ms (0x07C408 <- 0x1DFE3C). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: EGR Valve Feedback Integral Minimum
table.description:
Lower limit of the EGR valve flow-feedback correction (how far feedback may close the valve below feed-forward).
Details: Lower bound of the valve flow-feedback integral FFF8B294 (0x0F9E10, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: EGR Valve Feedback Integral Maximum
table.description:
Upper limit of the EGR valve flow-feedback correction (how far feedback may open the valve beyond feed-forward).
Details: Upper bound of the valve flow-feedback integral FFF8B294 (0x0F9E10, read). Confidence: read.

table.description:

Details: When used: Selected in 0x10D93C by drive mode FFF8A8C1: A for modes 1 (default), 4 and 0 (read). TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum, requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay. States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). used for mode FFF8A8C1 = 1, and for other modes while FFF8A8A2 bit 5 is clear. Confidence: read.

table.name: TGV Close Delay
table.description:
How long the TGV-close conditions must hold before the TGVs actually close, by vehicle speed. Longer = fewer TGV switches during brief light-load moments.
Details: TGV module 0x10CAE0, 10 ms task (read). 0x10E180 (read): FFF8A883 b5 = (FFF8B3E0 >= this(vehicle speed FFF99835, km/h)) and FFF8B3DE >= cal 0x37A2A (200 passes, 2 s since b5 last cleared) and (speed < cal 0x37A28 = 4 km/h or countdown FFF8B3D8 = 0) and FFF8A883 b7 clear. FFF8B3E0 counts 10 ms passes while the TGV request FFF8A888 = 1 (0x10C3D0), and 0x10D93C sets A888 = 1 when the TGV-close conditions are met (coolant, torque, air quantity thresholds) and not inhibited by the IAT threshold (read). A883 b5 then sets the TGV-closed command FFF8A881 b4 (0x10DEFC with cal 0x37A16 = 0, read). So this is the time the close conditions must hold before the valves close. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: TGV Open Fraction from Position (Closing)
table.description:
Converts measured TGV position into the open fraction used to blend every TGV-open / TGV-closed table (fuel, timing, AVCS) while the TGVs are closing; the blend also cannot fall faster than about 0.5 s from open to closed.
Details: When used: while FFF8A881 bit 4 is set (TGVs commanded closed; built by 0x10DEFC from the TGV request and fault/status bits). 0x10C948 (read): the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 falls by cal 0x379EE (1310) per 10 ms pass, about 0.5 s from open to closed, and is never above this table of the filtered average TGV position: output = min(this(position), previous - 1310). The fueling, ignition and AVCS blends then move to their TGV-closed tables. Confidence: read.

table.name: TGV Open Fraction from Position (Opening)
table.description:
Converts measured TGV position into the open fraction used to blend every TGV-open / TGV-closed table (fuel, timing, AVCS) while the TGVs are opening; the blend ramps at about 1 s from closed to open unless the valves open faster.
Details: When used: while FFF8A881 bit 4 is clear (TGVs commanded open). 0x10C948 (read): the TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8 (0 = closed, 65535 = open; the blend weight for every TGV closed/open table pair) rises by cal 0x379EC (655) per 10 ms pass, about 1 s from closed to open, and is never below this table of the filtered average position of the two TGV sensors (FFF88AA6 / FFF88AA8, filter cal 0x37A14): output = max(this(position), previous + 655). So the table is a floor: the blend follows the measured position if the valves open faster than the ramp. Confidence: read.

table.name: TGV Motor Duty Compensation
table.description:
Multiplier on the TGV motor drive duty by coolant and battery voltage, so the valves move reliably when cold or at low voltage.
Details: TGV actuator drive (0x10D8E4, read): the duty FFF8A885 = FFF8A87D x this / 16384 (capped at 255), where FFF8A87D is the duty chosen for the TGV state FFF8A884 by 0x10C690 (cals 0x37993-0x37998, 0x379DA/0x379DB or the tables 05D260-05D284). Axes: coolant FFF88A44 and battery voltage FFF9DD61 (x/12.8, inferred). With FFF8A883 bit 1 set the duty is the fixed cal 0x37992 instead. Confidence: read.

table.name: TGV Drive Duty (Opening)
table.description:
Motor duty used to drive the TGVs towards their open stop, by valve position (open meaning inferred). Leave alone unless the TGV actuators are changed.
Details: TGV drive 0x10C690 (10 ms task, read): the drive duty FFF8A87D is chosen by the TGV state FFF8A884 (state machine 0x10D374, 1-36), then x TGV Motor Duty Compensation (0x10D8E4) -> FFF8A885 -> timer duty = period x A885 / 250 (0x1D9A06 / 0x1D9956 or 0x1D9A5E / 0x1D99AE, read): 0.4 % per count. The H-bridge side is FFF8A881 b7 = table 0x5D360[state] (0x10E110, read). Axis = min(FFF888DE, FFF888E0), the two TGV sensors normalised between their learned end stops (0 = low stop, 4096 = high stop, read). Used only in state 14 (the switch was read in the disassembly; Ghidra's text wrongly adds state 36, which gives 0), where 0x5D360 selects bridge side 1. It drives until both sensors pass 95 % of the stroke, i.e. toward the high stop, which is the open end on the scale where higher = more open (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Exit threshold paired with TGV Torque Threshold Enter (Start Modes).
TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum, requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay. States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). Pairs with TGV Torque Threshold Enter (Start Modes). Confidence: read.

table.name: Cruise Pedal Equivalent (Other Drive Modes)
table.description:
Converts the cruise control torque request into a pedal-position equivalent by torque and rpm; while cruise is active the ECU uses the higher of this and the real pedal. Used in the default drive mode (cruise meaning inferred). If you change Requested Torque tables, cruise response changes unless this is adjusted too.
Details: When used: drive mode FFF8A8C1 not 2 or 3, FFF811E1 bit 4 clear. 0x168864 (read), in the seg-0x16 cruise module (cruise reading inferred, my research notes), runs while FFF88EC9 bit 6 is set: FFF8B9AC = min(this(torque FFF8B9E2, rpm FFF8CD54), a 1-D limit by the same selection, a ramped limit cal 0x3F852/0x3F854). 0x0BE128 then uses max(accelerator, FFF8B9AC) as the pedal FFF8AF00 while FFF88E12 bit 1 (cruise active) is set, so this is the pedal equivalent of the cruise torque request B9E2 (0 ft-lb = 16000). Selection: drive mode FFF8A8C1 (2, 3, other) and FFF811E1 bit 4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Maximum Speed (km/h Meter)
table.description:
Upper cruise speed by meter (market) code; the name 'maximum cruise speed' is inferred from the values. The ECU picks one of six tables by meter units (km/h or mph, inferred) and a cruise option flag from the meter. This is the standard km/h version.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16C1A0 (read): FFF8B9F0 = one of six tables by meter code FFF8A88C. B9F0 is the upper cruise speed: the tap logic 0x16D068 and the gain selection in 0x16AF7C compare the speed with it (read); 'maximum cruise speed' inferred from the values. Selection: FFF811E1 b4 clear -> 05EFE0 (FFF8A8A7 b0 clear) / 05EFEC (b0 set); b4 set and FFF8AB40 b2 clear -> 05EFB0 / 05EFBC; b4 and AB40 b2 set -> 05EFC8 / 05EFD4. FFF8A8A7 b0 comes from CAN (0x119EF8); the standard b0-set table 05EFEC holds whole-mph values (71 / 90 mph) where 05EFE0 holds whole km/h (114 / 145 km/h), so b0 = meter in mph (inferred); the Meter Cruise Option b0-set tables 05EFBC / 05EFD4 hold the same whole-km/h values as their km/h twins (114 / 145 / 200 km/h = 70.8 / 90.1 / 124.3 mph), so with that option the ECU uses the same km/h limits whatever the meter unit (read). FFF811E1 b4 is a latched CAN flag from the meter frame 0x282 byte 7 bit 0 (0x119B54, read; called Meter Cruise Option elsewhere). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Cancel Speed
table.description:
Speed below which cruise control cancels (and the set speed is cleared), by meter (market) code.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16C078 (read): FFF8B9EA = this(meter code FFF8A88C) while FFF811E1 b4 is clear (05EF44/05EF38, all 0, otherwise). 0x170774 (read): the cancel flag FFF8AB3E b2 is set unless speed FFF8B9F4 >= FFF8B9EA and cruise is available (FFF88E12 b0) and three other flags allow it; AB3E b2 resets the set speed in 0x16AAE0 and feeds the state machine. A second speed FFF8B9F2 (05EFF8-05F034, all 40 km/h) is not defined here. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Set Speed Ramp While Accelerating
table.description:
How fast the cruise target speed rises, by speed, while the raise (accelerate) switch is held.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16AAE0 (read): while an accelerate request is held (FFF88E11 b5, or b4 from the raise switch, still set from the previous pass) the cruise target FFF8B9DE = min(max set speed FFF8B9EC, max(target + this, speed + this)) every pass; this(cruise speed FFF8B9F4). On the first pass of a request the step is 05EDEC (10 km/h above the current speed, not defined here); lowering uses 05EDE0/05EDD4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Torque Limit Offset
table.description:
Torque margin by rpm that caps the cruise control torque request above a base torque value, limiting how hard cruise can drive the engine. One table edits all three copies (including the monitor copy).
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16BD54 (read): while cruise is controlling (FFF8AB40 b5) the cruise torque request FFF8B9E2 = min(controller torque, FFF8AE72 + this(rpm FFF8CD5C) - 16000), i.e. this table is a torque margin in Nm above FFF8AE72 (= AF64 - AF62, 0x0BAE68). 0x16AF7C writes the same sum to FFF8B9E0 (no reader found). FFF8B9E2 drives the cruise pedal equivalent (05ED14 etc.) and replaces the driver request in 0x0BB53C. Descriptors 05EF20 (0x16BD54) and 05FBBC (monitor copy 0x18B3EC) read the same data 0x04071C, so this one entry edits all three. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Cruise Speed Error Gain (Default)
table.description:
Main cruise controller gain by acceleration and speed error, used while holding speed and in all states without their own table. Higher = more aggressive throttle response.
Details: Cruise module 0x165AC4/0x1663AC, 20 ms task (read). Cruise runs on this 6MT ROM: cal 0x57788 = 0x03 enables the analog steering-switch input FFF88E76 (0x08DF14: main switch -> FFF88EC9 b6; two momentary switches -> FFF88EC9 b1 (raises the set speed) and b0 (lowers it), read; 'accelerate'/'coast' are inferred names); no MT-coding gate was found. 0x16AF7C (read): the cruise speed controller multiplies the speed error (target FFF8B9DC - speed FFF8B9F4) by a gain from one of seven tables, selected by the cruise state FFF8AB58 (state machine 0x168AC2) and flags: AB3D b0/b1 -> 05EE58; else state 0x23 -> 05EE1C; state 0xB0 -> 05EE44; state 0xC0, or any other state while the speed is not within 2 km/h of the maximum cruise speed FFF8B9F0 (86B5F): AB42 b2 -> 05EE94, else state 0x40 -> 05EE80, state 0xC0 -> 05EE6C; otherwise (incl. the hold state 0x33) -> 05EE30. Axes: vehicle acceleration FFF8B9C2 and speed error. The gain x 05EED0-family(rpm)/160 is filtered into FFF8C5BE, which is integrated with the error into the drive-torque command FFF8C438 -> FFF8B9E2. This is the default set (hold state 0x33 and all states not listed). Confidence: inferred.
