P0087 Rail Pressure Low Limit
table.description:
Rail pressure floor by rpm for P0087 (rail pressure too low): the code counts a fault when actual pressure stays more than 0.30 MPa (hysteresis cal) below this value for about 10 seconds, and recovers when pressure is back at this value.
Details: 0x0752A8 (read, boot lookup 0x72AC): the absolute low-pressure test fails while actual rail pressure FFF88884 < this(rpm FFF8CD56) - hysteresis cal 0x574DA for cal 0x574E0 passes -> P0087. p16 (read): 0x0752A8 (<- 0x0A1D2C <- 0x1DFE3C) runs every 10 ms; 200 passes = 2 s, 1000 passes = 10 s. Descriptor boot 061628. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level, by rpm and load, that confirms channel 1 of the P219A A/F imbalance monitor. It sets no code by itself; P219A needs both this and A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1 exceeded. Raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never).
Details: When used: once per combustion event (0x1908E4, crank-synchronous list 0x1E1D1C) while the P219A monitor runs (FFF8ACD1). Confirms channel 1 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1). 0x18E130 (read): threshold FFF8BC5E = this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616) x 05FCB0(coolant)/8192 x 05FCBC/128 x 1.0 (float constants 1000/2^33 and 8.192, 0x18E23C / 0x18E248, read); x 100 instead (capped at 65535, so during that window any cell >= 336 can never be exceeded) until the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 has been unchanged for cal 0x4496E = 150 passes (1.5 s; FFF8ACCD bit 5, 0x1912B4) - the A/C-state stability bit 6 (0x191324, cal 0x436B2 = 0) is always set; 65535 while FFF88A2D bit 0; 05FC90 (all 65535) replaces it near standstill with the pedal released (FFF8ACCD bit 0: FFF88C64 bit 5 and speed < 2 km/h) and 05FC68 (all 65535) while FFF8AA3F is set. 0x18F14C sets FFF8ACC5 = 2 when the crank fluctuation FFF8BC5C - 0x8000 > threshold x 250/256 (so an event counts when the fluctuation exceeds 0.977 x the cell value). 0x18D180... count those events per cylinder (FFF8ACC2 = 1..4, cylinder inferred) into FFF8BC24/28/2C/30 and in total FFF8BC48; at the end of a 2000-event window (FFF8BC20 = cal 0x436F0) 0x18F364 judges FFF8ACC7 = 2 'rough' when a cylinder count > cal 0x436F4 (17) or the total > cal 0x436F6 (17) (with a cylinder share > cal 0x43704 = 0) (read). That latches FFF8ACD8 (0x191850). The channel 1 judgement 0x18F980 gives FFF8ACCB = 2 (exceeded, which sets FFF8ACCF bit 1 and through it the P219A result in 0x19198C) only when the A/F swing exceeded its reference (FFF8ACCE bit 4) AND FFF8ACD8 (or FFF8ACD4) is set; FFF8ACCB = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 5, cal 0x436C0 = 1) (read). So the roughness test is a required confirmation: a channel 1 P219A needs both the A/F swing and this crank roughness. The largest count and its limit are also Mode $06 values FFF815CE / FFF815D0 (0x18EB24 / 0x18EBA8, test 0xDC in the 0x0A0000 reporter, read). Raising cells makes the confirmation harder (65535 = never), lowering makes it easier; it does not set a DTC by itself. LF76400Q: same code as LF75404S; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 0608F0. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2
table.description:
Crankshaft roughness level that confirms channel 2 of the P219A monitor (paired with A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). Lower than Threshold 1, so more sensitive. Sets no code by itself; raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never).
Details: When used: as A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1, for channel 2 of P219A (A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). 0x18E250 (read): same gating and scaling (x 05FD10(coolant)/8192 x 05FD1C/128, both 1.0) into FFF8BC60 -> FFF8BC64; 0x18F0F8 sets FFF8ACC4 = 2 on an exceedance; per-cylinder counters FFF8BC32..BC44 (0x18D4C8...) and the 2000-event window judgement FFF8ACC6 (0x18F1A0: a cylinder count > cal 0x436FC (17) or the total > cal 0x436FE (17) gives 2 'rough') latch FFF8ACDB (0x191920). The channel 2 judgement 0x18F928 gives FFF8ACCA = 2 (exceeded: FFF8ACCF bit 3 -> P219A result) only when the swing exceeded (FFF8ACCE bit 2) AND FFF8ACDB (or FFF8ACD6) is set; = 1 (passed) when the swing passed (FFF8ACCE bit 3, cal 0x436C1 = 1) (read). Mode $06 values FFF815D2 / FFF815D4 (0x18EFCC / 0x18F050, read). LF76400Q: same code as LF75404S; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 060950. Confidence: read.

table.name: Base Timing IAT Compensation
table.description:
Timing added (negative = retard) for hot intake air, by intake air temperature, scaled by Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier. Applied once the engine is running above about 800 rpm and feeds into base timing.
Details: When used: FFF8A782 = rate-limited (cals 0x32DE2/0x32DE4 = 65535, i.e. none) value, enabled once FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x37F9E (800 rpm) in running mode FFF8866C = 3 (0x0E0184, read; cal 0x239AE bit 3 clear, so the knock-limit min() is not applied). FFF8A782 is added to the torque-model base timing FFF8A645 (0x0C2C08, A-D path with FFF8A787; E/F path with FFF8A788; my research notes, Ghidra stack args) and to the timing request FFF8A78A/FFF8B10E -> FFF8A789 (0x0E0A30, register args, read), which becomes the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). It is not a separate term of the final timing sum FFF8A744, but it reaches the fired timing through FFF8A645 (FFF8A645 -> FFF8A76A -> FFF8A76D -> FFF8A74B -> FFF8A744, 0x0DD568 / 0x0DD760 / 0x0DA600 / 0x0D9E40, read). Value = this(IAT FFF88A48) x Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier(rpm, load) / 128 (read). LF76401R: 0x0DFD68 (pair of LF75404S 0x0E0184): the first curve, multiplied by Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier 05C8F4 (read; the transfer had put this name on 05C964, which is the second curve). Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 2)
table.description:
This software version (function 0x0E5098, read against the longer version of the function): the table is the step only on the pass where the window flag sets. On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x02953A instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 1)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock. Larger = that event less likely to count as knock. Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 1 (Event 1), knock channel 2 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C2 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C180[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D2, gain curve cal 0x26F6F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing IAT Compensation
table.description:
Timing added (negative = retard) for hot intake air, by intake air temperature, scaled by Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier. Applied once the engine is running above about 800 rpm and feeds into base timing.
Details: When used: FFF8A782 = rate-limited (cals 0x32DE2/0x32DE4 = 65535, i.e. none) value, enabled once FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x37F9E (800 rpm) in running mode FFF8866C = 3 (0x0E0184, read; cal 0x239AE bit 3 clear, so the knock-limit min() is not applied). FFF8A782 is added to the torque-model base timing FFF8A645 (0x0C2C08, A-D path with FFF8A787; E/F path with FFF8A788; my research notes, Ghidra stack args) and to the timing request FFF8A78A/FFF8B10E -> FFF8A789 (0x0E0A30, register args, read), which becomes the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). It is not a separate term of the final timing sum FFF8A744, but it reaches the fired timing through FFF8A645 (FFF8A645 -> FFF8A76A -> FFF8A76D -> FFF8A74B -> FFF8A744, 0x0DD568 / 0x0DD760 / 0x0DA600 / 0x0D9E40, read). Value = this(IAT FFF88A48) x Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier(rpm, load) / 128 (read). LF76500Q: 0x0DFD68 (pair of LF75404S 0x0E0184): the first curve, multiplied by Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier 05C8F4 (read; the transfer had put this name on 05C964, which is the second curve). Confidence: read.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 2)
table.description:
This software version (function 0x0E5098, read against the longer version of the function): the table is the step only on the pass where the window flag sets. On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x02953A instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 1)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock. Larger = that event less likely to count as knock. Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 1 (Event 1), knock channel 2 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C2 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C180[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D2, gain curve cal 0x26F6F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Base Timing IAT Compensation
table.description:
Timing added (negative = retard) for hot intake air, by intake air temperature, scaled by Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier. Applied once the engine is running above about 800 rpm and feeds into base timing.
Details: When used: FFF8A782 = rate-limited (cals 0x32DE2/0x32DE4 = 65535, i.e. none) value, enabled once FFF8CD5C >= cal 0x37F9E (800 rpm) in running mode FFF8866C = 3 (0x0E0184, read; cal 0x239AE bit 3 clear, so the knock-limit min() is not applied). FFF8A782 is added to the torque-model base timing FFF8A645 (0x0C2C08, A-D path with FFF8A787; E/F path with FFF8A788; my research notes, Ghidra stack args) and to the timing request FFF8A78A/FFF8B10E -> FFF8A789 (0x0E0A30, register args, read), which becomes the spark target FFF8A72A (0x0D9088). It is not a separate term of the final timing sum FFF8A744, but it reaches the fired timing through FFF8A645 (FFF8A645 -> FFF8A76A -> FFF8A76D -> FFF8A74B -> FFF8A744, 0x0DD568 / 0x0DD760 / 0x0DA600 / 0x0D9E40, read). Value = this(IAT FFF88A48) x Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier(rpm, load) / 128 (read). LF76600R: 0x0DFD68 (pair of LF75404S 0x0E0184): the first curve, multiplied by Base Timing IAT Compensation Multiplier 05C8F4 (read; the transfer had put this name on 05C964, which is the second curve). Confidence: read.

(slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). table.name: Injector 2/4 Rail Pressure Offset
table.description:
Pressure offset added to measured rail pressure before looking up Injector Flow Compensation (Injectors 2/4), by rpm and load; probably the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor.
Details: 0x06D43A (read): FFF89222 = sat(rail pressure FFF88886 + this(rpm FFF8CE9C, load FFF8A616)), interpolated by 0x00671C (descriptor 0x0608E4: data, u16 axis, u8 axis, 16, 16; row = rpm, read). FFF89222 indexes the injector flow compensation 05A844 used only for injectors 2 and 4 (0x0CB0C8, read); injectors 1 and 3 use 05A838 with FFF88886. Likely the pressure difference of the rail without the sensor (inferred from the boxer layout). Signed, in the rail-pressure unit. Descriptor boot 06D16C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description:
Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).
Details: Note: the ECU has a second open-loop fuel path: the four "Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...)" tables 05ABB0..05ABEC, blended by TGV and AVCS (0x0CE5E8 -> FFF8A681); 0x0CEA80 takes the richer of the two (max). To lean the open-loop target edit both sets; richening works with either (read, my research notes). Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor. Base open-loop enrichment target, 0x0CE854. Used only while the exhaust temperature estimate FFF8AFD0 (see Exhaust Temperature Model Map A/B) is >= cal 0x18DD4 (39322, hysteresis cal 0x18DD6 = 2185), or its integral FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8 (65535); otherwise this path contributes 0 (read). While cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is clear, the additive term (Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive x DAM multiplier) is added, minus Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive x Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128. The result is rate-limited (FFF84424) into FFF8A682, and FFF8A684 = max(FFF8A682, other enrichments) feeds commanded lambda. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05AC6C by the code that reads it (read). LF79200T: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 066DC4. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description:
Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.
Details: When used: whenever the open-loop delay has expired (see below); the blend follows TGV position and AVCS state. TGV-closed base, weight 1 - a (AVCS not in active control). 0x0CE5E8 (read; called from 0x0C589C with rpm FFF8CD54, load FFF8A616, cal 0x2F79A bit 4, DAM FFF811AE, AVCS weight FFF8A743 and TGV open fraction FFF8B3E8): TGV-closed base = 05ABB0 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABD8 x a/255, TGV-open base = 05ABC4 x (255 - a)/255 + 05ABEC x a/255, where a = FFF8A743 is the AVCS-active weight from 0x0D952C (255 while both cam controllers are in active control, my research notes); blend FFF8A69B = closed x (1 - FFF8B3E8) + open x FFF8B3E8. With cal 0x2F79A bit 4 clear. With the bit set: Alternate (+ cal 0x13DCD) while DAM16 < cal 0x1391C (16), else blend + cal 0x13DCD. 0x0CEA80 (read) then takes FFF8A681 (only once FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the open-loop delay, and when >= cal 0x13DD0 = 5), scales it by cal 0x237CA/128 (x1.0), rate-limits its rise by 05ACD4(rpm) and sets FFF8A684 = max(that, FFF8A682), FFF8A682 being Primary Open Loop Fueling from 0x0CE854. FFF8A684 is the open-loop enrichment in commanded lambda 256/(256 + B030 + A684 + AFE8) (0x171C88). So the commanded open-loop mixture is the richer of the two systems: to lean the target, lower this group as well as Primary Open Loop Fueling; to richen, raise this group (Primary Open Loop Fueling alone only takes effect while its exhaust-temperature enable holds: 0x0CE854 sets FFF8A683 to 0 unless FFF8AFD0 >= cal 0x18DD4 or FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8, read). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05ABB0 by the code that reads it (read). LF79200T: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 066B28. Confidence: inferred.

Details: Enrichment amount FFF843EE (0x0CD834, read); this TGV Closed table is used when TGV state flag FFF8A881 bit 4 (passed in by 0x0C73D0, read) is set. Faded to zero by After-Start Enrichment Decay 2 (TGV Closed), the three faded terms' maximum is scaled by the RPM multiplier into FFF8B012/B016/B01A/B01E (read), and FFF8B012 adds to the start-path fuel factor (B012 + A828 + B02C)/256 + 0.5 (0x0D1400, read). table.description:

table.description:
Purge valve duty needed for a target purge flow at a given manifold vacuum; higher vacuum needs less duty. Applied above Purge Valve Minimum Duty. Change only for a different purge valve.
Details: When used: every 80 ms pass (0x0D60FC, read): A70A = this(target purge flow FFF8B0C0, manifold vacuum FFF8CDFA). The final duty is A713 + (100 % - A713) x this, with A713 = Purge Valve Minimum Duty (0x0D6118, read), and 0 when this is 0. B0C0 = purge rate x air quantity FFF8B4D6 / 256, in the air-quantity unit (read). Higher vacuum needs less duty for the same flow. Purge module (inferred: canister purge): 0x0D4E78 (80 ms task 0x1E1560) and 0x0D4C14 (20 ms task 0x1E0AE8) (read). Chain (read): purge rate A70C (limits A6FD/A70F, ramp A709, cut B0A0) -> purge flow B0C0 = A70C x air FFF8B4D6/256 -> valve duty A70A = 05B314(B0C0, vacuum) -> A70B with minimum duty A713 -> A707 -> timer E channel 22 (0x1D98D6); A707 is also checked by the circuit monitor 0x072090 (driver status FFF88BF4 bits 10/11). Fuel: A71A = filtered purge rate x learned concentration FFF81412 (0x0D688C) is subtracted from the fuel factor (0x0D15EC). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05B314 by the code that reads it (read). LF79200T: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 067554. Confidence: read.

Secondary Knock Threshold (Event 1)
table.description:
Second knock detector level by rpm for event slot 1; a signal above it triggers the secondary knock retard steps. Unit: sum of the three strongest knock-channel ratios to their background (3.0 = all at background).

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 2)
table.description:
This software version (function 0x0F5FFC, read against the longer version of the function): the table is the step only on the pass where the window flag sets. On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F2A instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 1)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock. Larger = that event less likely to count as knock. Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 1 (Event 1), knock channel 2 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C2 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C180[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D2, gain curve cal 0x26F6F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: read.

On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F48 instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 3)).
Knock-detection background step for event slot 3, frequency channel 1.
Details: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 3 (Event 3), knock channel 1 of 8 (index 0 of FFF8CDB0), which is masked: bit 0 of cal 0x1B97E is set (0xC1 = channels 1, 7 and 8 off for every slot). 0x0E51E4 (read) then writes a fixed ratio for the channel instead of 256 x measured/reference, and the reference ref_0 (the only place this step enters, statics FFF84AB4..FFF84AD0 read only by 0x0E51E4, ram_xref) is not used; the reference copies FFF8C130.. have no reader. So editing it has no effect unless that cal bit is cleared, which would make the channel count (then this would be the background step for FFF8C1A0[0] when FFF8A7C4 changes; overlap flag FFF8A7D4, gain curve cal 0x26F8F). Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: read.

table.description:
Base ignition timing map for the pedal fully released (idle and deceleration) with the TGVs closed. It is only an upper limit: the ECU fires the lower of this map and Closed-Pedal Timing Target (plus its corrections).
Details: When used: Used while the accelerator is fully released (FFF8A774 bit 0: pedal-zero flag FFF88C64 bit 5 in engine state 2/3, vehicle speed FFF99835 at or below cal 0x2FDB2 = 200 km/h (inferred); 0x0E127C / 0x09FF9A, read), TGVs closed; enabled by cal 0x1071E bit 0, set in all four images. Base ignition timing. 0x0C2C08 uses this 16x16 table when cal 0x1071E bit 0 and FFF8A774 bit 0 are both set, and F2 set (F2 = FFF8A881 bit 4). The result is rate-limited (cals 0x1058C / 0x1058E) and the IAT compensation FFF8A782 and Closed-Pedal Timing Coolant Compensation FFF8A788 are added (0x0C2C08) to give base timing FFF8A645, which is only the upper limit of the fired timing: with the pedal released 0x0DD568 sets FFF8A76A = FFF8A645 - Torque Reduction Spark Retard(FFF8AF22 >> 7), where FFF8AF22 (0x0C13B4) is the efficiency of the closed-pedal timing request (Closed-Pedal Timing Target + FFF8A788 + FFF8A782 + Post-Start Closed-Pedal Timing Advance, 0x0E0A30) plus KCA + FLKC, so in effect FFF8A76A = min(FFF8A645, that request + KCA + FLKC) (read; min() form computed from the inverse tables). FFF8A76A then goes through 0x0DD760, 0x0DA600 and 0x0D9E40 to FFF8A744. The F2 selector is FFF8A881 bit 4, set by the TGV module 0x10CAE0 (0x10DEFC) - set = TGVs closed (see below). Rev Limit Full Cut RPM
table.description:
At or above this rpm, once the rev limit has started, every injector is cut on every firing (a hard fuel cut). Keep it equal to Rev Limit RPM; set higher, the range between them gets only the throttle cap, probably a softer limit.
Set rpm of the full-cut latch (part 2): at or above it, while state 0x0B is active, the torque cap is zero and all four injectors are cut every combustion event (part 3). On its own it does not start a cut; Rev Limit RPM does. Set above Rev Limit RPM, the range between them gets only the throttle cap (part 5; a soft stage, inferred). Rev limiter and limit-state cuts (LF75404S; read unless marked). The rev limiter is a fuel cut. (1) Limit state, 0x0BE140 (10 ms torque module 0x0BE694): the rev latch FFF8416A sets when rpm FFF8CD54 > Rev Limit RPM (the comparator FFF84169 then uses Rev Limit Reset RPM) and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Reset RPM and MAP FFF88FF4 < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP. The overboost latch FFF84167 sets when MAP >= Overboost Limit (compensated, FFF8A851) + Overboost Cut Margin (Limit State) and releases below that level minus Overboost Cut Hysteresis (Limit State). Either latch gives limit state FFF8A639 = 0x0B. Priority: not running = 1, FFF8A640 bit 0 = 0x19, latch FFF8416C = 0x1B (cals 0x22FB2-0x22FBC, not decoded), then 0x0B, then the vehicle-speed latch = 0x0C (see Vehicle Speed Limit). (2) Full-cut latch, 0x0BAE98: FFF840C4 sets when rpm >= Rev Limit Full Cut RPM and releases once rpm <= Rev Limit Full Cut Reset RPM and MAP < Rev Limit Reset Maximum MAP. In state 0x0B the final torque cap FFF8AE54 (0x0B9DC8) is limited to FFF8AE8A: zero indicated torque (32000 - losses FFF8AF62) while this latch or the overboost flag FFF8A63A bit 6 (Overboost Limit + Overboost Margin for Overboost Delay) is set, otherwise FFF8AF3A = the current air torque minus losses, i.e. no reduction. (3) Fuel: 0x0C4BA0 turns the cap into the torque ratio FFF8A64F; in limit states 8, 9, 0x0B, 0x0C and 0x18-0x1B, 0x0C1AC8 turns the ratio into the number of cylinders to cut FFF8A643 (Cylinder Cut Torque Ratio thresholds; a zero cap gives 4). Once per combustion event (crank-synchronous list 0x07D0E0) 0x0C4B84 makes a cut decision FFF8A648 from the count and the last three decisions (4 = every event, 3 = three in four, 2 = every second, 1 = one in four; the pattern is in code, not a cal). 0x0C88C8 (list 0x07D1C2) latches it into the cut flag of the cylinder being scheduled (FFF8A6F5-FFF8A6F8). For a flagged cylinder the fuel time is 0 (0x0D1D7C/0x0D1FB8) and both start angles are 0x1FE (0x0CB394/0x0CB604), which the injector driver 0x1DCA04 treats as no pulse. So the cut is a true injector cut, all four cylinders, every event. table.description:
Once set, the overboost flag clears only when boost falls to Overboost Limit plus this.

table.name: Vehicle Speed Limit Full Cut Speed
table.description:

table.name: Torque Model Filter Multiplier A (TGV Closed)
table.description:
Version of Torque Model Filter Multiplier A used while the TGVs are closed.
Details: 0x0C1EA8 (read): AF4E multiplies the rpm-based filter coefficient AFAC (0x0C38E0) in 0x0C2514 (AF58), 0x0C1854 (predicted air torque AF40) and 0x0C39DC (AF3E): k = AF4E x AFAC/512. 512 = 1.0; values that push k past 65535 mean no lag. Selected in state S2: after combustion-mode change 1 -> 3, while spark target - final timing > 4 deg (7 deg with A7E2 bit 0) and FFF886AB bit 5. TGV closed (A881 bit 4), A7E2 bit 0 clear. Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 059ED0 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). LF79200T: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 065A4C. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter
table.description:
Limits, by requested amount and coolant, how much the throttle model may add air to make up for retarded spark (TGVs not closed). Large compensation is cut more when cold. Leave alone unless you know the model. On 2017+ ROMs edit the "(Alt)" version instead.
Details: 0x0C2AD8 (read): A644 = this(AF58, coolant); AF5E = max(1.0, AF58 x A644/256) is the spark compensation actually allowed and is the normal value of the cap AF56 in 0x0C37D8. Used while TGVs are not forced closed (FFF8A881 bit 4 clear). Part of the torque-to-throttle model; see my research notes (Phase 13). LF79100P: located from LF75404S 059FA8 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). LF79200T: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 065B90. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Spark Air Compensation Limiter Baro Factor
table.description:
Barometric-pressure factor on Spark Air Compensation Limiter (later software versions).
Details: When used: only when the cal bit given below (bit 7) is set; otherwise the factor is fixed at 64 (x1.0) (read). Multiplies Spark Air Compensation Limiter: the allowed spark air compensation = (spark air compensation ratio) x limiter x this >> 14, floored at 1.0 (read, 2017 0x0D2134). table.name: Exhaust Temperature Model Map A (No Enrichment)
table.description:
Exhaust temperature estimate (inferred) that decides when Primary Open Loop Fueling kicks in. Map A is the fast-reacting part, by rpm and load, used while no open loop enrichment is active. Raising it brings enrichment in earlier; lowering it delays it.

Maps are rpm FFF8CD54 x load FFF8A616. table.description:

table.name: Intake Cam Target 1A (TGV Open, Normal, Altitude)
Intake Cam Target 1B (TGV Open, Normal, Sea Level)
table.description:
Main intake cam advance target (degrees from rest) by rpm and load for normal driving with the TGVs open near sea level: above light part throttle, above about 5200 rpm, or cold. Higher = earlier intake timing. At light part throttle the TGVs close and Intake Cam Target 3B is used instead. Normal vs high-pedal split is inferred.
Details: Convention (read, see FU_UNITS): crank degrees of intake cam ADVANCE from its learned rest position; 0 = rest (fully retarded, inferred), larger = more advance (earlier valve events). Values below 0 ask for less than the rest position: the OCV then sits at minimum duty and the cam stays at rest (inferred). AVCS target (intake 0x15C250, exhaust 0x16032C, read): target = coolant terms + v x [S_A x w + S_B x (1 - w)] + (1 - v) x [3A x w + (3B + Coolant Offset 3B x Coolant Factor 3 / 128) x (1 - w)], clamped to +/-90 degrees, 364.09 counts per degree. v = FFF8B3E8, the TGV open fraction: sets 1/2 apply with TGVs open, set 3 with TGVs closed. w = FFF8B948 = AVCS Barometric Blend (barometric pressure FFF88668, via 0x15B1E0, read): the A tables apply at altitude, the B tables at sea level. S = set 1 or set 2, chosen by FFF8A8A4 bit 7 (stack argument +24 from 0x15969C, read). That bit is a high-pedal latch (0x11C15C / 0x10F848, read): it sets when the accelerator FFF88A5E is at or above High Pedal Entry Threshold while vehicle speed is not jumping (under cal 0x35B16... per gear) and some status flags (FFF88A2D bit 0, FFF88ADA bit 6, FFF8A8A2 bit 6) are clear, or when FFF8A8A5 bit 2 or 4 is set; it clears once the pedal is below cal 0x36518 (85 %). So set 1 = normal driving and set 2 = near wide-open pedal (meaning inferred from these conditions). Exhaust set 2 differs mainly below 1.03 g/rev. The altitude (A) sets differ only below 0.52 g/rev. The set-3 terms are active because cal 0x3ACF6 = 1 in both images. Set 1, B table (weight 1 - w). This is the sea-level target while the TGVs are open (above the TGV torque / air-quantity thresholds, above 5200 rpm, or cold); at light part throttle the TGVs are closed and Intake Cam Target 3B is used. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 05E4A8 by the code that reads it (read). LF79200T: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 06AA40. table.description:
Minimum coolant for TGV closing used only while a warm-up fallback flag is set.
TGV request logic 0x10D93C (read): the request byte FFF8A888 is 3 unless all of these hold: coolant FFF88A44 at or above TGV Coolant Minimum, requested torque FFF8AEE2 (0x0BA868, Nm = x/80 - 200) below the rpm-based TGV Torque Threshold (it must fall below the Enter table and then rise above the Exit table to clear), air quantity FFF8B4D6 below TGV Air Quantity Maximum (Enter 0x37A4A, Exit 0x37A48), and FFF8A88D = 0. When they hold, FFF8A888 = 1, or 2 if the intake air temperature FFF88A48 is below TGV IAT Threshold (vehicle speed) or FFF88E28 bit 0/2 is set; FFF8A888 = 2 also while combustion mode FFF8A85C is below cal 0x37B48. State 1 requests TGV close: it runs the timer FFF8B3E0 (0x10C3D0) and FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is set once the timer reaches TGV Close Delay. States 2 (close blocked: cold intake air, FFF88E28 bit 0/2, or combustion mode below cal 0x37B48) and 3 (close conditions not met) reset the timer, so the TGVs stay open (read). Which threshold pair is used depends on FFF8A8C1 (1, 2, 3 or other) and FFF8A8A2 bit 5 (not identified). Each threshold is table(rpm FFF8CE9C) + TGV Torque Threshold Offset(rpm, FFF88AE6) - 16000, so the offset table is centred on 16000 (0 ft-lb). Used while FFF899D7 bit 0 is set. LF79100P: located from LF75404S 037A46 by the code that reads it (read). LF79200T: same code as LF79100P; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Address 04053E. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor Scaling
table.description:

The voltage axis (0x579FC, 32 points 0...4.96 V in 0.16 V steps; 65536 = 5 V inferred) is shared with Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling: change only the temperature values for a different thermistor, or both sensors move. While the sensor is faulted (FFF88E28 bit 2) the fixed voltage cal 0x579BA x 256 is used. Descriptor boot 06D0D8. Confidence: read.

table.name: Intake Air Temp Sensor 2 Scaling

On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F3A instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 2)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 2, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 2 (Event 2), knock channel 2 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C3 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C190[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D3, gain curve cal 0x26F7F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F4E instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 3)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 3, channel 4 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 3 (Event 3), knock channel 4 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C4 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C1A0[3] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D4, gain curve cal 0x26F8F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F62 instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 4)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 4, channel 6 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 4 (Event 4), knock channel 6 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C5 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C1B0[5] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D5, gain curve cal 0x26F9F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
This software version (function 0x0F5FFC, read against the longer version of the function): the table is the step only on the pass where the window flag sets. On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F4A instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 3)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 3, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 3 (Event 3), knock channel 2 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C4 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C1A0[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D4, gain curve cal 0x26F8F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

This software version (function 0x0F5FFC, read against the longer version of the function): the table is the step only on the pass where the window flag sets. On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F5E instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 4)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 4, channel 4 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 4 (Event 4), knock channel 4 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C5 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C1B0[3] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D5, gain curve cal 0x26F9F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 5)
table.description:
This software version (function 0x0F5FFC, read against the longer version of the function): the table is the step only on the pass where the window flag sets. On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F30 instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 1)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 1, channel 5 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 1 (Event 1), knock channel 5 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C2 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C180[4] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D2, gain curve cal 0x26F6F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F4A instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 3)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 3, channel 2 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 3 (Event 3), knock channel 2 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C4 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C1A0[1] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D4, gain curve cal 0x26F8F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

On the pass where it clears, the longer version subtracts the table; this one adds the fixed value at cal 0x030F5E instead (s16; the row for the event is Knock Background Clear Step (Event 4)).
Knock signal processing for event slot 4, channel 4 (probably a frequency band of the knock sensor). For the one event where the knock window switches length, it shifts the channel's background reference so the switch does not read as knock: added when the window lengthens, subtracted when it shortens. Larger = more compensation in both directions (the lengthening event less likely to count as knock, the shortening event more likely). Leave alone unless recalibrating knock detection.
Details: When used: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 4 (Event 4), knock channel 4 of 8, on the knock window where FFF8A7C5 changes. Background step for this channel, added to (window extended) or subtracted from (window back to nominal) the channel background FFF8C1B0[3] for that one event; overlap-flag FFF8A7D5, gain curve cal 0x26F9F. Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling
table.description:
Base open-loop (power enrichment) AFR target by rpm and load, used once the exhaust temperature estimate is high enough. The ECU uses the richer of this and the Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...) group: to lean, edit both; to richen, either. Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor (Outside Closed Loop).
Details: Note: the ECU has a second open-loop fuel path: the four "Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV..., AVCS...)" tables 05ABB0..05ABEC, blended by TGV and AVCS (0x0CE5E8 -> FFF8A681); 0x0CEA80 takes the richer of the two (max). To lean the open-loop target edit both sets; richening works with either (read, my research notes). Also see Open Loop Fueling Floor. Base open-loop enrichment target, 0x0CE854. Used only while the exhaust temperature estimate FFF8AFD0 (see Exhaust Temperature Model Map A/B) is >= cal 0x18DD4 (39322, hysteresis cal 0x18DD6 = 2185), or its integral FFF8C03C >= cal 0x18DD8 (65535); otherwise this path contributes 0 (read). While cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is clear, the additive term (Primary Open Loop Fueling Additive x DAM multiplier) is added, minus Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive x Primary Open Loop Fueling Subtractive DAM Multiplier(DAM)/128. The result is rate-limited (FFF84424) into FFF8A682, and FFF8A684 = max(FFF8A682, other enrichments) feeds commanded lambda. LF9C000C: located from LF75404S 05AC6C by the code that reads it (read). LF9B003U: same code as LF9C000C; address from the same instruction (exact (1 reads)). Descriptor 009728. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV Closed, AVCS Inactive)
table.description:
Open-loop AFR target for TGVs closed with AVCS not in active control, part of a blend by TGV position and AVCS state, used above Open Loop Delay Load Threshold after a delay. The ECU uses the richer of the two systems, so leaning needs both.
Details: When used: whenever the open-loop delay has expired (see below); the blend follows TGV position and AVCS state. With the bit set: Alternate (+ cal 0x13DCD) while DAM16 < cal 0x1391C (16), else blend + cal 0x13DCD. 0x0CEA80 (read) then takes FFF8A681 (only once FFF8AFD6 >= FFF8AFE6, the open-loop delay, and when >= cal 0x13DD0 = 5), scales it by cal 0x237CA/128 (x1.0), rate-limits its rise by 05ACD4(rpm) and sets FFF8A684 = max(that, FFF8A682), FFF8A682 being Primary Open Loop Fueling from 0x0CE854. FBKC Maximum Retard
table.description:
Largest amount of timing feedback knock correction can pull. The live knock retard never goes below minus this value, and it applies to all cylinders at once. Raising it allows more protective retard.
Details: Feedback knock correction (0x0E2BE4, read): FFF8A79A is an s8 integrator kept at or below 0 and added directly to the fired timing (x 0.3516 degrees, 0x0D9E40): it is the only knock term of that sum, and FFF8A79A is one value for the whole engine, so a knock event on any cylinder retards all four (the fired timing FFF8A744 is recomputed per event for the next cylinder, but no per-cylinder knock retard exists; read). The state FFF8A79C (set once per combustion event by 0x0E2F94 from that event's knock results FFF8A7AD / FFF8A7B5; FFF8A7C1 is the knock-window-length flag (1 = extended window), used there only to reload per-cylinder hold counters FFF84920...FFF84930 from cal 0x27014 when it changes, purpose inferred) picks the action: states 0x0E, 0x0D, 7 and 6 subtract a step (floor = minus FBKC Maximum Retard); states 0x0C, 2, 0 (outside the rpm window) and the other non-knock states (0x0A outside the window, 0x0B) add the recovery step 0x1C271; 0x10 (inside the rpm window, no knock, fewer than cal 0x1C288 = 100 events since the last knock) holds the correction unchanged; 0x0F (inside the window, no knock, >= 100 events) adds 0x1C270, 8/9 add 0x1C272 (capped at 0); 5 = FFF8A79B x 0x1C26E / 128; 3 and 4 load the fixed values 0x1C26F / 0x1C278; 1 = 0. States (0x0E2F94, read, in priority order): 1 = knock control off (cal 0x56EE7 bit 7); 2 = FFF886AB bit 5 or load FFF8ADE4 <= cal 0x1C27E (0); 3 / 4 = FFF88E29 bit 3 / FFF88E2A bit 6 (fixed -14 counts = -4.9 degrees, inferred knock-sensor fault default); 5 = engine speed above FBKC Window RPM Maximum (hold); inside the rpm window: 6 / 0x0D = knock A with / without FFF8AA85 bit 0, 7 / 0x0E = knock B (FFF8A7B5, intensity > Knock Threshold, the active one); 0x0F = no knock and FFF8B130 (events since the last knock, 0x0E7C7C) >= cal 0x1C288 (100), 0x10 = no knock, fewer events; 8 / 9 hold; 0x0A / 0x0B / 0x0C other conditions (0x0B: A/F FFF88AF6 above a lambda threshold). This is the floor: the integrator never goes below minus this value. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: FBKC Retard Step (Knock, State 0x0E)
table.description:
Timing pulled by feedback knock correction for each knock event detected above Knock Threshold, in the main knock case. Applied once per combustion event, to all cylinders (there is no per-cylinder knock retard).

The state FFF8A79C (set once per combustion event by 0x0E2F94 from that event's knock results FFF8A7AD / FFF8A7B5; FFF8A7C1 is the knock-window-length flag (1 = extended window), used there only to reload per-cylinder hold counters FFF84920...FFF84930 from cal 0x27014 when it changes, purpose inferred) picks the action: states 0x0E, 0x0D, 7 and 6 subtract a step (floor = minus FBKC Maximum Retard); states 0x0C, 2, 0 (outside the rpm window) and the other non-knock states (0x0A outside the window, 0x0B) add the recovery step 0x1C271; 0x10 (inside the rpm window, no knock, fewer than cal 0x1C288 = 100 events since the last knock) holds the correction unchanged; 0x0F (inside the window, no knock, >= 100 events) adds 0x1C270, 8/9 add 0x1C272 (capped at 0); 5 = FFF8A79B x 0x1C26E / 128; 3 and 4 load the fixed values 0x1C26F / 0x1C278; 1 = 0. States (0x0E2F94, read, in priority order): 1 = knock control off (cal 0x56EE7 bit 7); 2 = FFF886AB bit 5 or load FFF8ADE4 <= cal 0x1C27E (0); 3 / 4 = FFF88E29 bit 3 / FFF88E2A bit 6 (fixed -14 counts = -4.9 degrees, inferred knock-sensor fault default); 5 = engine speed above FBKC Window RPM Maximum (hold); inside the rpm window: 6 / 0x0D = knock A with / without FFF8AA85 bit 0, 7 / 0x0E = knock B (FFF8A7B5, intensity > Knock Threshold, the active one); 0x0F = no knock and FFF8B130 (events since the last knock, 0x0E7C7C) >= cal 0x1C288 (100), 0x10 = no knock, fewer events; 8 / 9 hold; 0x0A / 0x0B / 0x0C other conditions (0x0B: A/F FFF88AF6 above a lambda threshold). Subtracted per pass in state 0x0E. p16 (read): the FBKC logic 0x0E2F94 (0x0E402C <- 0x07D0E0 <- 0x1E1CBC) is crank-synchronous: one pass per combustion event (180 deg CA, dispatched at tooth position 70 via the ATU-J0 software interrupt 0x0A7390), not per time. Confidence: inferred.

States (0x0E2F94, read, in priority order): 1 = knock control off (cal 0x56EE7 bit 7); 2 = FFF886AB bit 5 or load FFF8ADE4 <= cal 0x1C27E (0); 3 / 4 = FFF88E29 bit 3 / FFF88E2A bit 6 (fixed -14 counts = -4.9 degrees, inferred knock-sensor fault default); 5 = engine speed above FBKC Window RPM Maximum (hold); inside the rpm window: 6 / 0x0D = knock A with / without FFF8AA85 bit 0, 7 / 0x0E = knock B (FFF8A7B5, intensity > Knock Threshold, the active one); 0x0F = no knock and FFF8B130 (events since the last knock, 0x0E7C7C) >= cal 0x1C288 (100), 0x10 = no knock, fewer events; 8 / 9 hold; 0x0A / 0x0B / 0x0C other conditions (0x0B: A/F FFF88AF6 above a lambda threshold). table.name: FBKC Recovery Step
table.description:
Timing given back by feedback knock correction per combustion event in the non-knock states other than normal knock-free running: when rpm is outside the FBKC window (for example below FBKC Window RPM Minimum), in the closed-pedal / low-load state, and in a few other special states.
